rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate the distinction between the shelves used before interruption and the shelf used for interruption in interrupted use by providing an indicator corresponding to each shelf of an automatic adjusting apparatus installed onto an image recording apparatus and controlling the lighting-up state. CONSTITUTION:An automatic adjusting apparatus has a number of shelves arranged in the vertical direction, and a paper sheet discharged from an image recording apparatus is received from a receiving port 4, and accommodated into a prescribed shelf 1 in partition through a horizontal transport 3, paper guide 5, vertical transfer belt 6, and an indexer 8 which can be shifted in vertical direction. In this case, photodiodes 2 as indicator are arranged in a line in the longitudinal direction corresponding to each shelf 1. The photodiode 2 indicates the shelf 1 in partition use through lighting-up, and the shelf 1 for interrupted use is controlled by an indication controlling means so that the shelves used before interruption and the lower separated shelves are selected, and the pertinent photodiode 2 comes ON.

rows.title: Processing device and production of metal nitrate
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To continuously and efficiently obtain metal nitrate by connecting plural processing chambers in loops and successively using each chamber for the process of supplying metal lumps, the main reaction process to effect the reaction with nitric acid, and the post-reaction process. CONSTITUTION:Plural processing chambers 11-1, 11-2, 11-3, etc., are connected in loops, and each chamber is provided with tube L1, L2, L3, etc., for transportation of the reaction product, with tube L5, L6, L7, etc., for supplying the source nitric acid 12, and tube L8, L9, L10, etc., for recovery of the byproduct nitrogen oxide, etc., and for recovery of the process product. The first processing chamber is used for supplying new metal lumps, the second chamber is used for production of metal nitrate by the reaction of the nitric acid, and then the third processing chamber is used for the post reaction to terminate the reaction. Each chamber is used successively for these processes of supplying lumps, the main reaction and post-reaction in a cycle.

rows.title: Automatic light intensity control for x-ray film viewer
rows.abstract: The intensity of light penetrating an X-ray film being viewed is automatically maintained at a preset, adjustable, eye comfort level. A photosensor detects the average light level on the observer side, and its output controls the charging time of a capacitor coupled to the emitter of a unijunction transistor. When the capacitor reaches a predetermined voltage it fires the transistor and dumps its charge through a pulse generator which in turn triggers a gated semiconductor connected in series with the viewer light source. The period between successive firing cycles is proportional to the penetrating light level. Thus, if the light level increases, as when a relatively transparent film negative is inserted in the viewer or when a negative is removed, the capacitor charging time increases, the firing period increases, and the light source intensity therefore decreases to restore the preset level of light penetration.

rows.abstract:

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the necessity of a battery for supplying electric power to a dating device so that the title camera can be made smaller in size and lighter in weight by feeding electric power to the dating device from a signal line connected to the reset terminal of a microcomputer. CONSTITUTION:A battery for power supply 3 is commonly used for the reset signal of a microcomputer 1 and dating device 2 in such a way that the battery 3 is used for signals to the microcomputer 1 and as a power source to the dating device 2. Namely, when the output voltage of a detector 5 drops, a switching transistor 7b is turned on, and as a result, no voltage is applied across the reset terminal 1a of the microcomputer 1 and dating device 2, respectively. When the output voltage V1 of the detector 5 again becomes higher than a prescribed threshold voltage thereafter, the microcomputer 1 and dating device 2 are reset. Therefore, no special power supplying battery is required for the dating device and the camera can be made smaller in size and lighter in weight.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the reliability of inspection and to make it possible to accomplish the high speed in inspection and the low cost of the inspection by performing the connectivity analysis for the image signal on the upper surface of a center hub, and judging the applied state of a bonding agent from the number of the obtained connectivity components. CONSTITUTION:Under the state wherein a bonding agent 8 is applied on the upper part of a flange part, the image of a center hub 6 is picked up by a TV camera 10. The output is inputted into the threshold processing part of an image processing part 12. Binary-coding is performed at an adequate slide level. When the image is regenerated in an a monitor 20, three concentric concen tric circles are displayed. When connectivity analysis is performed in an image processing part 12, the number 3 of the connectivity component is obtained. Therefore, the number of the connectivity components is counted in the image processing part 12. When the result is 3, a signal OK is outputted from an output terminal 22. When the result is 2, a signal NG is outputted from a termi nal 22. Thus the accurate judgment can be performed without decreasing the speed of inspection.

rows.title: Image sensor with aberration compensating lens and its manufacture
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To compensate various aberrations and to obtain an excellent image by forming a dam at the outer peripheral part of a sensor on a picked-up image side, making melted transparent resin flow in it and rotating a turntable at a preset speed and curing the resin for unity. CONSTITUTION:The annular dam 8 is fixed on the surface of a CCD chip 2 so as to surround the image pickup surface 7 of the CCD chip 2, and the synthetic resin 9 in a melted state is made to flow in the dam 8. In this state, the turntable 4 is rotated at the preset speed to curve the liquid surface of the synthetic resin 9 in the melted state into a parabolic surface with centrifugal force, thereby curing the synthetic resin 9 completely. Thus, the aberration compensating lens made of the transparent resin is molded integrally with the image pickup surface of the image sensor to improve, specially, curvature of field and also easily form the aberration compensating lens which has the parabolic surface which is hardly machined. Consequently, the picture quality of an image formation optical system using the parabolic concave lens advantageous to aberration compensation is improved at low cost.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve a void property, compression hardness and the ability to prevent the leakage of processing liquid to the outside by compression bonding a fiber aggregate contg. self-adhesive binder fibers under heating with rolls of different heating set temps. and subjecting this aggregate to a heating treatment at the temp. above the m.p. of the binder fibers, thereby forming the base material while adjusting the density difference between the front and rear surfaces. CONSTITUTION:A fiber web 5 formed by incorporating at least 10wt.% self-adhesive binder fibers therein by a web forming machine is previously subjected to needle punching by a needle punching machine 6 in order to fix the web and to make the web as a non-woven fabric as well as to provide many columnar holes in its sectional direction. The needle punched non-woven fabric 7 is compression bonded under heating by a pair of the calender rolls constituted of the upper roll 8 heated to the temp. above the m.p. of the binder fibers and the lower roll 9 set at the temp. below the b.p. of the binder fibers, by which the non-woven fabric sheet 10 having the coarse and dense two-layered structures varying in the density of the front and rear fiber layers is obtd. The void property, the compression hardness and the ability to prevent the leakage of the processing liquid to the outside are improved in this way.

【目的】  高感度の感光材料を用いて、高濃度の透過型 陰画像を形成する方法を提供する。
【構成】  支持体上に、ハロゲン化銀、還元剤、重合性 化合物および塩基プレカーサーを一緒に収容した感光性 マイクロカプセルを含む感光層を有する感光材料を像様 露光する第一工程；第一工程と同時に、または第一工程 後に、感光材料を加熱し、これにより、塩基プレカーサ ーから塩基を放出させ、ハロゲン化銀を現像し、重合性 化合物を像様に硬化させる第二工程；第二工程後に、感 光材料と、透明支持体上に、色素を含む層を有する着色 シートとを重ね合わせた状態で加圧し、これにより未硬 化の重合性化合物と共に塩基を感光材料から着色シート に転写して、転写された塩基により着色シートに含まれ る色素を消色する第三工程；そして第三工程後に、感光 材料を着色シートから剥離する第四工程からなり、これ らの工程により着色シートに透過型陰画像を形成する。

rows.title: Color center forming device using epitaxial growth single crystal structure of rare earth elements
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a high contrast by forming a color center on a substrate having the first and second main surfaces while being formed of an oxide of rare earth elements and consisting of a substance doped with ion impurities, responding to information of projection. CONSTITUTION:A color center forming layer 2 is desired to have transmissibility to light emitted from a light source 11, thereby, light is projected on a screen 18 through a layer 2 in the case there is no color center. A single crystal of an oxide of properly doped rare earth elements is used for the layer 2. The single crystal layer is desirable because the structure of the single crystal is denser than that of a multi-crystal layer and a non-crystal layer while having a denser lattice defect. When an electron beam 1 is scanned under control, a color center 6 is dispersed spatially inside the layer 2, thereby an absorbing characteristic of a selected part of the layer 2 changes in relation to a picture. This absorption of the picture is increased by impression of bias voltage.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sample stand being easily cleaned and enduring repetitive use by applying coating to a sample placing surface with a fluororesin. Actually, the sample stand is coated with a platinous tone using a silky black as a black pigment. A flange 10b is raised upward in a peripheral edge part of the sample stand 10, and a marking 10a for showing plural readable ranges for arranging a sample such as gel is formed in a recessed shape or a projecting shape in a flat part except for the peripheral edge. The marking 10a is formed after coating. Thus, since a sample placing surface is coated with a fluororesin, even if a fluorescence pigment, a sample and the like stick to the placing surface, these can be easily cleaned.

rows.title: 纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法
rows.abstract: 一种纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法是在干燥箱(31)内边传送胶片(1)边经干燥风排气管(33)及干燥风供给管(34)循环干燥风干燥胶片(1)。这时，与干燥箱(31)内的干燥风接触部分的温度比在干燥风中所含低分子量物质的饱和温度高5℃以上。另外，在新鲜风导入口(36)导入新鲜风，同时在干燥风排气口(37)排出部分干燥风。该方法在溶液制膜法中传送胶片至干燥箱使之干燥时，能抑制低分子量物质气化物附着在干燥箱内壁面并能防止低分子量物质附着在胶片上。

rows.title: 防水型照相装置和用于配有镜头的胶卷单元的外壳
rows.abstract: 药片形状的催化剂放在防水外壳内侧的上部。催化剂由钯做成,它加速氢气和氧气结合的化学反应。催化剂一接触氢气就开始加速化学反应。在上述的防水外壳内侧的上部放置催化剂,就能有效地去除比空气轻的氢气。该化学反应产生水,因此最好在催化剂旁边放置吸水剂。

rows.title: Metal surface treating agent
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a metal surface treating agent having excellent durability which is easily applied to operation such as coating for imparting water repellency and noncohesive properties, with which the film to be formed is extremely thin, and, moreover, the film is hard to be peeled and broken. rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to raise a main floating roller, which is for discharging a paper sheet which is in contact with a driving roller and on which copying and fixing thereof have been done, and an auxiliary floating roller simultaneously, by connecting the main and auxiliary floating rollers through a link mechanism. CONSTITUTION:The main floating roller 3 that is in contact with the driving roller 1 and a conveying belt 2 and the auxiliary floating roller 4 can be raised integrally through a main roller supporting link 9 and an auxiliary roller supporting link 11. When a solenoid 5 is energized to raise the forward part of the supporting link 9 to raise the roller 3, then the main roller shaft 10 is engaged with a bent part 11b of the supporting link 11 and the roller 4 is also raised. rows.title: Storage device and manufacture thereof
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce variations in recrystallization positions and to carry out write of data by forming a desired position of a plurality of amorphous layers formed in a semiconductor substrate thinner than other positions thereof. CONSTITUTION:An n<+>-diffusion layer 12 is formed in a p-type semiconductor substrate 11. An amorphous layer 14 is formed as a memory cell between the n<+>-diffusion layer 12 and an upper electrode 13. The amorphous layer 14 is approximately circular and formed thin in a central part and thick in an outer peripheral part. An upper electrode is regarded as a word line and the n<+>- diffusion layer 12 is regarded as a lead line. When a voltage for data write is applied, the central part is recrystallized and the outer peripheral part maintains a amorphous state. Thereby, it is possible to carry out write stably without dispersion in data write positions. To form the amorphous layer 14, ion implantation is carried out to an exposed plane of a semiconductor substrate and difference of thickness is produced in the amorphous layer 14 by controlling the angle of ion implantation.

rows.title: Information processor
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To efficiently perform object management by subordinating an item relating to an object to the object in an information processor in which the object of a document, etc., is displayed in a form of icon. CONSTITUTION:When the icon 18a of (memo A) and the (tag paper information display) of a pop-up menu 19 are selected, the operation of tag paper information display request processing is started. Firstly, an object managing information file 11 is referred, and an object ID is retrieved from an object name and the (memo A). Thence, a tag paper information managing table 12 is referred based on the object ID, and a correspondent tag paper storage address is retrieved. Tag paper information in a user data file area 9 is read out based on the tag paper storage address, and a tag paper window 20 is displayed. When the edit command part 23 of the tag paper window 20 is selected, the input of the tag paper information to the tag paper window 20 can be performed. After the tag paper information is inputted, it is written on the user data file area 9 by selecting (preservation) in an edit command.

rows.title: Driving system for heat-sensitive recording head
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten a recording time, to reduce an electric energy, and to enable obtaining of a uniform recording concentration, by a method wherein a plural number of common drive terminals, allotted to a block whose picture is totally black, is simultaneously selected for recording. CONSTITUTION:A video signal 10, which is a picture information transmission side, is inputted to a sequence controller 12 togetherwith a synchronizing signal 11. The controller 12 decides whether or not each block is black. In case the decision results in finding that the block is not totally black but an ordinary pattern, a recording takes place according to a conventional method. In case, however, it is decided to be totally black, two common drive terminals, for example, B1-1, B1-2 are simultaneously driven by a common drive specified signal 17 outputted from the controller 12. A total black signal is further transmitted to a shift resistor 15 from the controller 12, and this causes one block of a heat-sensitive head 14 to be recorded by one-time operation.

rows.title: Magnetic recording medium
rows.abstract: Disclosed is a magnetic recording medium comprising a nonmagnetic support, a lower nonmagnetic layer and an upper magnetic layer. The lower non-magnetic layer is coated on the support, comprises an inorganic nonmagnetic powder dispersed in a binder, and is surface-coated with an inorganic oxide. The upper magnetic layer has a dry thickness of 1.0 micrometers or less and comprises a dispersion of a ferromagnetic powder in a binder. The upper magnetic layer is coated onto the lower nonmagnetic layer.

rows.title: Low moisture permeability film, optical film, polarizing plate, and liquid crystal display device, and method of producing low moisture permeability film
rows.abstract: The invention provides a low moisture permeability film which can provide an optical film with low moisture permeability and good brittleness, the optical film that a hard coat layer is further disposed on the low moisture permeability film and has low moisture permeability and good brittleness, a polarizing plate using the optical film, a liquid crystal display device using the polarizing plate and excellent in plate image quality in the high-temperature and high-humidity environment after a lapse of time, and a method of producing the low moisture permeability film. A low moisture permeability film has a layer formed by curing a curable composition on a substrate film. The curable composition includes the following (A) of 50 mass%-99 mass% and the following (B) of 1 mass%-30 mass% relative to the total solid components of the curable composition of 100 mass%: (A) at least one of a compound having an aliphatic hydrocarbon group and the ethylenically unsaturated double bonds, and a compound having a fluorine ring and the ethylenically unsaturated double bonds. (B) polyester urethane.

CONSTITUTION:The photodetector 20 is provided in face with a rotary drum 10 storing a storage fluorescent sheet 13 on which radiation picture information is stored and recorded and the light waveguide element 25 is fixed to a photodetection face 20a of the detector 20. rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  現像液、定着液、漂白液等の各々写真処理剤 が充填された各々の容器をセットで自動現像機に装填す るための写真処理剤セット製品を製造する方法を提供す る。
【解決手段】  複数の異なる写真処理剤をそれぞれ空容 器に充填し、これらの写真処理剤を充填した容器をセッ トで収納する化粧箱４２であって、化粧箱４２内に収納 され、写真処理剤が充填された容器が各々識別可能な個 別の態様を有し、化粧箱４２に容器の個別態様を検知す るための孔４２Ａを設けた。容器の識別可能な個別の態 様は、各々の容器に付されたマーキングや各々の容器に 充填された写真処理剤の色相に起因する容器の外面色相 等からなる。この化粧箱４２の孔４２Ａを介して容器の セット状態が正常か否かを検知し、正常なセット状態の 化粧箱が出荷される。

CONSTITUTION:This magnetic card is so constituted that a magnetic recording layer is placed on one surface of a supporter, a heat sensitive recording layer is placed thereon and a protective layer set by ultraviolet rays is placed thereon. The magnetic recording layer can be appropriately formed by a known method. Known substances can be employed as the color developing agent of the heat sensitive recording layer and the other materials. However, it is preferable that a specific application liquid is prepared so that the adhesion of the other materials to the magnetic recording layer is excellent and the cohesiveness of the heat sensitive recording material becomes powerful. As a binder, water soluble polyester is preferable. It is preferred that the ultraviolet curing protective layer be formed with solventless ultraviolet set resin.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a VA mode liquid crystal display device which hardly causes irregularity in a moisture-heat environment and has excellent front contrast and viewing angle performance.SOLUTION: The VA mode liquid crystal display device comprises a pair of polarizing plates with absorption axes orthogonal to each other with a liquid crystal cell being interposed therebetween. The polarizing plate in a viewing side includes, successively from the liquid crystal cell side, an optical compensation layer, a polarizer and a polarizing plate protective film; and the optical compensation layer has a thickness of 10 μm or less and has Rth(550) of 35 nm to 220 nm. The polarizing plate in a backlight side includes, successively from the liquid crystal cell side, an optical compensate layer, a polarizer and a polarizing plate protective film; and the optical compensation layer has a thickness of 10 μm to 60 μm and satisfies expressions (1):30 nm≤Re(550)≤200 nm and (2):50 nm≤Rth(550)≤400 nm.

rows.title: Liquid level detector
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To surely detect the liquid level by providing a resistance for detection between a first electrode and a power source and deciding whether electric potential between the first electrode and the resistance for detection is prescribed value or below by a decision means. CONSTITUTION:A resistor 14 for detection is provided between a DC power source 12 and a first electrode 16. Electric potential V1 between the resistor 14 for detection and the first electrode 16 is detected by a signal processing circuit 26. When the electric potential V1 is regulated to prescribed value or below, it is decided that the liquid surface of a developer 22 is regulated to at least the position of height wherein the tips of the first electrode 16 and a second electrode 18 are immersed. Further when leakage current I2 is allowed to flow to a heater 24 from the first electrode 16, electric potential detected by a signal processing circuit 26 is made lower than the above-mentioned electric potential V1. Therefore it is judged that the liquid level of the developer 22 is regulated to at least the position of height wherein the tips of the first electrode 16 and the second electrode 18 are immersed. Thereby the liquid surface surely is detected without affecting the leakage current I2.

rows.title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To release timely a photographic reagent even when processing is carried out with a processing soln. of a low pH or under conditions during usual thermal development, by using a precursor of the photographic reagent having a photographically useful group protected with a bonded protective group having a specified structure. CONSTITUTION:This silver halide photographic sensitive material contains at least one kind of precursor of a photographic reagent represented by formula I. A concrete example of the precursor used is represented by formula I-1. The precursor is stably present under conditions during storage and releases the photographic reagent rapidly and efficiently at the necessary time during processing. Even when processing is carried out with a processing soln. of such a relatively low pH as 9-12 or by thermal development, the photographic reagent is timely released. Desensitization by the addition of the precursor is prevented and the function of the released photographic reagent can well be shown.

rows.title: 光電着法を用いた画像記録方法およびこれを用いたカラーフィルターの製造方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  基板に用いる材料の制約等がない汎用性の高 い光電着法を用いた画像記録方法を提供すること。ま た、高解像度、高階調度を有する画像を形成し得る画像 記録法を提供すること。さらに、この画像記録方法を利 用して、高い平滑性および高い光透過性を有する高解像 度のカラーフィルターの製造方法を提供すること。
【解決手段】  支持体１１、導電性膜１２、および光半 導体薄膜１３を順次積層した基板１０を（（Ａ））、少 なくとも光半導体薄膜１３が、電着液２０に接触するよ うに配置し、導電性膜１２に電流または電圧を供与しつ つ、光半導体薄膜１３側から電着液２０を介して、画像 様に基板１０を光照射し（（Ｂ））、光照射部に光起電 力を発生させ、光照射部に電着膜２１を形成すること （（Ｃ））を含む画像記録方法である。さらに、電着膜 ２１を、所望により、普通紙等の像保持基材４０上に転 写すること（（Ｄ））を含む画像記録方法である。

rows.title: Fine structure, method for creating fine structure, and raman spectroscopy and spectroscope
rows.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device that has the reinforcing function of Raman scattered light, has high performance and high quality, and can be created relatively easily.  <P>SOLUTION: A substrate 2 in a structure in which a plurality of micropores 6 are formed on the surface, is obtained by anodizing a substrate 1 made of, for example an aluminum layer 4. Metal is filled into the micropores 6 of the substrate 2 by electrical plating, or the like for forming a metal fine particle 8. Plating treatment continues until the head section of the metal fine particle 8 projects from the surface of the substrate 2 and the diameter of the head section is larger than the hole diameter of the micropores after metal is filled to the same position as the surface of the substrate 2. Plating treatment is preferably allowed to continue until the gap between the head sections of the metal particle becomes 10nm or smaller. In the structure thus formed, Raman scattered light is effectively reinforced by an electric field generated at the gap section of the head section, so that high Raman reinforced effect can be obtained. Additionally, a gold fine particle is arranged in the micropores that are formed in advance, so that the surface structure is homogeneous, thus obtaining a stable result in Raman spectrum.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

rows.title: Microfilming camera
rows.abstract: A microfilming camera for taking an microimage of a document on a film. The microfilming camera comprises a main mirror disposed beneath a transparent document support for the support thereon of a document to be microfilmed, which main mirror is used to deflect the optical path of a photo-taking system, a side mirror disposed on each side of the space delimited between the document support and the main mirror, and illuminating sources positioned exteriorly of the optical path and disposed in face-to-face relationship with the respective side mirrors.

rows.title: Scattered-beam eliminating grid, grid apparatus, and manufacture of scattered-beam eliminating grid
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To maintain a good picture quality by use of the grid of a radiation tomograph even if a distance from a radiation source varies. SOLUTION: A grid 1c comprises flexible spacer portions 4 and radiation absorbing portions 2 arranged alternately side by side, and has flexibility as a whole. A thin flexible plate member 42 with the grid 1c thereon is disposed on the top plate 46 of a sensor, and when an actuator 48 raises the peripheral portion of the plate member 42 from below, the plate member 42 and the grid 1c are deformed into the shape of a spherical surface and radiation non- absorbing portions 4 are aligned in the advancing direction of an X-ray from an X-ray source S located approximately at the focus of the spherical surface. Thus, picture quality will not be deteriorated even on the peripheral portion of the grid.

rows.abstract: 本发明涉及一种放射图像检测设备及其制造方法。具体地，本发明涉及一种放射图像检测设备，其包括：第一闪烁器和第二闪烁器，其响应于辐射的放射线而发射荧光；以及，第一光电检测器和第二光电检测器，其检测所述荧光；其中，从放射线入射侧起依序布置所述第一光电检测器、所述第一闪烁器、所述第二光电检测器和所述第二闪烁器，并且，向所述第一闪烁器位于所述第一光电检测器附近和所述第二闪烁器位于所述第二光电检测器附近的至少一个设置高活化剂浓度区域，在所述高活化剂浓度浓度区域中，活化剂浓度相对高于在相关的闪烁器中的平均活化剂浓度。

rows.title: Magneto-optical recording medium
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To control the variation in C/N by forming a first dielectric protective layer, recording layer, second dielectric protective layer and metal reflecting layer on a substrate and specifying thickness of each layer to a specified range so as to reduce phase difference in reflected light. CONSTITUTION:The medium has a four-layer structure composed of the first protective layer of 350 - 650 Angstrom  thickness, recording layer of 150 - 250 Angstrom  thickness, second dielectric protective layer of 100 -600 Angstrom  thickness, and metal reflecting layer of 200 - 800 Angstrom  thickness. By this constitution, phase difference due to rotation of polarization plane of the reflected light is made as small as <=15 degrees in absolute value. This almost prevents the reflected light from changing into elliptically polarized light and prevents reduction of the carrier output. Thus, the obtd. medium is hardly influence by the variation in performances of drives, namely, variation of C/N due to drives can be decreased. Thickness of these layers are controlled in a manner that the phase difference shows minimum against variation in thickness of the first protective layer which particularly affects the phase difference, and thereby, time of forming films can be reduced.

rows.title: Method for recording optical data and optical data-recording medium
rows.abstract: The invention provides a method for recording optical data being able to carry out the recordation and reproduction in high density by using a laser light having a short wave of length less than 450 nm, and provides an optical data-recoding medium having an excellent recording property and stability of recording data being able to preserve in long term under high temperature and high humidity as well as being able to be utilized in aforesaid optical data recording method. The method for recording optical data according to the invention comprises carrying out an optical recordation of recording an optical data on an optical recording medium by exposing under laser light having a short wave of length less than 450 nm, which is characterized in that the recording layer of aforesaid optical data-recording medium comprises a phthalocyanine derivate. Additionally, the invention further comprises an optical data-recording medium which is characterized in that it utilizes aforesaid method for recording optical data.

rows.title: Method for generating bit map data and printing data preparation system
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To generate bit map data of high picture quality and to execute facing operation and page editing operation in parallel. SOLUTION: Since Thin Flat PS obtained by facing operation using dummy page data (Probe EPS) and output page data obtained by page editing operation are individually rasterized (steps 704 and 712) and then output face data are generated by executing bit map synthesis (step 716), the facing operation and the page editing operation can be mutually independently executed. Since the output page data are processed by affine transformation at least on the basis rotational and enlarged/reduced components (step 710) and rasterized and bit map data are generated in each page (step 712), it is unnecessary to apply the affine transformation such as rotation and enlargement/reduction causing the reduction of picture quality to the bit map data of each page at the time of bit map synthesis.

rows.title: Image receiving sheet element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the slipperiness of an image receiving sheet surface and image forming material and to prevent intrusion of air bubbles therebetween by roughening the image receiving layer side surface of a removable cover sheet. CONSTITUTION:The cover sheet is made of a high polymer having high dimensional stability and the surface thereof is adequately roughened. The roughening is executed to the extent of the surface roughness having average 2-40mum, more preferably 4-10mum peak valley (dent) distance. The image receiving sheet element is formed by tightly adhering the image receiving layer provided on a base and the roughened surface of the cover sheet roughened in the above- mentioned manner in such a manner that said layer and sheet can be stripped from each other. The surface of the image receiving layer is roughened by the rough surface of the cover sheet when both are stripped at the time of use. The slipperiness between both is thereby improved and the workability is improved in the case of transferring the image from the image forming material to the image receiving layer. The air bubbles are easily removable even if said bubbles enter the spacing between both.

rows.title: 硬涂膜、具备硬涂膜的物品及图像显示装置
rows.abstract: 根据本发明提供一种硬涂膜、具备上述硬涂膜的物品及图像显示装置，上述硬涂膜具有基材和形成于上述基材的至少一个面上的硬涂层，上述硬涂层含有具有硅倍半氧烷结构的化合物，将上述基材的弹性模量设为σA且将上述硬涂层的弹性模量设为σB时，由σA‑σB表示的弹性模量差Δσ为1800～4900MPa，上述基材的弹性模量为6.0～9.0GPa，上述硬涂层在压入试验中的恢复率为84～99％。

rows.title: Photosensitive planographic printing plate
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a photosensitive planographic printing plate having satisfactory sensitivity, printing resistance and shelf stability. SOLUTION: A coating solution for a photopolymerizable layer containing a polyurethane resin binder, a compound having an addition polymerizable ethylenically unsaturated bond and a solvent is applied on a substrate having a hydrophilic surface and dried by heating under such conditions as to keep the resulting photosensitive planographic printing plate at 90-140 deg.C for >=10 sec to obtain the objective photosensitive planographic printing plate. Preferably the obtained photosensitive planographic printing plate is cooled to <=50 deg.C, the top of the photopolymerizable layer of the printing plate is coated with a protective layer containing a water-soluble oxygen barrier material and the protective layer is dried by heating.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To compress and accumulate a document, etc., including a graphic and a graph, etc., at high compressibility by converting image data concerning the graphic into the data in vector expression, and accumulating them. Next, for the data of a character, etc., they are compressed by MR, MH compressing methods in the same way as before, and accumulated to the accumulator 4. Thus, the contents of the documents, etc., including the graph and the graphic can be compressed at the high compressibility, and accumulated.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a job processing service device little in the labor and time for developing and correcting a user interface means and easy in matching. CONSTITUTION:A user interface means which is common to all the job processing services is arranged respectively by one for each client computer 2. A job processing service 11 desired by a user is selected by this interface means. A job processing service management means 12 supplies information concerning the user interface of the job processing service such as the layout of a screen 50 to the user interface means 21 to generate the user interface in accordance with the information. When the user executes input, selection, etc., the job processing service management means 12 supplies them to a job processing service means to start the job processing service. When the selected job processing service is finished, the processing result such as normal finish is supplied to the user interface means.

rows.title: Optical recording and reproducing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable an accurate seek and tracking control by controlling a ratio of currents to flow into 1st and 2nd seek coils in accordance with positions of a carriage part and focus adjustment movable part in the radial direction. CONSTITUTION:A relationship between a radially directional position of an optical recording medium and magnetic fields generated by conducting the coils is measured and a relationship between radially directional positions of the seek coils 41 and 42 to be electrified and a current ratio are stored in advance in a current ratio setting table ROM 83. Then, address information detected by an address detecting circuit 84 from a signal to be outputted from a disk reproducing circuit 85 is inputted to a microcomputer 80, where current amts. to flow into the coils 41 and 42 are instructed to current drivers 81 and 82 respectively with reference to the ROM 83. By this method, even when magnetic fields working the coils 41 and 42 respectively are uneven, a ratio of driving force for working the focus adjustment movable part (p) to driving force for working the carriage part (s) is conformed with a mass ratio of (p) to (s) so that resonance can be prevented, and the accurate control can thus be carried out.

rows.title: Mark imprinting device for rotary camera
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To confirm continuous relation between mutual films by looking the exposed film with naked eyes and to improve the efficiency of work such as the read or the arrangement of the film by obtaining such constitution that a mark showing the continuous relation between the films is imprinted on the head or the last of the film based on an imprint command. CONSTITUTION:In the case that the film 34 is exhausted on the way of the original of one group, the imprint command is inputted when an imprint key is depressed at the last of the film 34 or the imprint key is depressed before developing is executed by depressing a developing key on the way of photographing. Based on the imprint command, the respective picture elements of a light emitting means 86 are selectively made to flicker by a control means 88. Then, the mark showing a sentence such as 'there is a continuous film' or 'containing to the roll of number (n)', for example, is imprinted on the last of the film 34. When the imprint command is inputted on the head of the film 34, the mark showing the sentence such as 'there is a continuous film' or 'continuing to the roll of number (n+1)', for example, is imprinted on the film 34 to which photographing is performed next. Thus, the continuous relation between the films 34 is easily confirmed with the naked eyes while looking the exposed film 34. Besides, the efficiency of the reading or the arranging work of the film 34 is improved.

rows.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an excellent positive resist composition for reducing PEB temperature dependency without any problem of outgasing during exposure, by possessing sufficiently excellent contrast under exposure due to EUV light, and to provide a pattern forming method using it.  <P>SOLUTION: The positive resist composition contains a resin containing a repeated unit of a specific structure and increasing solubility to alkali developing liquid due to action of acid, and a sulfonium salt compound generating acid due to action of EVU light of a specific structure. rows.title: Head device for side print
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the quality of the side print by forming a rectangular light projection surface, imaging light which is emitted from its peripheral part on an exposure surface, and putting light projected from the center part out of focus on the exposure surface. CONSTITUTION:Monochromatic or multi-color light emitted by a light source 12 under the control of an LED driver is made incident on a bundle 15 and projected from its light projection surface 15. Light Part of the projection light which is emitted from the center part of the surface 15a becomes an out-of-focus image on the surface 18a of a film 18 through the operation of a lens 16 and the colors are mixed sufficiently. The light emitted from the peripheral surface of the surface 15a, on the other hand, forms a sharp image on the surface 18a. The light emitted from the surface 15a forms a latent image which has a sharp contour, but has no color irregularity on the surface 18a. Then respective light sources 12 are made to emit light selectively and a latent image of a mark is formed on the film 18.

rows.abstract: 【課題】複数パルス波形で可変サイズ小滴を発生するように小滴放出装置を駆動するための方法及び装置を提供する。 【解決手段】一実施形態では、アクチュエータを有する小滴放出装置を駆動するための方法は、少なくとも１つの駆動パルス及び少なくとも１つの離脱パルスを有する複数パルス波形をアクチュエータに印加することを含む。更に、この方法は、少なくとも１つの駆動パルスで流体の小滴を形成することも含む。更に、この方法は、少なくとも１つの離脱パルスで小滴の離脱を加速することも含む。更に、この方法は、小滴放出装置が、複数パルス波形のパルスに応答して流体の小滴を放出するようにさせることも含む。離脱パルスは、小滴の尾部質量を減少するために少なくとも１つの駆動パルスにより形成された小滴の離脱を生じさせる。 【選択図】図８

rows.abstract: 【課題】ユーザインタフェース表示や管理レポートの印刷出力などを行なう場合における複数の言語体系への対応を、より使い勝手が良くなるようにする。 【解決手段】通常言語設定記憶部１１０にデフォルト用の言語情報を記憶する。一般言語設定記憶部１２０に一般ユーザ設定用の言語情報を圧縮して記憶する。一般ユーザにより何れかの言語設定が選択されるとＲＡＭ１２４に展開して使う。機械管理者による言語設定の切替可能範囲と一般ユーザによる言語設定の切替可能範囲とは、個別に設定可能にしておく。デフォルト設定とするべきメジャー言語と、自由な切替えを可能にするべきマイナー言語の関係のバランスを加味して、それぞれの切替可能範囲を設定する。制御部１００の言語設定切替部１４０は、動作管理部１３０からの情報に従って言語設定を切り替える。 【選択図】図４

rows.title: Conductive film and method of producing the same, and touch panel and integrated solar cell
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of producing a conductive film in which a fine pattern of a high permeability low resistance conductive film can be formed easily while improving insulation significantly, and to provide a touch panel in which durability against writing pressure and flexibility are improved, and an integrated solar cell in which conversion efficiency is improved.SOLUTION: A conductive film consists of a substrate, and a conductive layer formed on the substrate and containing at least conductive fibers. The conductive layer is patterned and the pattern edge roughness is 5 μm or less. Such an aspect as the conductive layer contains dispersant and the mass ratio (A/B) of the total content A of the dispersant and the content B of conductive fibers is 0.1 to 5.0, or an aspect as the conductive fibers have an average short-axis length of 100 nm or less and an average long-axis length of 5 μm or more is preferable.

rows.title: Photocurable adhesive and bonding process employing same
rows.abstract:
An actinic radiation curable adhesive is provided that includes 50 to 99 wt %
of a bifunctional and/or a polyfunctional oxetane compound, 0 to 40 wt % of a
monofunctional oxetane compound, 1 to 50 wt % of an epoxy compound having a
cyclic structure, and a catalytic amount of a photoinitiator. The adhesive has an
initial viscosity of 10 to 1,000 mPa·s and a viscosity at gel point of 1 × 10 1  to 9 × 10 6 
Pa.s. There is also provided a process for bonding an adherend A and a different
adherend B, the process including forming an adhesive layer by coating a surface of
the adherend A with the above adhesive at a thickness of 0.05 to 50 µm, irradiating
the adhesive layer with actinic radiation, and bonding the adherend B to the
adhesive layer after 0.01 to 4 times the time required for gelling of the adhesive layer
has passed following the start of irradiation with actinic radiation.

rows.title: インスタントフイルムの展開機構
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  電源が消耗しても確実に現像液ポッドの裂開 及び現像液の展開を行う。
【解決手段】  フイルム展開機構４７を展開モータ６ ０、展開ローラ対６１、展開ギヤ列６２とから構成す る。展開ギヤ列６２を、遊星ギヤクラッチ６５を用いて ギヤ列６９とギヤ列７０との２段階の減速ギヤ列から構 成する。ギヤ列７０はギヤ列６９よりもギヤ比が高いの で、展開ローラ対６１の回転速度は遅いが高トルクで回 転する。通常、遮光カバーの搬送時にはギヤ列７０を、 インスタントフイルムの搬送時にはギヤ列６９を用いる ように展開モータ６０を回転させる。展開ローラ対６１ による現像液ポッドの裂開時に、展開モータ６０の回転 速度が所定値以下に減速した場合には、展開モータ６０ の回転方向を切り替えてギヤ列７０を用いて現像液ポッ ドの裂開を行う。現像液ポッドの裂開後に、再び展開モ ータ６０の回転方向を切り替えてギヤ列６９を用いて現 像液の展開を高速に行う。

rows.title: Sheet body fixing device having clamp with uniform nipping force
rows.abstract: When a sheet body such as a printing plate or the like is wound onto a rotation drum, the sheet body is securely fixed to the rotation drum and after being fixed, the coming up of the sheet off the drum is kept at a minimum. In the clamp having two support points, the position of the support points are determined such that the amount of deformation caused when a centrifugal force generated when the rotation drum rotates at a high speed, acts against an urging force of the clamp, in the dimension between the support points and the dimension between the support points and one end portion, is substantially uniform along the entire length of the clamp portion. Thus, the nipping force is uniform along the entire clamp and the printing plate, and the disadvantage of the printing plate inclining on the rotation drum is eliminated.

rows.title: Image storing method and image output system
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To more quickly output an image when the output of a highly accurate image is unnecessary in an image output system. SOLUTION: A QA-WS 20 inputs an image obtained by modality to a regulated processing means 22. The means 22 applies regulated processing to the image obtained by the modality, obtains 10-bit regulated image data (a) and stores original image data (p) in an image server 30. An image processing means 24 reads out regulated image data (c) stored in the server 30, applies resolution reducing processing and prescribed image processing to the read data (c) and stores image processed data (d) in the server 30. At the time of diagnosis, a diagnosing WS 12 reads out original image data (f) stored in the server 30, displays a highly accurate image, and at the time of image retrieval, reads out image processed data (h) of which data volume is smaller than that of the data (f) and quickly displays the retrieved image.

rows.title: Device and method for verifying synchronous clock in light beam scanner
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily and exactly verify the resolution and state of a linear encoder plate for synchronization. SOLUTION: The number of synchronous clock SYNC generated with the linear encoder plate for synchronization is counted in a counter part 106, is outputted to a comparing part 110 and a counted value storage part 116. With a compared result t obtained by comparing a counted value cnt in one main scanning direction of the forward with a reference value D0 supplied from a reference value setting part 112, the state of the linear encoder plate for synchronization is verified, and the resolution of the linear encoder plate for synchronization is simultaneously verified from the counted value cnt.

rows.abstract: 【課題】  設計データに対応する電気特性の配線基板を得る。 【解決手段】  基板設計装置１２から、回路設計、アートワーク設計、シート設計、そして面付け処理が実行された後のＩＣチップを搭載する位置に設けられるパッドや配線の設計データ（ガーバーデータ）が出力され、ＲＩＰ装置１４は、変換部２６における処理において配線の線幅について補正処理を施しつつ、設計データをラスターイメージに変換処理し、ＤＩ装置１６へ出力する。ＤＩ装置１６は、イメージデータにより直接ワークボード２０に画像を露光し現像し、ＤＥＳ装置１８でエッチング処理する。従って、ワークボード２０の基板厚にばらつきを有する場合に生じる特性インピーダンスのばらつき、つまり基板の各所でばらつく板厚や材料厚に起因した電気特性のばらつきを抑制するため、予め求めた補正テーブルによりパターン幅を調整することによって、電気特性ばらつきを抑制できる。 【選択図】  図１

rows.title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the photosensitive material which has excellent sharpness and suppresses the deterioration in the sharpness by the bleeding of color images during the preservation after processing by respectively specifying the oil drop content ratio in emulsion layers and the average jelly strength of the gelatin contained in the emulsion layers. CONSTITUTION:The oil drop content ratio of at least one layer of the silver halide emulsion layers of the silver halide color photographic sensitive material having protective layers is >=0.6 and <=1.5 and the average jelly strength of the gelatin incorporated into the emulsion layers is >=250. Namely, the oil drop content ratio=the total volume of the oil drops in these layers/the total volume of the gelatin in these layers and the oil drop content ratio is 0.6 to 1.5 and more particularly 0.7 to 1.2. The average jelly strength of the gelatin used for the emulsion layers contg. couplers is >=250 and is more particularly preferably >=260 and <=400. The case in which all of the gelatin kinds incorporated into the emulsion layers are constituted of the gelatin kinds having >=250 and <=350 jelly strength is more preferable.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To stabilize the quantity of light of a fixed fluorescent lamp and prevent defects such as uneven fixing and others generated by the variation of quantity of light by recording an image on a light fixing type photosensitive recording material by means of an image recording section and then emitting light and fixing image. CONSTITUTION:A photosensitive recording material 10 between a guide plate 66 and another guide plate 68 is clamped by a carrier roller 72 guided by a guide 70 and rotated reversely, fed out to a feed-in and out site and disposed on a tray. The heat treatment of one photosensitive recording material is completed by the arrangement. The surface temperature of a fixing flourescent lamp 150 is controlled by an air suction fan 154, a heater 156 and a Pertier element 158 at light sources 64A and 64B. For the purpose of shortening the starting time from putting on the fixing fluorescent lamp 150 to reaching the lowest optimum temperature level, power is applied to the air the suction fan 154 and the heater 156.

rows.title: Photosensitive material drying device
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To dry a photosensitive material without the occurrence of damages, pressing traces, unequal brightness, etc. SOLUTION: A chamber 64 which has transporting roller pairs 44 to 62 arranged along the horizontal direction and slit holes for blowing hot air to photographing paper P formed on the upper and lower side, is disposed. Only the transporting rollers 54, 56, 58 in contact with emulsion layers among the transporting roller pairs disposed in the region where the moisture content of the emulsion layers of the photographing paper P attains >=2 to <20% are formed as tacky adhesion resistant rollers of PTFE, etc., and the other rollers are formed out of low-cost materials.  The tacky adhesive power of the emulsion layers increases when moisture content falls to <20% but the emulsion layers of the state increased in the tacky adhesive power are composed to come into contact with only the tacky adhesion resistant rollers and, therefore, such troubles as jamming of the photographing paper P and the transfer of the emulsion layers to the roller surfaces are prevented. The pressing trace of the roller is hardly formed.

rows.title: Microfilter and its manufacture
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a filter having extremely fine pore diameter and narrow distribution of pore diameters by irradiating an energy beam on a substrate, vapor-depositing another substance on the substrate, and then removing the substrate. CONSTITUTION:An energy beam 2 whose flux is extremely narrowed is irradiat ed on a substrate 1 of a Cr sheet, etc. to form selectively an irradiated part 3 and a non-irradiated part 4 on the substrate 1. Then a desired filter-forming substance of Au, etc. is vapor-deposited on the substrate. The vapor is not deposited on the part 3 irradiated with the energy beam 2 to form a part 5 on which vapor is not deposited, and the vapor is deposited on the non-irradiated part 4 to form a vapor-dposited part 6. Moreover, a filter-forming material 7 is separated from the substrate 1 by dissolving the substrate 1 into an acidic soln., for example. A microfilter having <=0.1mu pore diameter and having <=20% variance of diameters is obtained in this way.

rows.title: Total photofinishing laboratory system
rows.abstract: A total photo-lab system for automatic printing processing, cutting, sorting and enveloping. Each of a plurality of films spliced into a film roll is provided with a label printed with a respective ID number bar code. The same ID number bar code is provided on a respective envelope. During printing, the ID number of each film set in a printing position is read out so as to record a punch code indicative of the same ID number on a photographic paper besides the first print frame made from that film. The printed film is reserved until the corresponding print frames have been processed. The ID number of the processed photographic paper is read and compared with the ID number of the reserved film. When these ID numbers are identical, the film is cut and inserted into a film sheath sheet, whereas the photographic paper is cut into individual prints, and are sorted into each set of prints belonging to the same film. The film sheath sheet is inserted into the envelope having the same ID number as the film contained in that film sheath sheet, and then the prints having the same ID number are inserted therein.

rows.title: Thermal transfer recording material
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a thermal transfer recording material having favorable heat resistance and high sensitivity, by adding a releasing substance liquefied when being heated, to a matrix polymer constituting a base film. CONSTITUTION:A thermal transfer recording material comprises a heat-sensitive ink layer 1, a base film 2, a releasing substance 3 and a matrix polymer 4. The releasing substance 3, which is liquefied when being heated, is added to the matrix polymer 4 constituting the base film 2. The matrix polymer 4 may be a polyester, triacetyl cellulose, nylon, a polycarbonate or the like. The releasing substance 3 is a waxy substance, e.g., a low molecular weight polyolefin wax such as polyethylene and polypropylene, a modified polyolefin such as polyethylene oxide and polypropylene oxide or a copolymer thereof. With heat applied by a thermal head at the time of recording, the releasing substance exudes to the contact surface of the base film and the thermal head, whereby a sticking phenomenon or defective feeding of the film can be obviated.

rows.title: 光触媒電極、人工光合成モジュール及び人工光合成装置
rows.abstract: 透明導電体層を用いた場合に、面積を大きくしても電気抵抗が小さい光触媒電極、人工光合成モジュール及び人工光合成装置を提供する。光触媒電極は、基板、透明導電体層、光触媒層及び線状の金属電気伝導体を有する、光により水を分解して気体を発生させる光触媒電極であって、基板、透明導電体層、光触媒層がこの順に積層され、且つ線状の金属電気伝導体が透明導電体層に接している。人工光合成モジュールは、光により水を分解して酸素を発生させる、酸素発生電極と、光により水を分解して水素を発生させる、水素発生電極とを具備し、且つ酸素発生電極と水素発生電極が光の進行方向に沿って直列に配置されている。酸素発生電極と水素発生電極の少なくとも一方が上述の光触媒電極の構成である。人工光合成装置は人工光合成モジュールを有し、水を循環して利用する。

rows.title: System timing synchronizing system
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To simplify an arithmetic device for executing the arithmetic at each station for the purpose of synchronism by setting a flag only to the packet of a station having leadership, and allowing each station to establish the system timing based on the distance from an optical star coupler. CONSTITUTION:A packet signal formed by a transmission logical circuit 11 is transmitted to optical cables 31a-31d and received by each station. When the transmission of the initial packet signal is succeeded, its station acquires a position as the master station and a flag is set to the packet transmitted from the station to establish the reference of frame synchronism. When stations other than the master station detect that the master flag is set, it is transferred to a timing set circuit 24. The set circuit 24 operates a distance code of the own station and a guard time of a packet signal at a position of the optical star coupler 30 to synchronize the system timing.

rows.title: Color image forming device
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To restrain the color slurring of a full color image with a simple constitution and to restrain the increase of the production cost by transmitting the rotational driving force of a driving motor to plural photoreceptor drums through a belt-like carrying body. SOLUTION: Laser beam scanning units 20A to 20D scan the photo-receptor drums 18A to 18D to which specified charge is previously given by electrifiers 19A to 19D with a laser beam based on image information in accordance with respective colors outputted from an operation control part 12 so as to form electrostatic latent images in accordance with the respective colors. In the case of issuing a command that the latent image is to be formed on the drums 18A to 18D based on scanning with the laser beam, a paper carrying belt 17 is driven based on the rotation of a driving roller 13, and simultaneously, pressure rollers 24A to 24D press the belt 17 to the non-image forming area of the drums 18A to 18D. Thus, driving force based on the rotation of the driving motor is transmitted to drive the drums 18A to 18D.

rows.title: Paper-sheet collator
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To permit paper sheets to be distributed at high speed with a small motive force by installing a reciprocating distributing means for distributing the transported paper sheets onto a plurality of stages of pins during reciprocating operation and a reciprocating dividing means for dividing-controlling said distributing means. CONSTITUTION:When a paper sheet discharged from a copying machine, etc. reaches a paper-sheet collator installed onto the copying machine, etc., a paper sheet is inserted between the endless belt 8 of a paper-sheet carrying-in mechanism 5 which forms a reciprocating distributing means and an endless film 10, and said paper sheet is lowered along a plurality of stages of pins. At the same time, the electromagnetic clutch 23 in a reciprocating dividing means 16 is turned ON, and the turning moment of a motor 15 is transmitted onto the sprocket 11 of the reciprocating distributing mechanism 6 through transmission means 17, 18, 33, and 34, and the guide installed onto a chain 12 in lowered. When the guide reaches a distribution position, the electromagnetic clutch 23 is turned OFF to stop the guide, and the paper sheet transported by the paper-sheet transportation mechanism 5 are fed onto the pins.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To display the state of an image forming device with a few images by independently storing and displaying image data for each display pixel as an image component. SOLUTION: This device independently stores and displays image data that is a component of an image for each display pixel. Also, it changes the coordinate information of a desired component in accordance with a specified moving image pattern and displays a moving image that is related to the display element. For instance the outside appearance of an image forming device such as a copying machine which consists of display elements such as a center tray (ejecting tray) 1, a side tray (ejecting tray) 2, a hand inserting tray (feeding tray) 3, a side panel 4, a front panel 5, a top tray (feeding tray) 6, a middle tray (feeding tray) 7 and a bottom tray (feeding tray) 8, is displayed. Each of these display elements is respectively prepared as an independent image and the outside appearance of the image forming device can be obtained by combining them.

rows.title: Manufacture of mother wafer structure body
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To carry out position matching of a structure body by scanning a beam to a mother wafer structure body to detect lengthwise and breadthwise edge line information of a rectangular construction part from a stepped section and by obtaining edge corner coordinate of the rectangular construction section. CONSTITUTION:Arbitrary coordinate of a mother wafer structure body 20 on lengthwise and breadthwise edge lines 25, 26 of a specified semiconductor chip 22 on a stage 10 is obtained from a peak section of signal waveform of secondary electron which is emitted by deflection scanning of an electronic beam 2. Then, coordinate X1 and coordinate X2 on a breadthwise edge line 26 of the specified semiconductor chip 22 and coordinate Y1 and coordinate Y2 on the lengthwise edge line 25 are obtained; lengthwise and breadthwise edge line information of [Y=a1X+b1] and [Y=a2X+b2], which are linear equations of each of lengthwise and breadthwise edge lines 25, 26 on the stage 10 are obtained. Thereafter, simultaneous linear equations of lengthwise and breadthwise edge line informations are solved to obtain an edge corner coordinate Z of the specified semiconductor chip 22 which is equivalent to an intersecting point of the lines.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate the key operation and the state check by constituting a key input means of a transparent touch switch which is operated by slight pressure, and also, proving a touch switch selecting area and a display part on one sheet of printed surface printing sheet so that a switch operation and a display operation by a light emitting element can be executed. CONSTITUTION:When a display part on a surface printing sheet 1 is pressed with a finger, a touch panel upper sheet 6 which has been placed thereunder and a control circuit part I 13 scan a scan signal, and subsequently, a control circuit part II 14 scans a return signal, and when a touch panel electrode 8 is brought to electric conduction, a switch input is detected. The switch input which has been detected is transferred to a control circuit board 15, in which a light emitting element 10 corresponding to the display part, for instance, an LED is lighted. The light emitting element 10 is loaded on a printed board 17, and also, the side end face of supporting member 12 is surrounded and shielded by a light shielding wall 12a, therefore, it does not occur that a light beam from the LED leaks to the periphery. In such a way, it does not occur that the light beam leaks to the periphery of the display part and it comes to be scarcely visible, and both the switch operation and the display operation by the light emitting element 10 can be executed.

rows.title: 着色组合物、固化膜、滤色器及显示装置
rows.abstract: 本发明提供一种能够形成耐光性优异的固化膜的着色组合物、固化膜、滤色器及显示装置。着色组合物包含着色剂及具有脂环式环氧基的化合物，上述着色组合物在将其相对于波长445nm的光的吸光度设为1时，其相对于波长535nm的光的吸光度为17以上。

rows.title: Positioning device for thermal head
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable to accurately adjust a fitting position, by a method wherein a guide pin is passed through a through-hole of a base, is inserted into a guide hole of a thermal head, and a metallic fitting having the guide pin projected therefrom is positioned by moving along the major surface of the base. CONSTITUTION:First, the thermal head 2 is placed on a major surface 1a of the base 1, the guide pin 10 of the metallic fitting 11 is passed through the through- hole 6 of the base 1, is inserted into the guide hole 12 of the head 2, and the fitting 11 is affixed to a major surface 1b of the base 1. Next, screws 15, 15' are engaged into threaded holes 17, 17' of the fitting 11 to tentatively fix them, and an adjusting screw 14 is rotated to slide the fitting 11 on the major surface 1b through the large diameter through-holes 6, 7, 7', thereby moving the thermal head 2 to a predetermined position on the base 1. Then, the head 2 is fixed to the base 1 by the screws 15, 15', and the fitting 11 is fixed to the base 1 by a screw 18. Accordingly, fitting can be performed accurately and easily, fine positioning can be achieved, and the fitting position is prevented from being shifted.

The resin A is a polymer having 1X10<3>-2X10<4> wt. average mol. wt., contg. >=30wt.% units represented by formula I and having a prescribed polar group at one terminal of the principal chain. The resin B is a copolymer having >=3X10<4> wt. average mol. wt. and consisting of a macromonomer having a specified group at only one terminal of the principal chain of a polymer contg. one or more of units represented by formulae II, III and a monomer represented by formula IV. In the formulae I-IV, each of a1-a8 is H, halogen, etc., R1 is hydrocarbon, each of X0-X1 is -COO-, -OCO-, etc., each of Q0 and Q2 is 1-8C aliphatic group and Q1 is -CN, -CONH2, etc.

rows.abstract: 1,184,216. Photographic filter control devices. FUJI SHASHIN FILM K. K. Sept. 8, 1967 [Sept. 30, 1966], No.41166/67. Heading G2A. In a photographic camera, there is provided a control device to set filters of the camera lens system so as to take into account the spectral condition of the prevailing illumination and the spectral sensitivity of the film used. When a film cartridge, e.g. containing film suitable for use in tungsten lighting, is inserted switches (E, F) and (G, K) Fig.2, (not shown) of a selection switch 9 are closed. If the prevailing illumination is tungsten lighting, filters 1, 2 change the light intensity falling on to photoelectric elements 3, 4 causing an unbalance of the bridge circuit to which they belong, and thus causing switch 5<SP>1</SP> to take up the dotted line position. However, no current flows through the switch 9, so colour correction filters 13, 14 remains with grey filters N in front of the taking lens 11 and the photo-electric element 12 for exposure control. If the prevailing illunination is daylight, the light intensity falling on the photo-cells 3, 4 causes the switch 5<SP>1</SP> to take up the solid line position current then flows through the switch 9 causing a driving device 10 to shift the filters 13, 14 so that amber filters are in front of the lens 11 and element 12. For daylight film, switches (H, I) and (K, J) are closed. The photo-electric elements 3, 4 respond to daylight and tungsten lighting as before, but in this case no current flows through the selector switch 9 for daylight, and filters N are in front of the lens and element 12. Tungsten lighting causes the device 10 to shift the filters 13, 14 so that blue filters B are in front of the lens 11 and the element 12. The filters 13, 14 are biased so that when no current flows through the device 10, the central filter remains in the operative position.

rows.abstract: To furnish with an electrophotographic sensitizing body with excellent electrophotographic peculiarity. In the course of drying after coating, it has an under-coating layer which is hard to bring about failure caused by an outbreak of cracks, etc. There is neither fluctuation of electrification potential in the course of reiterating use, nor rise of residual electric potential. The under-coating layer built up on the conductive substrate is formed by zirconium chelate compound or zirconium alkoxide compound and silane coupling agent as raw material; it is characterized by having more than 25 mole % of organic residual radical among the under-coating layer against the raw material. The under-coating layer is made up of coating liquid obtained from (1) the zirconium chelate compound or the zirconium alkoxide compound and (2) the silane coupling agent, each or mixture of both having more than 50% hydrolysis in the organic solvent solution.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to set an original fixed on a film mount in an original cassette and to improve work for reading an image by demarcating a recessed part where the film mount is housed on a plate material for mounting and directly forming an aperture part for reading an original image. CONSTITUTION:The original cassette 100 is provided with a frame 106 formed in a nearly rectangular shape and the plate material 112 for mounting which is mounted to the rectangular aperture part 110 demarcated in the center part of the frame 106. A pair of nearly rectangular recessed parts 120 is provided on the plate material 112 for mounting and the film mount 130 is housed in the recessed part 120. In such a case, the rectangular aperture parts 120a is formed to penetrate at a position opposed to the original S for reading when the film mount is housed in the recessed part 120. The original S can be irradiated with reading light through the aperture part 120a. Since the original S is positioned and fixed in the original cassette 100 just by setting the film mount 130 in the recessed part, workablity is improved in the case of reading the image.

rows.abstract: The invention relates to an improved injection mould for hollow articles which have a base and an orifice, for example for glasses. The injection mould is, in this arrangement, formed by a fixed mould part and a movable core which also has a cooling channel. According to the invention, the cooling channel (11) is formed in the longitudinal direction of the core (1b) by a longitudinally divided basic bore (13), at least one rib (20, 20', 30, 31) being provided in the base region of the basic bore, essentially opposite the nozzle orifice (6) of the injection mould, parallel to the flow direction of the coolant in the core (1b), so that the basic bore (11) forming the cooling channel (13) extends to the vicinity of the front end face of the bore (1b) and the heat exchange between the core (1b) and coolant, and the mechanical strength of the end section (21) of the core (1b) can be improved. rows.title: Procede de developpement de materiau photographique couleur a halogenure d'argent
rows.abstract: Un procédé de développement de matériau photographique couleur à halogénure d'argent consiste à effectuer le développement couleur, à désargenter et à effectuer le rinçage à l'eau et/ou la stabilisation. Selon ce procédé, un matériau photosensible qui contient au moins une couche photographique à haute teneur en chlorure d'argent et au moins une couche photographique contenant une émulsion à dispersion simple, peut être rapidement développé à l'aide d'une soltuion de développement couleur contenant un composé à masse moléculaire élevée et soluble dans l'eau. Il est préférable que le poids de revêtement d'argent dans le matériau photographique décrit ci-dessus soit de 0,75 g/m2 au maximum, et que la solution de développement couleur contienne au moins 0,035 mol/l d'ions chlorure. Le développement rapide et continu permet de réduire de façon remarquable les variations des caractéristiques photographiques, en particulier la sensibilité et la gradation, de prévenir les inégalités de développement et d'empêcher la formation de dépôts sur la paroi du bac de développement.

rows.title: 超声波图像产生方法和超声波图像诊断装置
rows.abstract: 本发明提供一种可以快速判定折射的影响是否存在的超声波图像产生方法和超声波图像诊断装置，它们可以缩短用于测量或计算所花费的时间，可以用小的误差来执行测量或计算，且可以获得准确的局部音速值。在关注区域中设置格子，测量位于在超声波的扫描方向上的不同位置处的两个或更多格点的环境音速值作为初步音速测量，以及当所测量的环境音速值的最大值和最小值之间的差小于等于所述预定阈值时，执行计算格点上的局部音速值的主音速测量。

rows.title: Information recording medium
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a medium which shows excellent recording/reproducing performance, durability and special deterioration quality in the reproduction and can be produced at high productivity by forming a base layer in a manner that the number ratio of fluorine atoms to carbon atoms is smaller the interface layer on the side contacting the recording layer. CONSTITUTION:The information recording medium 1 consists of a substrate 2, base layer 3 on the substrate, and further a recording layer 4 on the base layer 3. The base layer 3 consists of fluororesin and formed in a manner that the number ratio (FA/CA) of fluorine atoms (FA) to carbon atoms (CA) in the interfacial part 3A of the base layer which is in contact with the recording layer 4 is smaller than the ratio (FB/CB) of fluorine atoms (FB) to carbon atoms (CB) in other parts 3B of the base layer. By this method, adhesion property to the recording layer 4 and heat resistance of the base layer can be improved. Thus, the obtd. medium shows excellent durability, recording/reproducing performance, and special deterioration quality in the reproduction and can be produced at high productivity.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To contrive the decreasing of the quantity of a processing liquid to be used and air oxidation, by providing an inserting member for forming a developing bath for allowing a photosensitive material to pass through, and a wrapping guide means of the photosensitive material provided on a bending part of the developing bath between a recessed part and a projecting part of the body. CONSTITUTION:The titled device is provided with a body 14 in which a recessed part 14E is formed, and a projecting part 24D for going into the recessed part 14E of this body 14, and between this recessed part 14E and the projecting part 24D, a rack 24 being an inserting member for forming a slender developing bath 28 for allowing a photosensitive material to pass through, and a roller 30 being a wrapping guide means of the photosensitive material P provided on a bending part of its developing bath 28. Accordingly, when the rack 24 is inserted into the recessed part 14E of the body 14, the developing bath 28 is formed between the projecting part 24D and the recessed part 14E of the rack 24, therefore, the photosensitive material P passes through the slender developing bath 28. In such a way, the quantity of a processing liquid to be used decreases, an atmospheric contact area of this processing liquid becomes small, and the air oxidation can be reduced.

rows.title: Silver halide photographic material
rows.abstract: There is provided a silver halide photographic material which comprises silver chloride or silver chlorobromide substantially free from silver iodide. The silver halide photographic material is excellent in rapid processability, low in fogging, and high in sensitivity and contrast.

rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  複数のサンプルを同時に保持するサンプルプ レートを容易かつ安価に作製する。
【解決手段】  透明基板２上に金属膜３を配し、該金属 膜３上に親水性の結合反応膜４を形成し、さらに、該結 合反応膜４上に疎水性のネガ型フォトレジスト５を配 し、所定のパターンのマスク７を用いてフォトレジスト ５を露光してその後現像することによって、フォトレジ スト５を所定のパターンにパターニングしてサンプルプ レート１を形成する。現像後に残ったフォトレジストか らなる疎水膜5Aと親水性の結合反応膜４とにより囲まれ た部分をサンプル保持部６とする。

rows.title: 画像処理装置およびガミュート調整方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  画像データの適切なガミュート圧縮方式を簡 易に指定できる画像処理装置を提供する。
【解決手段】  ディスプレイにオリジナル画像４０２ と、各種のガミュート圧縮方式による変換画像４０４ａ 〜４０４ｃと、混合比率スケール４０６とを表示した。 ユーザは、変換画像４０４ａ〜４０４ｃの何れかをマウ スでクリックすることにより、ユーザ調整画像４０３を 指定できる。さらに、混合比率スケール４０６をマウス でクリックすると、クリックされた箇所（点４０６ｐ） に応じて、変換画像４０４ａ〜４０４ｃが混合され、そ の結果がユーザ調整画像４０３に指定される。

rows.title: Device for processing photosensitive material
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of fur by a purifying device and to suppress the passage of washing water having a large degree of contamination through a filter and an adsorbent tank as well as to prolong the life of the filter and adsorbent. CONSTITUTION:This device 1 for processing the photosensitive material has a developing tank 2, a fixing tank 3, a washing tank 4, a squeezing section 7, and a drying section 8, and processes the exposed photosensitive material S by successively transporting the material by means of rollers 51 to 54, 71, 82. Further, the device 1 has a washing water supplying means 18 for supplying the washing water to the washing tank 4, a control means 10 for controlling the operation of the means 18, and the purifying device 9 having the filter 91, a UV rays ozone processing chamber 93 and the adsorbent tank 98. This device 1 detects the passage of the photosensitive material S by a sensor 19 and determines the processing quantity per unit time. The operating time of a pump 15 is prolonged to control the supply rate of the washing water to the washing tank 4 so as to increase this rate when the continuous processing is judged.

rows.title: Sprocket and film winding up device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To detect the charging of a shutter and the shifting of one frame of a film by mechanically detecting the movement of perforations with a sprocket. CONSTITUTION: The perforations 21 are alternately arrayed on a photographic film 15 at long and short pitches. Two teeth 25a and 25b are provided on the periphery 27 of the sprocket 26 at the short perforation pitch and the circumferential length of the periphery 27 is shorted than the shift length of one frame of the film 15. The teeth 25a and 25b are engaged with the perforations 21 by the shift of the film 15, the sprocket 26 is driven-rotated and after the engagement of two teeth is released, the sprocket 26 is driven by the friction of the periphery 27 and the film 15. Before the film 15 the shifted by one frame, the preceding tooth 25a is abutted on the film 15, to be stopped in an engagement standby position, so that the driven-rotation of the sprocket 26 is inhibited.

rows.abstract:

【目的】膜割れやダイリップ筋の発生を防止すると共 に、紙基体と耐水性樹脂層との密着性に優れた、高解像 力写真印画紙用支持体及びその製造方法を提供するこ と。

rows.abstract: 【課題】欠陥検出の精度を高めるとともに、生産性の低下を防止する。 【解決手段】受光ユニット１３を、ウェブ１１を正透過したレーザ光２４を遮光するマスク３７と、レーザ光２４の照射範囲内でウェブ１１の両側方に位置する標準板３９Ｌ，３９Ｒと、ウェブ１１や標準板３９Ｌ，３９Ｒを通った光を受光する受光器３０とで構成する。標準板３９Ｌ，３９Ｒに、レーザ光２４の走査線Ｌに対するマスク３７の中心線のずれに応じて走査線Ｌ上での幅が変化する形状のスリット穴４２，４３を形成する。スリット穴４２，４３を通過したレーザ光２４を受光器３０で検出した結果に基づき、走査線Ｌに対するマスクの中心線のずれが補正されるように、受光ユニット１３の姿勢を調整する。これにより、マスク３７の幅を極力細くして欠陥検出の精度を高めることができ、さらに、表面検査と並行してずれ補正を実施できるので生産性の低下が防止される。 【選択図】図１

rows.title: Liquid ejection recorder and manufacture thereof
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve energy efficiency by suppressing a parasitic resistance existing on the both ends of a heating section, to improve the reliability by making a structure to have the resistance to corrosion from a liquid and to reduce the cost. SOLUTION: A heating resistor section 31, an interbedded insulation film 36, a metallic pattern layer 38 and a surface protection film 41 are formed on an Si substrate in the above order. After that, the insulation film 36 and surface protection film 41 on a heating region of the heating resistor film 31 are removed by using a photolithography method and a dry-etching method to open a pit 8 and to make an opening. A liquid-resistance layer 40 is formed to cover at least the opening and to be extended beyond a portion of a bypass liquid passage 47. Further, only one resin layer 54 is formed thereon. The pit 8 of the resin layer 54 is made greater than the liquid-resistance layer 40 and the resin layer 54 at the bypass liquid passage 47 is removed, then a heating element substrate is formed.  The substrate is bonded with a liquid passage substrate which is formed independently, thereby forming a liquid ejection recorder.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To execute encoding with high efficiency without increasing a distortion quantity by executing variable length enooding with respect to a combination of each component obtained by a sum and difference conversion of an original picture element group and its forecasting conversion. CONSTITUTION:A sum component S0 and a difference component S1 of input picture element groups Uj1, Uj2 of a block Bij are calculated, forecasting error components DELTAS0, DELTAS1 are calculated by a forecasting converter 3, and also they are quantized adaptively. Its quantized forecasting error components DELTAS0, DELTAS1 are brought to variable encoding by an encoder 4, inputted to a buffer memory 5, and in case of an actual time processing, they are read out asynchronously from an input by a prescribed bit rate from the buffer memory 5 at the same time, and sent onto a trasmission line by adding a redundant code which is capable of correcting an error generated on the transmission line. Accordingly, deterioration of a reproducing picture is reduced, considering a high compression rate.

rows.title: Recording medium and method for regenerating the recording
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a high density recording medium performing high density recording and regeneration under vacuum using electron beam, charged particle beam or neutral particle beam, by forming a multilayer structure wherein atom layers comprising at least two kinds of elements different in a secondary electron discharge characteristic and not substantially forming an alloy mutually between adjacent atom layers are alternately stacked. CONSTITUTION:As at least two kinds of atom layers different in a secondary electron discharge characteristic, a first atom layer 2, a second atom layer 3, a first atom layer 4 and a second atom layer 5 are alternately repeatedly stacked on a support 1 to form a recording medium having a four-layered structure. Recording beam is allowed to irradiate this recording medium to remove a part of the second atom layer 5 being the uppermost layer to form a recording part 6. Regenerating beam is allowed to irradiate the surface of the recording medium having information recorded thereon and, by reading the difference between the discharge characteristic of the secondary electron discharged from the recording part 6a of the first atom layer 4 and that of the secondary electron discharged from the second atom layer 5 of the uppermost layer, the regeneration of the recorded information can be performed.

rows.title: Image exposing method using two-dimensional matrix type space optical modulator
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To remove the influence by the DC component in each pixel part by a method wherein counter-polar DC voltages are applied to every pixel part in the exposure of a photosensitive material by irradiating exposing lights, which are modulated at every pixel part arranged in a two-dimensional matrix-fashion by means of space optical modulator. SOLUTION: The light emitted from a light source 3 is focused by a condenser 4 and incident in a polarized light beam splitter (henceforth expressed as a PBS) 2. An S polarized light wave among these rays of light incident is reflected at the PBS 2 so as to be incident in a two-dimensional space optical modulator 1 in order to be reflected at pixel electrodes through a liquid crystal layer, resulting in being incident in the PBS 2 by passing through the liquid crystal layer again. At this time, only the P polarized light wave of the reflected light passes through the PBS 2 so as to form an image on a photosensitive material 7 through a projecting lens 6.  In this case, under the condition that the pixel parts are set for the predetermined time under an ON state, under which an exposing light is outputted, a DC voltage, the absolute value of which is nearly equal to that of an applied DC voltage and the polarity of which is opposite to that of the applied DC voltage, is applied during the period except the On state so as to remove the influence by the DC component in the pixel parts, to which the exposing light is applied during their exposure period.
