rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable an operator to set an adequate job mode and to prevent the occurrence of miscopy by judging whether the job mode is adequate or not after the detection of an original size, stopping a device once and displaying a warning message when inconsistency is judged to exist. SOLUTION: A copy mode managing and control means 76 judges consistency between a function selected by a magnification selecting key 63 or a paper tray selecting key 68, and an original size and the size of a housed paper when an automatic magnification selecting function or an automatic paper size selecting function is selected by the key 63 or the key 68. When the inconsistency is judged to exist, a message display part displays the existence of the inconsistency, and calls operator's attention. rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a ruled line image generator capable of high-speed processing by preparing raster image data to be sent out to a printer by synthesizing a letter pattern sent out of a font memory and ruled line image data into dot units. CONSTITUTION:Letter data stored in a font memory 20 and ruled line image data transferred from I/P port 60 and DMA controller 70 are each stored in image buffers 40-42 for every raster line correspondingly to the letter information CM and DT of a controller 10. In reading out data, said data are converted in PS converter 55 in a parallel serial manner and sent out to OR circuit 56 for one bit each. In the circuit 56, three outputs of said letter pattern and lateral and vertical ruled lines image are syntherized to prepare raster image data to be sent out to the printer. The printing of any ruled line can be made possible without the use of font for ruled lines.

rows.title: Nonlinear side band emphasis circuit
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To apply nonlinear emphasis to a side band component by inserting a nonlinear element to a negative feedback path of a differential input form and connecting a parallel resonance circuit between an inverting input terminal and a ground. CONSTITUTION:Diodes 2, 3 of antiparallel connection are used for the nonlinear element of a negative feedback system. Then, when the level of an input signal S is small, the output level is also small, the diodes 2, 3 go to a high-impedance state and no negative feedback gives effect on the gain. When the level of the input signal S is large, the output level is also large, the diodes 2, 3 to go a low- impedance state, resulting in that the negative feedback amount is increased and the gain is suppressed. This fact gives effects on the emphasis characteristic of the system depending on the parallel resonance circuit 7 and a series resistor 8, and the overall emphasis characteristic becomes the nonlinear side band emphasis characteristic with respect to the input signal level.

rows.title: Paper conveyor
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate the control of parts, by providing both feed rollers of the same construction upstream and downstream to a reading section or the like and providing both pinch rollers, one of which has a higher hardness than the feed rollers and the other of which has a lower hardness than the feed rollers. CONSTITUTION:A paper conveyor for a copying machine or the like comprises a first feed roller 2 and a first pinch roller 3 downstream to a reading section 1 and a second feed roller 4 and a second pinch roller 5 upstream to the reading section. Both the feed rollers 2, 4 are turned in directions of arrows through pulleys 7-9 and a toothed belt 10 by driving a motor 6 so that paper sent out from an automatic paper feeder 11 is conveyed rightward as to the drawing. The feed rollers 2, 4 have the same construction. The first pinch roller 3 has a lower hardness than the feed rollers 2, 4. The second pinch roller 5 has a higher hardness than the feed rollers 2, 4.

rows.title: Device for automatically changing magnetic disc pack
rows.abstract:
The device automatically changes a magnetic disc pack and is applicable to a reproducer in an electronic camera system wherein a subject is electronically still-photographed and recorded in a rotating magnetic disc, and the reproducing of an image is carried out by a television system or a printer. 
     In the device for automatically changing a magnetic disc pack according to the present invention, the magnetic disc packs are installed in a magazine in blocks of a plural number. The magazine as a whole is set in the device for automatic change and each of the magnetic disc packs is drawn out of the magazine in accordance with a reproduction order and set in a reproducing section.

rows.title: Slide type film take up mechanism
rows.abstract: A pinion is geared to an operating bar for film take-up and a locking pawl having a projection is fixed to the pinion for engagement with a step cam which is fixed to a film take-up shaft whereby sliding the operating bar in one direction will drive the film take-up shaft. A control lever having a projection is positioned to be rotated by engagement with the operating bar so that the projection thereof is positioned for engagement with the projection of the locking pawl to prevent a film take-up operation. A shutter lever is positioned to be rotated by engagement with the operating bar and then locked by a shutter release lever. The control lever may be reversely rotated to prevent engagement between the projection thereof and the projection of the locking pawl only by the rotation of the shutter lever by unlocking the shutter lever and the shutter release lever in a shutter release operation, so that the film will not be taken up even if the operating bar is slid into the camera body without a shutter release operation.

rows.title: Control method of data transmission for the multiplexing bus system network and wireless network
rows.abstract: An improved transmission control method for use in a network which includes a time division multiplexing channel and a contention control channel. At least one station and a central control unit are connected both to a contention control channel and a time division multiplexing (TDMA) channel. When a station starts a time division multiplexing session, it transmits an access request to the central control unit via the contention control channel. After the central control unit receives the access request, the station which transmitted the access request is included in the order of the time division multiplexing (TDMA). The central control unit repeatedly transmits a transmission permitting token to the station via the TDMA channel in accordance with the order of the time division multiplexing. The station which received the transmission permitting token transmits the data entity, if existing, to either the other station or the central control unit via the second communication channel, and also transmits a transmission terminating token to the central control unit via the second communication channel. When the central control unit receives the transmission terminating token, it transmits the transmission permitting token via the second communication channel to the next station in the order of the time division multiplexing.

rows.title: Nonlinear optical material
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a nonlinear optical material which is free from orientation relaxation and is subjected to electric field orientation by using a mixture composed of a high-polymer compd. simultaneously having both of nonlinear optical response groups and crosslinking reactable functional groups and a low-polymer compd. having specific pieces or above of crosslinking reactable functional groups. SOLUTION: This nonlinear optical material consists of the mixture composed of the high-polymer compd. simultaneously having both of at least one kind of the nonlinear optical response groups and the crosslinking reactable functional groups and the low-polymer compd. having at least one kind of >=4 pieces of the crosslinking reactable functional groups which may be the same or different from each other. The nonlinear optical response groups refer to the functional groups having one π electron conjugation system and simultaneously at least one kind of electron-donating groups and at least one kind of electron- withdrawing groups. The electrondonating groups refer to a substituent of Hammett's substituent constant σp<0 or σp<+> <0 and the electron-withdrawing groups refer to a substituent σp>0 or σp<+> >0.

rows.title: Web varnishing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make effective surface treatment on a comparatively short web by installing blades which grind off projections on the surface of a magnetic recording medium in the process of making contact with the surface thereof, on the outer peripheral surface of a roller arranged to cross the running direction of the recording medium at a right angle. CONSTITUTION:A roller 11 provided with blades 12 is arranged in a direction for crossing a web 8 at a right angle and enabling blades 12, 13 to make contact with the web 8. Even though the running speed of the web 8 is small, these blades 12 can have a large relative rotational speed in relation to the web 8 because of the peripheral speed caused by the rotation of the roller 11, and projections on a comparatively short web 8 less than several tens m can be ground off by these blade 12, and at the same time, any dust stuck on the surface of the web 8 can also be swept away.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a module to be installed in compliance with the object of its use by composing a multicolor process module and a single color process module individually and making each module freely attachable to/detachable from an image forming device regardless of the other module. SOLUTION: In the copy machine 1, a multicolor process module 10 and a single color process module 20 are constructed freely attachably to/detechably from the copy machine 1. There multicolor process module 10 and single color process module 20 can be individually conveyed out from the copy machine 1 respectively, by, for instance, opening an open/close door and totally drawing out cases 14, 23 via guide rails, and by holding them on the side rails and pushing them in, they can be respectively stored individually in the preset positions inside of the machine. And it is respectively possible to carry out the multicolor screen image formation only by means of the multicolor process module 10 and to carry out the single-color screen image formation only by means of the single color process module 20.

rows.abstract: The present invention provides an optical recording method, optical recording apparatus, optical reading method, and optical reading apparatus which are capable of high density recording an d high speed recording, and high speed reading. In recording, a recording light comprising a plurality of polarization distributions corresponding to the data information; is generated, and irradiated onto an optical recording medium to thereby record a plurality of polarization distributions of the recording light on the optical recording medium as photo-induced birefringence. In reading, a reading light having a uniform polarization distribution is irradiated onto the recording medium in which the data information has been recorded previously, and the polarization distribution of the transmitted light or reflected light in the optical recording medium is read as the polarization distribution of the reproducing light.

rows.title: Magnetic tape cassette and its actuating device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To set automatically a cassette in a miserasion preventing state for a switch when the cassette is taken out of a VTR by providing a miserasion preventing member which opens and closes an aperture at the outer circumference of the cassette in response to the shift of the switch material within a space. CONSTITUTION:A release bar 8 contains a hook part 9 at its tip and is energized downward by a spring 14 connected to the tip. Then a roll 11 touches the side wall of a cassette and is supported by a support member 12 which is fitted with a play into a slit 10. when a video cassette with which the recording is through is taken out of a VTR, a set button 13 is pushed before an ejecting operation. Thus the upper end of the bar 8 is pushed, and a hook part 9 of the bar 8 is hooked to a projected part 6 of a switch member 5. The button 13 is maintained in a state where the bar 8 is pushed, and then the cassette moves toward an arrow B of the figure 5 by an ejecting operation. As a result, the member 5 is slided toward the lower part of a space 4. Thus the cassette is set without having miserasion.

rows.title: Integrated ion selection electrode device
rows.abstract: An ion selection electrode device for measuring concentrations of predetermined ions such as in biological samples in which measuring electrodes are disposed on a planar substrate with their active heads lying within a circle of small radius. A small sample of a liquid to be measured is dropped on and spreads over the circle contacting each electrode. In a preferred embodiment, two sets of electrodes are provided around adjacent circles on a single substrate, one for the sample and the other for a standard reference fluid. A dam separates the two liquids but electrical contact therebetween is provided by a porous bridge.

rows.title: Recorder/reader for radiation picture information
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To execute tomography, reading and erasing successively and automatically by transferring a sheet between a sheet holding part and a reading/erasing part when the sheet holding part of a tomographic device is moved to a prescribed sheet delivering position. CONSTITUTION:A sheet 13 is held by a sheet holding part 14 of a tomographic device 1 and while moving the holding part 14 and a radiation source 11 relatively, tomography is executed. After ending the tomography, the holding part 14 is moved up to a sheet delivering position and connection ports 26, 144 are shielded by a light shielding pipe 5. Then, shutters 26, 144 are driven to open the connection ports 26, 144 and the sheet 13 is delivered to a sheet carrying means 21 of the reading/erasing device 2 by a sheet carrying means 145. The sheet 13 is carried in the arrow directions L1-L4, picture information of the sheet 13 is read out by a picture reading part 23 and the read sheet 13 is carried to an erasing part 24 in the arrow directions L5-L8 by a switchback carrier part 22c. Then, the sheet 13 is carried in the arrow directions L10-L11 and set up again on the photographing position of the sheet holding part 14.

rows.title: Lens driving device for camera
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a lens driving device in which spring repulsive force for removing backlash is not changed regardless of a lens position and in which a stepping motor can be used for driving a lens. CONSTITUTION:A lens supporting frame 64 moves in an optical axis direction in a lens barrel 29 through a guiding bar 66. A connection frame 78 is screwed to a lead screw 70, and the connection frame 78 is connected with the lens supporting frame 64. When the stepping motor 72 turns, the lead screw 70 rotates, and the lens supporting frame 64 moves with the connection frame 78. Since a spring 88 for removing the backlash is provided between the connection frame 78 and a spring bearing 86 screwed to the lead screw 70 and moves with the connection frame 78, the elastic force of the spring is not changed even when the lens position is changed. Consequently, the stepping motor whose rotational torque is small can be used for driving the lens.

rows.abstract: 細胞が培養される培養容器の全体から選択された複数の撮像領域を撮像することにより複数の画像を生成する撮像装置から取得した複数の画像に基づいて細胞の品質を評価する細胞品質評価装置であって、複数の画像の各々から特徴量を求め、特徴量の平均値を算出することにより、培養容器の全体に対する細胞の品質を推定する推定処理と、複数の画像における特徴量のばらつきと、複数の撮像領域の面積に関連する撮像情報とに基づいて、推定処理による品質の推定誤差を導出する導出処理と、推定誤差が許容範囲外である場合に、複数の撮像領域とは異なる少なくとも１つの再撮像領域について撮像装置に再撮像を行わせる撮像制御処理とを含む処理を実行する。

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obviate the occurrence of troubles and defects, such as projections, fine splits and recesses even in the case by grinding by using a grinding wheel, by injecting fluid under a specific pressure to a part or the entire part of the surface of the grinding wheel at the time of grinding. SOLUTION: The fluid is injected under the pressure of 1.0 to 30.0 to a part or the entire part of the grinding wheel surface at the time of grinding the surface of a metallic pipe substrate by the grinding wheel. Namely, grinding fluid is injected under the high pressure to the grinding wheel surface, by which the desorbed abrasive grains and metallic pipe grinding dust which are stuck on the surface of the grinding wheel are efficiently removed, the influence thereof at the time of grinding is eliminated and the projections, fine splits and recesses on the metallic pipe surface are eliminated. In such a case, the metallic pipe 10 is not fixed and is ground by the grinding wheel 12 while the metallic pipe is rotated under three-point contact by the grinding wheel 12, the adjusting grinding wheel 14 and a supporting blade 16.  At this time, only the supply of the grinding fluid of the relatively low pressure from a grinding fluid supplying port 18 is executed thus far and in this case, a device 20 for injecting the grinding fluid under the high pressure is added and the grinding fluid is positively applied under the middle pressure to the high pressure to the grinding wheel 12.

rows.title: Process for formation of base and light-sensitive material
rows.abstract:
A process for formation of a base, which comprises reacting an acetylide compound with a salt. The acetylide compound has the following formula: 
     
         (R--C.tbd.C--).sub.n M 
    
     wherein R is a monovalent group selected from the group consisting of an alkyl group, a cycloalkyl group, an alkenyl group, an alkynyl group, an aralkyl group, an aryl group and a heterocyclic group, each of which may have one or more substituent groups; M is an n-valent transition metal atom; and n is 1, 2 or 3. The salt is composed of an anion having an affinity for the transition metal (M) (the affinity of the anion for the transition metal is more than that of the acetylide anion (R--C.tbd.C⊖)), and a cation derived from one selected from the group consisting of an alkali metal, an alkaline earth metal, ammonia and an organic base. A light-sensitive material containing the acetylide compound and the salt is also disclosed.

rows.title: Compound to produce acid by irradiation with light
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a new compound useful for image-forming material, having high reactivity to light rays in a range of far ultraviolet light-visible light, producing an acid by light irradiation. CONSTITUTION:Compounds shown by formula I and formula II (R<1> is alkyl; R<2> and R<3> are H, alkyl, aryl, cyano or R<2> and R<3> are bonded to form ring; A is arylene, alkylene or alkenylene) such as 2-(9,10-dibutoxyanthracene-2- sulfonyloxy)imino-2-phenylacetonitrile. The compound shown by formula I is obtained by condensing a sulfonyl chloride shown by formula III with an oxime shown by formula IV in the presence of an acid eliminator (e.g. triethylamine). The compound shown by formula II is obtained by condensing the sulfonyl chloride shown by formula III with an N-hydroxyimide shown by formula V in the presence of an acid eliminator. rows.title: 画像処理装置
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  オーバープリント指定されている画像の有無 ないし画像を簡単にかつ的確に判断可能となるようにす る。
【解決手段】  プリントサーバでは、オーバープリント 警告機能が設定されいると、オーバープリント指定され ている画像の検出及び抽出を行う（ステップ１００〜１ ０４）。これにより、オーバープリント指定されている 画像を検出すると、クライアント端末に警告を発すると 共に、該当する画像が明確となるように、該当する画像 に対する画像処理及び印刷処理を設定する（ステップ１ ０６〜１１２）。これにより、プリンタから出力される 印刷物上でオーバープリント指定されている画像を的確 に判断することができる。

rows.title: Formation of original stencil for printing
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the fogging phenomenon of printing when a copy by electronic photograph method is used as a manuscript by using a manuscript formed by transferring toner images to a sheet having highly smooth surface and fixing them by hot hard rolls. CONSTITUTION:Toner images formed on a latent image carrier are transferred to a sheet having highly smooth surface, and the sheet is fixed by hot hard rolls to form a manuscript. A base paper for thermal process printing is put on the manuscript and exposed to flash light to form holes in the base paper to obtain an original stencil. By this method to fix dry toners by hot hard rolls to the sheet having highly smooth surface, the toners adhered to non-image portions are spread over the surface to reduce the height of the toners. The use of the original stencil formed of the sheet by thermal holding prevents the occurrence of fogging in printings because no hot holding occurs in non- image portions of the sheet.

rows.title: Ultraviolet/infrared ray absorbing film
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an ultraviolet/infrared ray shielding film which shields infrared rays, and shields ultraviolet rays up to 410 nm without spoiling the visible light permeability. SOLUTION: For this ultraviolet/infrared ray absorbing film, an ultraviolet/ infrared ray absorbing layer is provided on a transparent supporting body. In this case, the ultraviolet/infrared ray-absorbing layer contains a specified cyanin dye as an infrared ray-absorbing agent, and also, contains a fluorescent whitening agent. Then, the permeability for ultraviolet rays at 410 nm or lower of the ultraviolet/infrared ray-absorbing layer is 10% or lower.

rows.title: Speed calculation device and image forming apparatus
rows.abstract: The invention relates to a speed calculation apparatus and an image forming apparatus. A speed calculation device is provided. The generation component generates a plurality of pulse signals having different phases according to the rotation of the rotating body. The detection component detects a rise and a fall of respective pulses in the plurality of pulse signals generated by the generation component. Each time the detection component detects a rise or a fall, the duration calculation component calculates a total duration of the durations of a predetermined number of rise or fall detection intervals detected by the detection component prior to the current rise or fall. A speed calculation component calculates a speed related to rotation of the rotating body based on the total duration and a rotation angle of the rotating body corresponding to one pulse in the pulse signal.

Then, the lower end of the revolving shaft 6 rides on an edge 23a of a holding lever 23. rows.title: Method for processing silver halide photographic sensitive material
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make substantially replenishing amounts of a washing water and a replenishing water for diluting a fixer unnessary by using the part or whole of the exhausted solution of the puddle washing water for the diluting solution of a concentrated solution for photographic processing having fixing ability. CONSTITUTION:The part of whole of the exhausted solution of the puddle washing water is used for the diluting water of the concentrated solution for the photographic processing having the fixing ability. The puddle water washing means a system supplying the washing water by batch process in which the replenishing amount of a processing solution i substantially zero. And, the exhausted solution in the system means the solution in which the prescribed amount of the washing water (including a rinsing water) was supplied by batch process and has been used for the processing of photosensitive material until the max. allowable processing limit. The washing water is preferably given ability of preventing the growth of a mold. For said purpose, a fungicide such as an isothiazoline type, a benzoic acid and its derivative, etc., is used, or physical means such as UV ray irradiation and magnetic treatment is used. Thus, the discharge of the waste solution after water washing which has a large pollution load is obviated. The silver contg. in the waste solution can be recovered with high yield.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To process even a photographic film for which the processing data can not be used efficiently to print an image. SOLUTION: Magnetic information stored on a magnetic track of a negative film is read by a read head 19, and analyzed in a magnetic information analyzing part 130. After that, only the processing data is extracted corresponding to an image frame in an image processing data extract part 132. If there is no processing data corresponding to the image frame, a data miss detecting lamp 122 provided on a data processing keyboard 112 is lighted to inform an operator of the data miss. The processing data is input from a data processing instructing part 114 by designated key operation of the operator, and designated process is instructed to an image data processing part 136 of an image signal processing part 10 corresponding to the image data of an image frame.

rows.title: Photosensitive composition
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the developability of a photosensitive composition when the composition is developed with an aqueous alkali developer, by incorporating polyurethane having carboxyl groups and hydroxyl groups and/or nitrile groups. CONSTITUTION:This photosensitive composition contains a diazonium compound and polyurethane having carboxyl groups and hydroxyl groups and/or nitrile groups. The polyurethane may be obtd. by reacting a diisocyanate represented by formula I with a diol having a carboxyl group represented by formula II or III and by reacting part of carboxyl groups in the resulting reaction product with a halogen compound having a hydroxyl group and/or a nitrile group. In the formulae I-III, each of R1 and R3-R5 is bivalent aliphatic or aromatic hydrocarbon, R2 is H, alkyl or the like, and Ar is tervalent aromatic hydrocarbon. When the composition is developed with an alkaline developer after exposure, it has superior developability and gives a relief image having improved wear resistance, sensitizability and adhesion to the support.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To transfer data between a two-dimensional sensor unit and a controller or the like by a small-scale interface circuit using a cable composed of less signal lines by utilizing a blanking period and transmitting control signals from other equipment to a two-dimensional area sensor via a data line. SOLUTION: In an image system 10, a CCD camera unit 12 and a camera controller 16 are connected electrically by the cable 24 and the camera controller 16 and a personal computer 18 are also connected electrically by the cable 26. rows.abstract: 本発明の課題は、細胞移植治療等において細胞が放出するトロフィックファクタの量を増大させたトロフィックファクタ放出剤、および炎症疾患処置剤を提供することである。本発明によれば、生体親和性高分子ブロックと細胞とを含み、複数個の細胞間の隙間に複数個の生体親和性高分子ブロックが配置されている、細胞構造体を含む、トロフィックファクタ放出剤であって、上記生体親和性高分子ブロック一つの大きさが２０μｍ以上２００μｍ以下であり、上記細胞からトロフィックファクタが放出される、トロフィックファクタ放出剤が提供される。

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To extend the life of a contact charger without increasing the number of cleaning members even when the processing speed of image carriers is large by providing a contact charging member abutting to multiple image carriers, and simultaneously charging multiple image carriers with the contact charging member. SOLUTION: A common belt-like contact charger 2 arranged across four photoreceptor drums 1Y, 1M, 1C, 1K is kept in contact with the surfaces of the photoreceptor drums 1Y, 1M, 1C, 1K. The contact charging belt 8 of the contact charger 2 is stretched between a drive roll 9 and a support roll 10, and it is driven at the speed equal to the processing speed of the photoreceptor drum 1Y. The contact charging belt 8 is pressed to the surface of the photoreceptor drum 1Y by a contact charging belt feed roll 20 Y, and it is applied with the prescribed voltage by a charger power supply 7 to charge the surface of the photoreceptor drum 1Y to a prescribed potential.

rows.title: Image forming apparatus and image forming support apparatus
rows.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image forming apparatus and an image forming support apparatus capable of forming an image while unifying colors of an image part in the case that a plurality of image data include the image part such as a logo mark whose colors are to be unified.  <P>SOLUTION: A BEP apparatus 600 receives print data outputted from a DFE unit 500 and scan data outputted from a scanner unit 410. A GUI 80 displays an image of the print data and a user designates a part of a particular image such as the logo mark from the displayed image, and extracts the image part whose feature is coincident with that of the part of the designated image from the image represented by the scan data. In the case of the extraction, the image part whose shape is similar to that of the particular image and whose color difference is within a prescribed range (α or below) is extracted. Data of the extracted image part are corrected so as to have the same colors as those of the particular image of the print data. The print data and the scan data are composed after the correction and the image data obtained by the composition are outputted to the image forming apparatus 11.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

rows.title: Image-forming method using silver halide and polymerizable compound
rows.abstract: An image-forming method employs a light-sensitive material comprising a support and a light-sensitive layer provided thereon which contains a silver halide, a reduc­ing agent, an ethylenically unsaturated polymerizable compound and a specific development inhibitor precursor. The image-forming method comprises heat-developing the light-sensitive material after or simultaneously with imagewise exposure of the material so as to imagewise polymerize the polymerizable compound in the presence of a development inhibitor released from the precursor in the course of the heat development. The image-forming method may be also performed under such condition that a liquid such as water is contained in the light-sensitive layer of the light-sensitive material within the specific amount.

rows.title: Double sided recording and reproducing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an excellent head touch by generating negative pressure between a magnetic sheet and magnetic heads, sliding the respective magnetic heads and making them into contact with the both surfaces of the magnetic sheet while an elastic member is deformed. CONSTITUTION:Inclined and curved surfaces 38 and 39 formed so as to momentarily separate from the free rotating surface N of the magnetic sheet 12 as they proceed to the rotating direction of the magnetic sheet 12 are formed on the respective surfaces of the magnetic heads 15 and 14 respectively supported by supporting members 16 and 21 which are opposed to the magnetic sheet 12. Then, the negative pressure is generated between the magnetic sheet 12 and the inclined curved surfaces 38 and 39 with the rotation of the magnetic sheet 12 so that the surfaces 38 and 39 may be mutually sucked. Besides, a positive pressure generating type auxiliary plate 52 is provided to a fitting plate 31 and actuated so as to push the magnetic sheet 12 on the magnetic head 15 side with the rotation of the magnetic sheet 12. Thus, the magnetic heads and the magnetic sheet are surely slided and made into contact each other with extremely slight contact resistance and the excellent head touch is realized.

rows.title: Picture reader
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To simplify a power source constitution by making the title reader into a system in which equivalent capacity is set at a prescribed positive potential by means of the ON-operation of a resetting switch, discharging is executed according to irradiating light, and the residual potential is read. CONSTITUTION:The picture reader is equipped with an optical sensor 1, a resetting switching 3 to discharge the charge of the equivalent capacity, and a reading signal change-over switch 4 to read the potential of the equivalent capacity, grounds a terminal on a side opposite to the side to which the resetting switch 3 of the optical sensor 1 is connected, and connects the resetting switch 3 to the positive power source. That is, the optical sensor 1 is reversely biased by a ground potential and the action power source of a reading circuit chip, and the photoelectric current is applied when the light irradiates. Thus, the optical sensor is reversely biased by utilizing the positive power source used for the reading circuit chip.

rows.title: Lens inspection method and device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To surely detect a defect being present on the surface or inside a lens with a simple configuration. CONSTITUTION: A light source 11 speedily scans a spot-shaped inspection light 25 in a specified direction and is provided so that it can freely travel in a direction crossing the scanning direction of inspection light 25 by a light source traveling device 13. The inspection light 25 is applied to a lens surface 15a in parallel with a light axis 15b of the lens 15 and is applied to a light receiver 12 through the lens 15. A light receiver 12 is arranged on the light axis 15b of the lens 15 and a mask 27 for blocking the incidence of the inspection light 25 is provided at the center of a light reception surface 12a. The light receiver 12 photoelectrically detects the inspection light 25 being applied to the light reception surface 12a and transmits a photoelectric conversion signal in proportional to the intensity to a signal processing circuit 14.  The signal processing circuit 14 generates a defect signal when the signal level of the photoelectric conversion signal from the light receiver 12 exceeds a preset prescribed level.

rows.title: 画像記録装置
rows.abstract: 【課題】  画像記録中のカット記録紙への衝撃を小さく抑えながら、記録速度と後処理速度をそれぞれ独立に設定することが可能な画像処理装置を提供する。 【解決手段】  カット記録紙２２の撓みを規制するガイド位置と、カット記録紙の撓みを許容する解除位置との間で切り替え可能とされた可動ガイドを、第２露光搬送ローラ対２７とガイド搬送ローラ対２９との間に配置する。ガイド搬送ローラ対２９を、カット記録紙２２を挟持する挟持状態とカット記録紙２２の挟持を解除する解除状態との間で切り替え可能とする。画像記録中にカット記録紙２２の先端がガイド搬送ローラ対２９に達した場合に、ガイド搬送ローラ対２９を解除状態から挟持状態へと移行し、ガイド搬送ローラ対２９によるカット記録紙２２の搬送速度を減速し、次いで記録後搬送ローラ対２９の回転を加速して、カット記録紙２２の搬送を行う。 【選択図】        図６

rows.title: Information recording medium and method of optically recording information employing the same
rows.abstract: An information recording medium comprises a disc-shaped substrate provided with a concave groove of spiral form on the surface and a recording layer for optically recording and reproducing information by means of a laser beam which is provided on the substrate, and both corner portions and top portions of both side walls facing each other in the concave groove are radiused. The information recording medium may further compries an intermediate layer between the substrate and the recording layer. A method of optically recording information using the information recording medium is also disclosed.

rows.title: Sheet of accumulative fluorescent substance
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a special photography such as a dental panoramic photography by joinning a main sheet of an accumulative fluorescent substance to a dummy sheet part with a hinge and by folding back the dummy sheet part under the former sheet. CONSTITUTION:A sheet 1 of an accumulative fluorescent substance is constituted of a main sheet 2 having a layer of the accumulative fluorescent substance on its upper surface, a dummy sheet part 3 consisting of a resin or the like, and a hinge 4. A sheet size of the main sheet 2 combined with the dummy sheet 3 is the size that is possible for a reader device to read out, and a size of the main sheet itself is the size that is suitable for a special photography. Also in case of taking the special photograph, the dummy sheet part 3 is folded back to the rear side of the main sheet 2 as shown in a figure(b) and the photograph is taken after containing the sheet 1 in a cassette matching the size of the main sheet 2. Then, after taking the photography, the sheet 1 is takenout, the dummy sheet part 3 is spread on the same level plane as shown in the figure (a) and the spread sheet is contained in an ordinarily sized cassette. With this procedure, the sheet 1 can be read out by loading the sheet to an ordinary reading device.

rows.title: Ｉｃカードとその製造方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  本発明は、ゴミや水滴等が内部に侵入しない 構造を有するＩＣカードとその製造方法を提供すること を目的とする。
【構成】本発明におけるＩＣカードは、電子回路基板を 収納するカード状の本体と、外部より挿入される突起状 の接触子を受け入れ、前記電子回路基板の配線と接続す るメス型接続端子とを有し、前記メス型接続端子と前記 電子回路基板との間に前記電子回路基板を外部から遮断 する遮蔽部材を備えている。また、本発明によるＩＣカ ードの製造方法は、外部より挿入される突起状の接触子 を受け入れるメス型接続端子を電子回路基板に結合し、 該メス型接続端子を前記電子回路基板の配線と接続する 工程と、電子回路基板を容器部材内に収納してカード状 本体を組み立てる工程と、前記メス型接続端子と前記電 子回路基板との間の空間に前記メス型接続端子の少なく とも一部に設けた貫通孔より遮蔽部材を注入充填して前 記電子回路基板を外部に対し密閉する工程とを有する。

rows.title: Ic卡(一)
rows.abstract: 本創作係有關於一種IC卡(一)之新式樣，其主要途是與數位相機結合，作為記憶影像用的IC卡；由各圖觀之，該IC卡整體是一大致呈長矩形狀，但僅於下緣呈現較為平緩的圓弧狀造形，詳細而言，該IC卡在正面的左右兩側，分別設有一呈段差狀的階段部，藉此令之形成導條狀的構造，有助於針對欲結合的電子產品，例如數位相機等插入IC卡的便利性，此外更在該階段部的一側，形成由第5圖觀看時，呈ㄈ字形的缺口部；另外，更如第4圖所示，其主要是在正面的約二分之一處，形成開口向上的淺凹部，並在該淺凹部上嵌入一枚表面呈多數薄片狀的IC晶片，除此之外，正面的圓弧形下緣，並突設一道略呈綑矩形狀的淺凸條；再者，其背面大致為平面狀的設計，僅在上下方，各設一呈三角形及細長圓形的淺凹部，而整體的凹凸狀態則可經由第8圖的縱剖面圖，清楚明顯的觀察出詳細的凹凸深淺；綜上所述，本創作之整體造形上除了必要的功能性外，整體造形充分突顯出極力應用高科技產品，並透過設計者的巧思將之達到淋漓盡致的設計概念，實為一極富科技美感之獨特設計。

rows.title: Ic卡(五)
rows.abstract: 本創作係有關於一種IC卡(五)之新式樣，其主要途是與數位相機結合，作為記憶影像用的IC卡；由各圖觀之，該IC卡整體是一大致呈長矩形狀，但僅於下緣呈現較大的圓弧狀造形，詳細而言，該IC卡在正面的左右兩側，分別設有一呈段差狀的階段部，藉此令之形成導條狀的構造，有助於針對欲結合的電子產品，例如數位相機等插入IC卡的便利性，此外更在該階段部的一側，形成由第5圖觀看時，呈ㄈ字形的缺口部；另外，更如第4圖所示，其主要是在正面的約三分之二處，形成開口向上的淺凹部，並在該淺凹部上嵌入一枚表面呈多數薄片狀的 IC晶片，除此之外，正面的圓弧形下緣，並突設一道細長圓形的淺凸條；再者，其背面乃為平面狀的設計，而整體的凹凸狀態則可經由第8圖的縱剖面圖，清楚明顯的觀察出詳細的凹凸深淺；綜上所述，本創作之整體造形上除了必要的功能性外，整體造形充分突顯出極力應用高科技產品，並透過設計者的巧思將之達到淋漓盡致的設計概念，實為一極富科技美感之獨特設計。

rows.title: 碳粉匣
rows.abstract: 【物品用途】;本創作係關於一種新穎之碳粉匣。;【創作特點】;本創作為圓筒狀之碳粉匣，於該碳粉匣兩端部分中之一端部分具有手把及設於手把頂部之卡匣防脫部，而另一部分為與印表機相接合之接合部，包括有構造接合部、電接合部、及碳粉供給用接合部。又，該碳粉匣之本體部分具備有沿碳粉匣長邊方向延伸之導件。;本創作之碳粉匣如附圖所示，其整體外形式樣新穎美觀，為根據使用機能所作之最佳與最合理之設計，申請前未見於刊物亦未公開使用，符合新式樣專利要件。

rows.title: Scrapbook server, method of controlling same, and control program therefor
rows.abstract: A user accesses a scrapbook server using a computer and executes a simulation for creating a scrapbook by affixing part images such as photographic images and decorative images to an image of a paper mount utilizing a scrapbook image, which has been created by another person, on the display screen of the computer. A procedural manual in line with the simulation is created. The procedural manual and paper mount, photographs and decorations such as buttons and ribbons for actually creating the scrapbook are bundled into a package and the package is delivered to the user. The user accepts the package and, while viewing the manual and using the bundled paper mount and decorations, actually creates the scrapbook in the manner that was simulated. The creator is given points that differ depending upon how the scrapbook image was utilized.

rows.title: Silver halide photographic material
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a contrasty photographic material excellent in fog by continuing a metal complex containing one or more nitride ions. SOLUTION: In a photographic material having at least one silver halide emulsion layer on a support body, a metal complex containing one or more nitride ions is contained in the emulsion layer. The meal complex is formed of a metal selected from transition metals of the third group to the twelfth group of the periodic table. Preferably, it can be selected from metals of the fifth group of the tenth group such as vanadium, chromium, manganese or the like. One or more nitride ions (N<3-> ), preferably one ion, must be present in the compound. The metal complex containing the nitride ion is dissolved in water or a mixed solvent with a proper organic solvent mixable with water followed by adding.  It is preferably contained by being directly added into the reaction solution in the formation of silver halide grain, or added to a halide aqueous solution for forming the silver halide grain or a solution other than it during the grain formation.

rows.abstract:

rows.abstract: A non-aqueous dispersing agent comprising a graft copolymer is characterized in that monomer(s) to constitute the graft portion(s) of the graft copolymer is (are) at least one or more macromonomers each having a terminal polymerizable functional group and that the graft copolymer is substantially soluble in a high electric-resistance non-aqueous solvent having a dielectric constant of 3 or less and a volume specific resistance of 109  OMEGA cm of more. The dispersing agent may sufficiently disperse any of a colorant of pigment or dye, a fixing resin-coated colorant or a fixing resin itself by wet-dispersion, and it has an excellent storage stability. The agent is therefore useful in a liquid developer for electrostatic photography or in a liquid developer for preparing printing plates.

rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】銀よごれを生じることのないハロゲン化銀写真 感光材料の現像処理方法を提供することである。
【解決手段】メルカプトイミダゾピリジン化合物または メルカプトトリアゾロピリジン化合物の中から選ばれる 少なくとも１種の化合物を含有することを特徴とするハ ロゲン化銀写真感光材料用現像液。
【効果】本発明の化合物を用いることにより、写真性能 に影響を与えることなく優れた銀よごれ防止効果を得る ことができた。

【課題】  懸賞応募を行う際の作業を簡易化する懸賞応 募システムおよび懸賞応募方法を提供することを目的と する。
【解決手段】  懸賞応募者は、携帯電話機１０１に接続 されたバーコードリーダ１０２を用いて、懸賞対象商品 に貼り付けられたバーコードを読み取る。バーコードに 含まれるバーコード情報が読み取られると、携帯電話機 １０１は懸賞応募支援サーバ１０４にログインし、バー コード情報を送信する。懸賞応募支援サーバ１０４は、 受信したバーコード情報に含まれる懸賞ＩＤを基に、そ の懸賞ＩＤが示す懸賞管理サーバ１０５に、予め登録さ れていた懸賞に必要な情報およびバーコード情報を送信 する。該バーコード情報を受信した懸賞管理サーバ１０ ５は、該バーコード情報に含まれる商品識別情報を検出 し、その商品識別情報が懸賞応募に使用されていないと 判断した場合に限り、懸賞応募を受け付ける。

rows.abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a photosensitive composition with which it is possible to form a pattern having a small LCDU. A photosensitive composition according to the present invention contains a resin that has a repeating unit which is derived from a monomer containing an onium base that is composed of an anionic group and a cation. The acid dissociation constant of a compound that is obtained by replacing the cation with a proton in the monomer is -1.0 or less. The cation has a structure that is changeable by the action of an acid. When the cation before the structure is changed by the action of an acid is defined as a cation X, and the cation after the structure is changed by the action of the acid is defined as a cation Y, the integrated value of the molar absorption coefficients of the cation Y at wavelengths of 200-450 nm is larger than the integrated value of the molar absorption coefficients of the cation X at wavelengths of 200-450 nm, and the onium base that is composed of the anionic group and the cation Y generates an acid when irradiated with light having a wavelength of 200-450 nm.

rows.title: 樹脂被覆紙から紙基材を採取する方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【構成】  本発明は、紙基材両面に熱可塑性樹脂を被覆 コーティングした樹脂被覆紙に予め樹脂被覆層に紙基材 にまで貫通する穴をあけた後、該樹脂被覆紙を紙基材へ の浸透性を有する液に浸しつつ超音波照射すると共に、 更に、紙基材層と樹脂被覆層とを該液中で超音波照射し つつ分離する、樹脂被覆紙から紙基材を採取する方法で ある。
【効果】  本発明によれば、従来、経済的かつ有効に再 利用できなかった両面樹脂被覆紙から、樹脂層と紙基材 とを効率よく、連続的にかつ容易に剥離できるので、樹 脂被覆層と紙基材とをそれぞれ単独に回収でき、工業的 価値は極めて大きい。

rows.title: 樹脂被覆紙から紙基材を採取する方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【構成】  本発明の樹脂被覆紙から紙基材を採取する方 法は、紙基材両面に熱可塑性樹脂を被覆コーティングし た樹脂被覆紙において、少なくとも一方の樹脂被覆層に 紙基材に迄貫通する孔を穿ち、次いで紙基材への浸透性 を有するケトン類を前記孔より紙基材に浸透せしめた 後、紙基材層より樹脂被覆層を剥離することを特徴とす る。
【効果】  本発明によれば、今までに経済的かつ有効に 再利用できなかった両面樹脂被覆紙を効率よく、連続的 にかつ容易に剥離でき、樹脂被覆層と紙基材それぞれが 単独に回収できるので工業的価値は極めて大きい。

SOLUTION: This method for producing the ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid iron salt, comprising reacting ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid or its salt with an iron salt in a solvent, characterized by controlling the pH value of the reaction system to <=8. The obtained ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid iron salt is used as a bleaching agent for treating photographic photosensitive materials.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for manufacturing an ferric salt of ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid in which the byproduction of insoluble compounds is suppressed, and the ferric salt obtained by the method. SOLUTION: The method for manufacturing an ferric salt of ethylenediamine- N,N'-disuccinic acid in which the pH of the reaction system is controlled in the range of 0.6-4.4 when the ferric salt of ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid is manufactured by reacting ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid or its salt with an ferric salt in an aqueous solvent. Further, the obtained ferric salt of ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid is used as a bleaching agent for treating a photosensitive material.

rows.title: Handwriting support device
rows.abstract: This handwriting support device is provided with: a half mirror; an image display surface positioned at a mirror surface side of the half mirror; and a handwriting surface positioned to face the image display surface with the mirror surface of the half mirror interposed therebetween, wherein a virtual image of the image displayed on the image display surface is projected onto the handwriting surface. The handwriting device is provided with an image display control unit which allows a first image to be displayed on the image display surface, and which, when a real object is inserted on the handwriting surface, allows a non-display-processed image of the first image to be displayed on the image display surface, the non-display-processed image being obtained by non-display-processing at least a part of an area corresponding to a vertically projected area of the real object onto the handwriting surface. In the handwriting support device, as a virtual image of the non-display-processed image, an image that becomes non-displayed for only at least a part inside the vertically projected area of the real object is projected onto the handwriting surface.

rows.title: Autograph assisting device, autograph assisting method, and program
rows.abstract: Provided are an autograph assisting device, an autograph assisting method, and a program that reduce a sense of discomfort felt by a user to improve an autograph assistance function. The autograph assisting device is provided with: a beam splitter that is arranged with a space provided between the beam splitter and a writing surface, the beam splitter reflecting light from an image display surface so that a virtual image of an image displayed on the image display surface is visually recognizable on the writing surface opposing the image display surface, and allowing light from a writing surface side to pass therethrough so that the writing surface side is visually recognizable; and an image display control unit that performs control such that a first image including a plurality of image objects indicating write-down target regions is displayed on the image display surface, and, when a real object including a writing tool has been inserted into the space between the beam splitter and the writing surface, an image object among the plurality of image objects that overlaps the real object on the writing surface and does not overlap a tip end of the writing tool is hidden.

rows.title: 磁気記録媒体表面の有機化合物の分析方法、該方法を用いた磁気記録媒体の製造方法およびこれにより得られた磁気記録媒体
rows.abstract: 【課題】  磁気記録媒体表面に存在する有機化合物の量を、簡単かつ正確に分析可能な有機化合物の分析方法、走行耐久性、電磁変換特性等に優れた磁気記録媒体を、前記分析方法を用いて製造する方法、並びに該製造方法により得られた磁気記録媒体を提供すること。 【解決手段】  支持体上に少なくとも六方晶フェライト粉末および結合剤を含む塗布層を設けた塗布型磁気記録媒体の、前記塗布層表面に存在している有機化合物を分析する方法において、飛行時間型二次イオン質量分析計（ＴＯＦ−ＳＩＭＳ）を用い、前記塗布層表面に存在する有機化合物をフラグメント化し、有機化合物を分析する。この分析方法を含む工程を備えて磁気記録媒体を製造する。 【選択図】  なし

rows.title: 磁気記録媒体表面の脂肪酸エステルの分析方法および磁気記録媒体
rows.abstract: 【課題】  磁気記録媒体表面の脂肪酸エステルの量を、簡単かつ正確に分析可能な、脂肪酸エステルの分析方法を提供すること。また、該分析方法を用いて得られる、走行耐久性、電磁変換特性等に優れた磁気記録媒体を提供すること。 【解決手段】  支持体上に少なくとも無機粉体および結合剤を含む塗布層を設けた塗布型磁気記録媒体の、前記塗布層表面に存在する脂肪酸エステルを分析する方法において、フーリエ変換赤外分光光度計（ＦＴ−ＩＲ）を用い、前記脂肪酸エステルに固有の吸収波数を含む前記塗布層表面の全反射吸収（ＡＴＲ）スペクトルを測定する工程を有することを特徴とする脂肪酸エステルの分析方法と、該分析方法を利用して得られる磁気記録媒体。 【選択図】  なし

The external stimulus is heat or the irradiation of an active ray.

Method and device for measuring a degree of exhaustion of photographic processing solutions
rows.abstract: An exhaustion degree measuring board for measuring the fatigue of photographic processing solutions including a base member having at least one reference density window formed therein along with graduated scales corresponding to a control strip. The reference density windows have upper and lower portions with the upper portion being transparent for viewing the relevant part of the control strip and the lower part of at least one of the windows having a varying dot density. A center line with a reference mark is formed on the base for alignment with the control strip.

rows.abstract: A step tablet in which density steps of a definite shape, each density step having a specific optical density, form a series of decreasing or increasing densities, in which any two density steps contiguous to each other are disposed with a boundary space of a specific shape between the density steps.

rows.title: Step tablet
rows.abstract: A step tablet with which an amount of exposure or degree of exhaustion of a developing solution can very readily been determined. The step chart is composed of a number of rectangular patches of photosensitive material, arranged in an order of sensitivity. The respective part sufficiently coated with a rust preventive is assembled by a machine 18, but the heat resistant grease is injected by a grease injecting device 15 for the shaft hole which needs much heat resistant grease especially. rows.title: 洗浄処理液、着色画像の形成方法、カラーフィルターの製造方法、及び、カラーフィルター付きアレイ基板の製造方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  現像残渣等の汚れの洗浄除去性に優れ、表面 の平滑性、エッジ形状が良好で、解像度の高い着色画像 を形成可能な洗浄処理液等の提供。
【解決手段】  アルキルエーテル系界面活性剤及び塩基 性化合物を含有し、加圧条件下で被処理対象物に付与さ れることを特徴とする洗浄処理液である。加圧による圧 力が、０．０１〜１００ＭＰａである態様、加圧が、ブ ラシ、スポンジ及び液圧の少なくともいずれかの加圧手 段による態様、被処理対象物が、基板上に、少なくと も、感光層及び酸素遮断層を順次積層してなる態様等が 好ましい。

rows.title: Color television signal generator
rows.abstract: Disclosed is a color television signal generator which is capable of producing color television signals directly from an 8 mm-width color film to reproduce the colored images of the film on a home-use color television. The present generator uses a polygonal prism which is rotated in synchronous relation with the feeding of the film, thus assuring that the raster on the flying-spot scanner is in register with the frame of the film, no matter what the feeding speed of the film is. Also, the present generator includes a color reproduction compensator which functions to subtract green and blue contents from the red component color, thus reproducing the color image of the film on the home-use color television with high fidelity of color.

rows.title: Means for generating a signal capable of being used for reproduction of a multicoloured image by television
rows.abstract: 1392863 Colour television FUJI PHOTO FILM CO Ltd 20 Oct 1972 [22 Oct 1971 (3)] 48519/72 Heading H4F A colour film 136 is scanned by a flying spot scanner 130 having a screen formed either of vertical (for horizontal scanning), differently coloured phosphor stripes, or a white phosphor layer covered with one or more striped colour filters, the transmitted signals being detected by a photo-detector 138 to generate a colour television signal. In one embodiment (Figs. 2, 3, not shown), two striped colour filters are used having alternate cyan/transparent and yellow/ transparent stripes respectively at different repitition frequencies, band-pass filters being used to produce respective red and blue signals which are matrixed with the output of a low pass filter to produce a green signal. In alternative embodiments (Figs. 4-7, not shown), repeating red, green and blue filter stripes or phosphor stripes at the same repetition frequency are used, and black or white index stripes may be included to produce an index signal to demodulate the resulting chrominance signals at the correct phases to produce red, green and blue signals. A filter or phosphor layer may be used having repeating red, green and blue stripes in the correct relative widths and transmissions or luminescences to produce an NTSC colour signal directly in the output of the photodetector. Repeating red, magenta, blue, cyan, green and yellow stripes of the correct properties may alternatively be used. When the phosphor layer or filter is such that an NTSC signal is directly produced in the photo-detector output, the flying spot scanner screen also includes a sequence of black and white stripes at one side, the light from which is fed via light guide 149 directly to the photo-detector 138 (or a separate detector), to produce a burst signal at the colour carrier frequency, which is compared in frequency at 152 with the output of an oscillator 151, any difference in frequency being used to control the width of the raster generated by flying spot scanner 130 to correct the colour carrier frequency. A rotating polygonal prism 165 is used to ensure correct scanning of the film frames by scanner 130.

rows.abstract: １以上の防音セルを有する防音構造であって、その１以上の防音セルの各々が、孔部を持つ枠と、孔部を覆うように枠に固定された振動可能な膜と、膜に穿孔された１以上の貫通孔と、を備え、枠の孔部の両方の端部は、共に閉塞されておらず、枠と膜とが、同じ材質からなり、一体的に形成されていることにより、環境変化や経時に対する耐性が高まり安定した防音性を得ることができることに加え、枠への膜の均一接着、貼り付け等の製造上の問題も回避することができる防音構造、および防音構造の作製方法を提供する。

rows.abstract: ２次元平面内に配置され、枠、膜及び穴を含む開口部、又は枠、及び膜を備える１以上の防音セルを有する単層防音構造を積層してなる積層防音構造であって、単層防音構造は、防音セルの膜の第１固有振動周波数より低周波側に、防音セルの開口部に起因して定まり、かつ透過損失が極大となる遮蔽ピーク周波数を有し、単層防音構造の防音セル同士は積層されており、積層された一方及び他方の防音セルとは、枠、膜、及び開口部の少なくとも１つの条件が異なることにより、軽量で薄く、その穴の位置及び形状に依存することなく、遮音材としてのロバスト性が高く、かつ安定性があり、複数音の遮音、又は遮音の広帯域化を実現することができ、更に、目的通りの遮蔽周波数を得ることが可能な防音構造を提供する。

rows.abstract: 小型軽量で、音源に固有の高い周波数の騒音を複数の周波数で同時に消音できる防音構造体を提供する。   本発明の防音構造体は、互いに離間した状態で重ねられた複数の膜状部材と、剛体により構成され、複数の膜状部材をそれぞれ膜振動可能に支持する支持体と、複数の膜状部材のうち、隣り合う２つの膜状部材の間に挟まれている膜間空間と、複数の膜状部材のうち、支持体内において支持体の一端にある膜状部材と支持体の一端との間に形成された背面空間と、を有し、支持体の一端が閉じられた状態で、複数の膜状部材がそれぞれ膜振動することで吸音する。

rows.title: 防音構造体
rows.abstract: 音源に固有の周波数の音をより大きく消音することができる防音構造体を提供する。厚み方向に貫通する開口部を有する第一枠体と、開口部を覆い、振動可能に第一枠体に固定される膜状部材と、膜状部材の面内に、膜状部材の膜振動に追従可能に固定される、音波に共鳴する共鳴構造と、を有し、共鳴構造は、音波の入射側と音波の透過側とで粒子速度の位相が反転する、音波に対する単極子共鳴器として機能する共鳴周波数を有し、共鳴構造の共鳴周波数は、共鳴構造が共鳴しないとみなした場合における、共鳴構造を含む膜状部材の第一固有振動周波数での吸収率の周波数スペクトルの半値幅の範囲内にある。

rows.title: 防音構造体、防音パネル、及びルーバー
rows.abstract: より簡易で且つ小型の構造で、且つ、高い吸音性能を発揮する防音構造体、防音パネル、及びルーバーを提供する。   本発明の防音構造体、防音パネル、及びルーバーは、並べて配置された複数の流れ抵抗体を有し、複数の流れ抵抗体のうち、隣り合う２つの流れ抵抗体は、各々の厚み方向において互いに対向しており、複数の流れ抵抗体には、流れ抵抗が１５０Ｐａ・ｓ／ｍ以上、且つ２０５０Ｐａ・ｓ／ｍ以下である特定流れ抵抗体が２つ以上含まれており、特定流れ抵抗体の厚みは、１１ｍｍ未満であり、隣り合う特定流れ抵抗体同士の間には隙間が設けられており、隙間の各部分の厚みの平均値が０．６ｍｍ以上、且つ４０ｍｍ未満である。

Method and jig for cutting brittle plate
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve precision and yield by forming a specified kerf on one side of a brittle plate, placing a buffer plate thereon, placing a cutting jig consisting of a base plate in which a pattern groove including a specified form is formed and a sleeper on the opposite side and pressing the assembly. CONSTITUTION:A grid-shaped groove 1b, for example, is provided on one side of a brittle base plate 1a of glass, etc., having specified thickness and a columnar sleeper 1c of stainless steel, etc., is placed thereon to constitute a cutting jig 1. A first elastic film 2 of PE, etc., is placed on the jig 1, a brittle plate 3 with a kerf 3a provided thereon is placed on the film 2 so that the surface having the kerf 3a is placed on the opposite side of the surface abutting on the jig 1, and further the kerf 3a is confronted with the sleeper 1c. A second elastic film 4 of PE, etc., is placed on the surface of the plate 3 having the kerf 3a, a buffer plate 5 of acrylic resin, etc., is placed on the film 4. The brittle plate is placed between the upper and lower press jigs 6a and 6b, pressed and uniformly cut with good precision.

rows.title: Method for joining band-shaped metallic sheets
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce a joining time of the title band-shaped metallic sheets by cutting the superposed band-shaped metallic sheets in the specific angular range with respect to the width direction and then, welding a superposed part. CONSTITUTION:A joining device 16 is constituted of an abutting device 18 and a rolling device 20. Clamps 22 and 28, a cutter and welding equipment 26 are arranged respectively to the inside of the abutting device 18. The band- shaped metallic sheets 10 and 30 are clamped respectively by the clamps 22 and 28 and ends 30A and 30A are superposed on each other in the device 18. The superposed part 32 is then cut at >=5 deg. angle with respect to the width direction by the cutter 24 and the welding equipment 26 welds a weld zone 46. Further, the rolling device 20 executes rolling and the difference in level on the weld zone 46 is solved. Since the superposed surfaces of the band-shaped metallic sheets 10 and 30 are easily abutted on each other, the joining time of those is remarkably reduced.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide joining method and apparatus preventing breakage or rupture of a hoop-like metal plate by uniformly trimming both edges of the wide hoop-like metal plate. Further, this apparatus provides means 42 for trimming the end part of the wide hoop-like metal plate 22 in the hoop-like metal plates 10, 22 joining the different widths while corresponding to side edges of the narrow hoop-like metal plate 10 and means 59 for detecting side edge positions of the hoop-like metal plates 10, 22 and shifting the trimming means 42 so as to keep positional relation between the trimming means 42 pre-inputted based on the detected side edge positions and the side edges of the hoop-like metal plates 10, 22.

rows.title: Method and device for joining band-like metallic plate
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To decrease the generation of perforation of a junction by placing a band-like metallic plate end part on a step difference part of a back bar in which a step difference being equal to plate thickness of the band-like metallic plate is formed, superposing other metallic plate end part thereon by a minute quantity and welding and joining them. CONSTITUTION:Each end part of band-like metallic plates 10, 22 is superposed on each other by a minute quantity and welded and joined. In this case, a step difference part (step difference quantity l) being roughly equal to plate thickness of the band-like metallic plate 10 superposed to the lower side is formed in a back bar 31. Subsequently, an end part 10A of one band-like metallic plate 10 is placed thereon, an end part 22A of the other metallic pate 22 is superposed on this end part 10A by a minute quantity and each band-like metallic plate 10, 22 is welded and joined by an electrode 30A of a welding touch 30. In such a way, warp of the band-like metallic plate of the upper side can be prevented.

rows.title: Method and device for joining beltlike metallic sheets
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the occurrence of cracking of a welding starting end and to improve productivity by superposing or abutting beltlike metallic sheets on each other, fixing these by a couple of clamps provided at a specified interval to perform welding thereon and then, rolling a welded and joined part. CONSTITUTION:Since the beltlike metallic sheets 10 and 22 are superposed or abutted on each other and the respective metallic sheets 10 and 22 are fixed by the couple of clamps 26 and 28 provided at >=10mm interval, cracking does not occur on the welding starting end even when a joining part of the beltlike metallic sheets is welded at the welding speed of >=5m/min.

rows.title: Method for joining beltlike metal plates
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a joining part from fracturing and to improve the quality of the joining part by butt-welding beltlike metal plates to each other and afterward, rolling the joining part and further, as necessary, performing the trimming processing on both sides of the joining part. CONSTITUTION:A precutting device 18, welding equipment 24, a rolling device 32, an edge trimming device 36, etc., are arranged in order with respect to a beltlike metal plate 10. The beltlike metal plate 10 rewound from a roll 12 is conveyed to a joining device 16 and precut by the device 18. The beltlike metal plate 10 butted against a beltlike metal plate 22 are clamped by clamps 28 and 26 of the welding equipment 24 and welded to each other by a welding torch 30. Next, the rolling device 32 rolls the joining part 40 of the metal plates 10 and 22 by a roller 34 and as necessary, both ends 46 thereof are trimmed by a device 42. Since the joining strength increases, the joining part 40 is prevented from fracturing. As rolling and trimming are performed, the quality of the joining part 40 is improved.

rows.title: Joining method for striplike metal plate
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the joining strength of a welding junction part by arranging the end part of a striplike metal plate in opposition, providing an alloy filler metal to a joining part as well and rolling the joining part after welding the striplike metal plate. CONSTITUTION:The joining device 16 of a striplike metal plate is composed of a precut device 18, welding equipment 24 and rolling device 32. The striplike metal plate 12 rewound from a roll 12 is cut by the precut device 18 and abutted to the rear end part 22A of a preceding striplike metal plate 22. A filler metal 31 is formed by the metal composing metal plates 10, 22 and the alloy contg. the elements excepting it, arranged at the abutting part of the metal plates 10, 22 and the welding is executed. The welding junction part of the metal plate end parts 10A, 22A is rolled in the rolling device 32 to eliminate the step difference. The joining strength of the joining part is improved because the striplike metal plates 10, 22 are welded via the filler metal 31 and moreover the joining part is subjected to a rolling treatment.

rows.title: Joining device for band-shaped metallic sheet
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the strength at the center in the welded joint part of band-shaped metallic sheets and to prevent the burn-through at both ends of the joint part by forming respective recesses to the center of the opposite surfaces of the clamps of clamping members which press and fix the band-shaped metallic sheets. CONSTITUTION:The front end 10A of the succeeding band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the preceding band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are first cut by cutter blades 20, 20 of a precutting device 18. The front end 10A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are superposed slightly on the front surface of a back bar 31. Cylinders 29... are then extended and the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 26. The band-shaped metallic sheet 22 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 28. The slightly superposed parts of the band-shaped metallic sheets are then welded and joined by a welding torch 3. The recesses 26A and recesses 28A are formed in the central parts of the surfaces facing each other of the clamps 6 and the clamps 28 in this case and, therefore, the escape of the heat energy at the center of the band-shaped metallic sheets is suppressed in the parts of both the recesses 26A, 28A and the penetration of welding is well executed even at the center of the band-shaped metallic sheets.

rows.title: Device for joining band-shaped metallic sheet
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of holing and unwelded parts which are the cause for the degradation in the strength of the joint part of band-shaped metallic sheets by forming the pressing surfaces of clamping members which press the band-shaped metallic sheets as rough surfaces. CONSTITUTION:The front end 10A of the succeeding band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the preceding band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are first cut by cutter blades 20, 20 of a precutting device 18. The front end 10A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are superposed slightly on the front surface of a back bar 31. Cylinders 29,... are then extended and the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 26. The band-shaped metallic sheet 22 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 28. The slightly superposed parts of the band-shaped metallic sheets are then welded and joined by a welding torch 30. The bottom ends of the clamps 26 and the clamps 28 are formed as rough surfaces by knurling, etc., and, therefore, the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are surely held by the clamps 26 and 28. The set size of the superposed part does not change even if the ends of the metallic sheets 10 and 26 are expanded by the heat at the time of welding. The joining of the slightly superposed part by welding is, therefore, possible.

【解決手段】  容器の取出口に装着される装着円筒部２ ０の軸方向一端に、装着円筒部２０の内径Ｌ１よりも大 きな外径Ｌ２を有する固着円筒部２６が形成されてい る。複数のキャップ１０を装着円筒部２０の軸方向に並 べた状態で、固着円筒部２６が装着円筒部２０の内側に 入り込み、装着円筒部２０の内面２０Ａが固着円筒部２ ６の外面２６Ａに圧着する。複数のキャップ１０は隙間 なく軸方向に並び、さらに、１つのキャップ１０の装着 円筒部２０と、別のキャップ１０の固着円筒部２６とが 部分的に重なるので、少ないスペースで運搬や保管等が できる。軸方向両端以外のキャップ１０のパッキン１２ は、軸方向両側のキャップ１０によって保護され、脱落 や損傷が防止される。

rows.title: Probe assembly for ion activity measuring apparatus
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To measure ion activity in a solution with limited noise by spotting a solution to be inspected on an ion selective electrode while an impedance lowering means is provided near a probe for detecting the potential difference thereof. CONSTITUTION:A reference solution is spotted on the side A at one end of ion selective electrodes 3.1A and 3.1B, 3.2A and 3.2B and 3.3A and 3.3B while a solution to be inspected done on the side B at the other end thereof and connected with a bridge. Pairs of probes 11A and 11B, 12A a and 12B and 13A and 13B are brought into contact with the reference solution and a solution to be inspected on both sides of these electrodes and the potential difference is detected between the reference solution and the solution being inspected. A circuit board 15 as electric impedance lowering means is provided near the probes 11A, 11B-13A and 13B to amplify a potential difference signal. In this manner, Na, K and Cl ions are measured selectively separately with the electrodes 3.1A-3.3B, for instance. Thus, as the circuit board 15 is provided near the probes, ion activity in the solition can be measured at a high accuracy with limited noise.

rows.title: Measuring apparatus of ion activity
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To measure the ion activity with high accuracy, by providing >=1 pair of solid-state ion selective electrodes on the first supporting body and providing a bridge capable of migrating ions between the electrodes by cross-linking between a pair of said ion selective electrodes on the second supporting body and opposing and bringing both supporting bodies close to each other. CONSTITUTION:A pair of ion selective electrodes is provided on the first supporting body 60, and liquid storing parts 28, 29 for maintaining a standard solution and a sample liquid to be inspected on a imperforated hydrophobic layer are formed on the electrodes 10, 10' made of polyester, etc. On the other hand, holes 62, 63 fitting accurately to the parts 28, 29 are formed on a bridge 20 formed of a porous member on the body 61. The bodies 60 and 61 are engaged with e.g. a hinge 67 and a prescribed liquid is introduced into the parts 28, 29. Thereafter, the body 60 is brought into contact with the body 62 and the measurement of ion activity is performed by using an electrometer 51, etc. Different ion activities may be measured continuously by providing plural pairs of solid- state electrodes and the bridges to long-sized supporting bodies 60, 61 and drawing out of housings 68, 69. In this manner, many measurements are made possible quickly and accurately.

rows.title: Measurement of liquid
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To realize a highly accurate and short time measurement and secure a wide measuring range by making a fuzzy inference from the flow rate characteristics of an opening regulating valve for limiting the flow rate of a liquid and a measurement set value, determining the initial opening of the valve before the initiation of the measurement and conducting a fuzzy control on the basis of the actual measurement. CONSTITUTION:When a measurement setting value is given to a measurement controller 1, the initial opening of an opening regulating valve 6 is calculated by fuzzy inference from the flow rate characteristics of the valve 6 and a liquid flows out from a measuring tank 8 by an instruction from the controller 1. The actual weight value of a load cell 2 charges. The controller 1 measures the actual weight value from a gravimeter amplifier 3 at prescribed control periods and calculates a deviation between the measurement set value and the actual weight value and the quantity of temporal change in the deviation. When an observation resulting from the low-pass filter processing of those quantities is calculated, the inferential calculation of the opening of the valve 6 is conducted on the basis of a fuzzy rule. Thus, the valve 6 is controlled so as to take the suitable opening, the infection of a backlash or the like is absorbed and highly accurate measurement can be performed.

rows.title: Liquid weighing and mixing apparatus
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To perform a wide range of weighing within a short time with high accuracy, by a method wherein opening degree control valves are respectively provided to a plurality of supply containers while a liquid amount detector is provided to a liquid receiving container to control the opening degree control valves on the basis of an actually weighed value and a weighing set value. CONSTITUTION:For example, in a system for weighing and mixing two kinds of liquids, when a manufacturing condition is indicated to a weighing control apparatus 3, a weighing set value is set and valves 9, 19, 10 are changed over to a weighing system line. When a stopper valve 8 is opened and an opening degree control valve 7 is adjusted to a predetermined opening degree, the raw material of a tank 1 is transferred to a tank 2 and the wt. of the transferred raw material is detected by the load cell 4 of the tank 2 and the value thereof is fed back to the weighing control apparatus 3 through a load cell amplifier 5. The control apparatus 3 operates the deviation between the actual wt. value and the set value and the timewise change quantity of the deviation to issue a new opening degree order to the next control cycle. A tank 11 is also controlled in the same way.

rows.title: Liquid weighing and mixing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To weigh and mix plural raw liqs. by using a closed-loop weighing controller for changing the flow velocity of the liqs., and controlling the weighing controller based on fuzzy logic reasoning. CONSTITUTION:When two kinds of liqs. are weighed and mixed, for example, a weighing set value is set to the weighing controller 3. When the start of weighing is indicated, an opening adjusting valve 7 is controlled to the estimated opening by the weighing controller 3, and the flowing out of a raw material is started. In this case, the initial opening of the opening adjusting valve 7 is calculated from the flow rate characteristic of the valve and the weighing set value based on fuzzy logic reasoning. The raw material in a tank 1 is transferred to a tank 2, and the weight of the material is detected by a load cell 4 and fed back to the weighing controller 3. The opening is operated from the actual weight value by the weighing controller 3 based on fuzzy logic reasoning, and the appropriate opening of the valve is obtained in the succeeding control cycle. When the weighing deviation is reduced after the weighing is started, the opening of the opening adjusting valve 7 is reduced, and the weighing is discontinued when the opening is reduced to lower than a certain value. Weighing is switched to a tank 11, and weighing is carried out in the same way.

rows.title: Method and instrument for measuring ion activity
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To measure the activity of one kind or plural kinds of ions by using one measuring instrument, by respectively applying a reference liquid and a liquid to be inspected to the surfaces of the ion selection layers of at least a pair of sheet like ion selection electrodes separated electrically to each other. CONSTITUTION:Sheet like ion selection layers 115, liquid imparting parts for imparting a reference liquid and a liquid to be inspected to the surfaces of respective selection layers 115 and a bridge 19 for bringing both liquids to a mutually electrical continuity state are provided to the uppermost part. The electrodes 11a-11c are arranged so as to direct the selection layers 115 to the downside and the reference liquid and the liquid to be inspected imparted from above is once moved to the parts below the surfaces of the selection layers 115. Thereafter, said liquids are raised to the surface positions of the selection layers 115 from the surfaces of the selection layers 115 through liquid rising guide passages 15a-15c of which the top parts of the side walls are set apart so as to have a gap accompanying no generation of a capillary phenomenon to the surfaces of the selection layers 115 to impart both liquids to the surfaces of the selection layers 115. Subsequently, the potential difference between electrodes 11a-11c is measured in such a state that both liquids are brought to a mutually electrical continuity state by the bridge 19.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a measuring instrument which can be easily produced and can measure always exactly ionic activity by adhering the end edge of the ion selective electrode layer of an ion selecting electrode pair to the upper part of a supporting plate. CONSTITUTION:The measuring instrument is constituted of the ion selecting electrode pair 20 consisting of a pair of ion selecting electrodes 21, 22 disposed on the supporting plate 10 and a porous bridge 50 which conducts electrically the sample liquid and reference liquid spotted respectively to both electrodes 21, 22. The end edge of at least the ion selective electrode layer of the electrode pair 20 is adhered by an adhesive agent 30 to the upper part of the plate 10. The reference electrode and sample electrode arrive respectively at the electrodes 21 and 22 when the reference electrode having the known activity of ions and the sample liquid having the unknown activity are respectively spotted to spotting holes 41 and 42. On the other hand, the boundary faces of both liquids contact with each other to establish the electrical conduction therebetween the therefore the potential difference corresponding to the difference of the ionic activity between the reference liquid and the sample liquid is generated near the center of the bridge 50. The ionic activity in the sample liquid is calculated if the potential difference is measured.

rows.abstract: When determining an activity of particular predetermined ions in a sample liquid by use of a device for measuring ionic activity including a pair of ion-selective electrodes which are selectively responsive to particular predetermined ions, a pair of spotting holes through which a sample liquid and a reference liquid are respectively supplied to the ion-selective electrodes and a porous bridge which communicates the spotting holes with each other so as to permit the sample liquid and the reference liquid spotted to the spotting holes to electrically contact with each other, for instance, the sample liquid is first spotted to one of the spotting holes of the device for measuring ionic activity with a first spotting tool, and at least one of the first spotting tool and the device for measuring ionic activity is thereafter moved to remove the first spotting tool away from the device for measuring ionic activity. Then the reference liquid is spotted to the other spotting hole of the device for measuring ionic activity with a second spotting tool within a predetermined time after the sample liquid is spotted to the spotting hole.

rows.title: Method and element for dry analysis
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To analyze a substance to be inspected, simply, quickly and with high accuracy by the substitution and discharge reaction of the substance to be inspected (e.g. an antigen), a labeling specific binding substance (e.g. an antibody) and a weak affinity substance [e.g. a substance whose affinity is weaker than that of the antigen and which is bound to a specific binding substance (an antigen)] with a complex. SOLUTION: A weak affinity substance is immobilized to a detecting layer 14, a labeling specific binding substance is bound in advance to it, and a complex is formed. A water absorbing layer 12 is formed under the detecting layer. Only when a liquid sample which contains substance to be inspected is inspected, a substitution and discharge reaction progresses inside the detecting layer, and the discharged labeling specific binding substance is moved to the water absorbing layer so as to be removed due to the diffusion and the movement of the liquid sample inside this analytical element. As a result, a cleaning operation or the like is not required. The amount of the labeling specific binding substance which is left in the detecting layer according to the amount of the substance to be inspected can be measured easily on the basis of the absorption of labeling coloring particles.  Also the amount of the labeling specific binding substance which is shifted to the water absorbing layer can be detected. Since the substance to be inspected is analyzed by the dry analytical element, it can deal easily with a small measuring apparatus.

rows.title: Simple checking jig for analyzer for measuring ion activity
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To permit simple checking of whether an analyzer for measuring ion activity is normal or not by use of a checking jig by providing a conductor (metallic plate) between two sheets of supports, thereby constituting the checking jib. CONSTITUTION:A slide provided with an ion selective electrode or the like is mounted on the analyzer for measuring the ion activity and measurement is made at the time of measuring the ion activity. The checking jib 1 is mounted in place of the slide on the analyzer in order to check the normal condition of said analyzer. The jig 1 is formed to the same outside dimensions as the outside dimensions of the slide and constituted by providing an upper mount 2 and a lower mount 3 as the supports and fixing the metallic plate 4 therebetween. Probes for measuring a potential difference are raised and penetrated through holes 3a-3f of the lower mount 3 and are brought into contact with the plate 4 to short circuit the plate. The short circuited potential difference between the probes decreases to zero if an electric circuit is normal at this time. Since the zero potential difference between the probes is detected by the checking jib, the simple checking of whether the analyzer is normal or not is permitted.

As a result, because potential difference corresponding to the difference between ion activities of Na<+> and K<+> between the reference solution and the specimen solution is respectively generated not only between electrodes 211, 211 but also between electrodes 212, 222, measuring probes are inserted in measuring probe insert holes 461, 462, 471, 472 to be contacted with the electrodes to measure potential difference.
