rows.title: Ion activity measuring instrument
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable accurate measurement, by providing liquid supply holes respectively communicated with the electrodes of an ion selection electrode pair while providing liquid dripping parts respectively communicated with said liquid supply holes. CONSTITUTION:It is assumed that an ion selection electrode pair 20 responds to certain specific ions and, if a reference solution, of which the ion activity is known, is dripped to a liquid dripping part 53 and a specimen solution, of which the ion activity is unknown, is dripped to a liquid dripping part 54, the reference solution is supplied to a liquid supply hole 31 and the specimen solution to a liquid supply hole 32. The interface of the reference solution and the specimen solution is communicated with a porous bridge 60 in the vicinity of the center thereof. As a result, because potential difference corresponding to the ion activities between the reference solution and the specimen solution is generated between the ion selection electrodes 21, 22, measuring probes are inserted in measuring probe insert holes 56, 57 to be contacted with both electrodes and the ion activity in the specimen solution can be measured.

rows.title: Ion activity measuring apparatus
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten the arrival time of a liquid at an electrode surface, by sticking at least one of the ends of a distribution member downwared below a liquid supply port to permeate the liquid from the side of the end. CONSTITUTION:When, for example, three types of reference liquids each with the known ion activity spotted at liquid spotting hole 510 and a sample liquid is spotted at a liquid spotting hole 520, the reference liquids permeate into porous liquid distributing members 410A and 410B to be distributed into liquid receiving holes 311-313 while the sample liquid permeates into porous liquid distributing members 420A and 420B to be distributed into liquid receiving holes 321-323. Here, as the members 410A and 410B are separated with a clearance 430 while the members 420A and 420B are done with a clearance 440, the liquid are fed to end faces of the members through these clearances. After the distribution of the liquids into respective liquid receiving holes, potential differences which will be generated due to differences of ion activities between ion selection electrodes 211 and 221, 212 and 222 and 213 and 233 is measured. This can shorten the arrival time of the liquids at the electrode surface thereby eliminating the possibility of hemolysis of the whole blood sample liquid.

rows.title: Simple inspection device for analyzer for ionic activity measurement
rows.abstract: A simple inspection device is constituted for inspection of an analyzer for measuring ionic activity by using an ionic activity measuring device provided with at least one ion selective electrode pair for generating an electrical potential corresponding to ionic activity of a predetermined ion, and a porous bridge for associating the electrodes of the ion selective electrode pair with each other, and by contacting potential difference measuring probes respectively with the electrodes of the ion selective electrode pair, to thereby measure a difference in potential between the electrodes. The simple inspection device employs a supporting member having outer dimensions approximately equal to the outer dimensions of the ionic activity measuring device, and an electrically conductive member supported on the supporting member for short-circuiting across the potential difference measuring probes when the potential difference measuring probes are contacted with the electrically conductive member.

rows.title: Method and apparatus for measuring, mixing and distributing liquid
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To realize an improvement of measurement accuracy, an enlarge ment of measurement range, and a shortening and fixing of measurement time by carrying out a fuzzy inference etc., based on observed values obtained in the course of measurement and by varying sequentially a flow rate of a liquid to be measured with a special flow rate control valve. CONSTITUTION:In a closed loop control method for measurement of a liquid, a fuzzy control, a learning control or an optimal control of a liquid to be measured with a flow rate control valve 7 is carried out based on observed values of deviations and their differentials with respect to time between measurement values set arbitrarily beforehand and those really measured with measurement sensors 4 weighing the liquid. As the flow rate control valve 7, a control valve driven by a motor 11, which has a property of small and linear flow rate change with respect to a valve lift and, furthermore, a large maximum allowable flow rate, is used. It becomes possible, as a results, to shorten a measurement time while keeping an accuracy of measurement and to carry out a wide range measurement without being influenced by flow rate fluctuations due to disturbances.

rows.abstract: 本发明的课题在于提供一种准确地求出稀释倍率并进行成分的定量分析的血液分析方法及血液检查试剂盒。根据本发明，血液分析方法包括：用稀释液来稀释所采集的血液样本的工序；使用恒久性地存在于血液中的标准成分的标准值来确定稀释倍率的工序；分析血液样本中的对象成分的浓度的工序，血液分析方法是使用选自包括第1容纳器具，容纳有稀释液；分离器具，用于从用所述稀释液稀释后的血液样本中分离并回收血浆；保持器具，用于保持所述分离器具；第2容纳器具，用于容纳所回收的血浆；及密封器具，用于将所收容的血浆维持在第2容纳器具内的组中的部件的血液分析方法，稀释液是将源于稀释液及/或部件的可包含于稀释液中的标准成分的量进行了规定的稀释液，血液样本的容量为50μL以下，血液样本中的血浆成分的稀释倍率为14倍以上。

rows.title: Evaluation method of test substance
rows.abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing an evaluation method of a test substance using an M cell model similar to M cells in a living human body. Provided is an evaluation method of a test substance, the method including: preparing intestinal epithelial cells containing M cells from intestinal stem cells induced from induced pluripotent stem cells; co-culturing lymphocytes with the intestinal epithelial cells containing the M cells; bringing the M cells into contact with the test substance having a diameter of 0.3 μm or greater; and evaluating the uptake of the test substance by the M cells and discharge of the same from the M cells.

rows.title: Multilayer analytical element for analyzing whole blood sample
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To achieve easy processing at the time of preparation and to enhance the reproducibility of the measured value of an analyte by partially bonding a detection function layer containing one or more reagent layer to glass fiber filter paper. CONSTITUTION:Glass fiber filter paper and a detection function layer are partially bonded. This glass fiber filter paper has high blood corpuscle/plasma separation function separating whole blood into a blood corpuscle and plasma. The detection function layer is composed of at least one reagent layer or said layer and a detection layer. The reagent layer is composed of a water permeable layer of a hydrophilic polymer binder containing a composition capable of generating color development or a color change or a change in the absorption wavelength of an ultraviolet region capable of being optically detected in the presence of a component to be examined or a porous layer containing a reagent composition. In the detection layer, the dye formed in the presence of the component to be examined is diffused and optically detected through a transparent support. This analytical element is integrated in a closely bonded state by the adhesive arranged partially between interfaces.

rows.title: Integral multilayer analytical element for urea analysis
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To carry out an urea analysis in high accuracy by laminating an absorbing layer, color reagent layer, porous developing layer on a light- permeable and water-impermeable support and containing ascorbic acid oxidase on upper side than the color layer. CONSTITUTION:An absorbing layer containing a hydrophilic polymer is provided on a light-permeable and water-impermeable support such as polyethylene terephthalate and polystyrene. Further, a color reagent layer dispersing and containing an uricase-containing color reagent composition in a hydrophilic polymer binder and porous developing layer consisting of a fibrous developing layer, etc., are bonded and laminated one after another on the absorbing layer. Moreover, a light-shielding layer, adhesive layer, etc., are provided between the color reagent layer and developing layer and ascorbic acid oxidase is contained in either one or more layers on upper side than the color reagent layer e.g. in the light-shielding layer, adhesive layer, etc., over the range of about >=5mum thickness.

rows.title: Dry glucose-analyzing element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a dry glucose-analyzing element capable of quantitatively analyzing glucose in a high accuracy up to a high concentration region of the glucose by adding specific components to a reagent layer and an enzyme- containing layer, respectively, disposed on a support and using a special material in a light-shielding layer. CONSTITUTION:A reagent layer, enzyme-containing layer, light-shielding layer and porous developing layer, all being water-permeable, are laminated in this order to a water and light-impermeable support. At least a coupler among a hydrogen peroxide-detecting coloring composition comprising a hydrogen donor and the couple is added to the reagent layer and gluxose oxidase, peroxidase and a mordant are added to the enzyme-containing layer. An oxygen- permeable and protein-impermeable material is used for the light-shielding layer. It is preferable that the light-shielding layer is a non-porous layer wherein titanium dioxide fine powder having a light-shielding property and a light- reflecting property are bonded with a hydrophilic polymer haivng a little film formability.

rows.title: Dry immunity analyzing element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain high analyzing sensitivity and accuracy in quantitative analysis, by a constitution wherein at least two water permeability layers form a unitary body, at least one of the water permeability layers is a porous layer, and components related to the reaction of antigen/antibody are added in the water permeability layers. CONSTITUTION:An element comprises at least two water permeability layers which form a unitary body. At least one of the water permeability layers is a porous layer. Components related to the reaction of antigen/antibody are added in the water permeability layers. One of the components related to the antigen/antibody is the labelled antigen. The other is the antibody for the non- labelled antigen and the labelled antigen. The labelled antigen is incorporated in the porous layer until the time when liquid to be checked comes to contact. The porous layer does not have the antibody substantially. The antibody is incorporated in the second water permeability layer which is located at a position separated remotely from the surface that receives liquid of the analyzing element from the porous layer. Said second layer does not incorporate the labelled antigen substantially. In this way, high analyzing sensitivity and the accuracy in quantitative analysis can be maintained.

rows.title: Dry type analysis element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To determine hydrogen peroxide with high sensitivity by using the imidazole deriv. expressed by specific formula as a color forming component. CONSTITUTION:A coating liquid for a reagent layer contg. uricase, the compd. expressed by formula, and peroxidase is coated on a colorless transparent polyethylene terephthalate film having an under coating layer of gelatin and is dried. The reagent layer is then moistened with water and a cellulose acetate membrane filter is laminated and integrated as a porous developing layer thereon to prepare a multi-layered chemical analysis element for determination of uric acid. A sample is spotted onto the porous developing layer of such analysis element and the reflected light is measured at about 670nm from the polyethylene terephthalate film side to determine the concn. of the uric acid. Since the compd. expressed by formula is extremely stable as chromogen, the measurement with the high accuracy is permitted.

rows.title: Integration type multi-layer analysis element for determining ammonia product
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To analyze an ammonia product at a high sensitivity, by providing an ammonia diffusion preventing layer between an endogenous ammonia trapping layer to trap ammonia existing in a liquid reagent and an ammonia product reaction reagent layer. CONSTITUTION:A gaseous ammonia indicator layer (b) and a gaseous ammonia transmission layer (c) are provided on a support (a). An ammonia production reaction reagent (d) is provided on the layer and made to react with an ammonia product (creatine, urea or the like) to form a gaseous ammonia. An ammonia diffusion preventing layer (polymer binder or the like) (e) is provided on the layer to prevent ammonia generated in the layer (d) from diffusing to an endogenous ammonia trapping layer (f) provided thereon. The endogenous ammonia trapping layer (f) traps ammonia present in a water liquid. Thus, the diffusion preventing layer (e) arranged prevents ammonia from diffusing upward, thereby enabling analysis of creatine, urea the like at a high accuracy.

rows.title: Integrated type multilayer analytical element for measuring gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To carry out measurement with a high accuracy, by incorporating a cationic surfactant and nonionic surfactant and hydrophilic polymer in a porous development layer in an analytical element containing the porous development layer, containing a substrate and laminated to water absorbing layer and support layer. CONSTITUTION:A water absorbing layer containing a hydrophilic polymer as a layer-forming component is provided on a light-transmitting and water- impermeable support consisting of a polymer, e.g. polyethylene terephthalate, polystyrene, cellulose ester, etc. A matrix containing filter paper, nonwoven fabic or woven fabric cloth, etc. as a material is laminated on the resultant layer, and a substrate sensitive to gamma-glutamyltransferase and exhibiting the self-developing property and gamma-glutamyl-p-nitranilide, etc., are contained in the above-mentioned development layer. A cationic surfactant, nonionic surfactant and hydrophilic polymer in respective specific amounts are further contained to give the aimed element for measuring gamma-glutamyltransferase activity.

rows.title: Integrated-type multi-layer analyzing element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a high-sensitive integrated type multi-layer analyzing element available for quick, easily operatable and high-accuracy analysis of an ammonium producing substance in bodyily liquid, by installing an air barrier layer permitting passage of gaseous ammonia only between indicating chemical layer and reagent layer. CONSTITUTION:An air barrier layer set on an indicating chemical layer is composed of continuous air gap structured porous substance of mutually entangled, bonded or connected fibrous substance and on the occasion of analyzing operations, etc., it does not permit passage of aqueous water and that containing as solved an inhibitory agent, such as alkali substance, permitting only gaseous ammonia. And, a reagent layer is set on said air barrier layer and further, a porous developping layer on said reagent layer. The main integrated multi-layer analyzing element being provided with the air barrier layer, a dispersion velocity of ammonia gas is high and consequently, measurement time can be remarkably reduced as compared with the case of the conventional element and accuracy can be highly improved also.

rows.title: Integral multilayer analysis element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a quick quantitative analysis of various components to be inspected in a chemical emission analysis by dry operation, by laminating a diffusive layer, a chemical emission reagent layer and a water non-permeable support integral in this order to form a multilayer analysis element. CONSTITUTION:In this multilayer analysis element, a diffusive layer which is adapted to diffuse components to be inspected in a liquid sample into a chemical emission reagent layer before chemical emission reaction starts in substance, a chemical emission reagent layer containing a polymer binder which is swelled by chemical emission reaction reagent composition and water or water-soluble and a water non-permeable support allowed to transmit light at least in a wavelength range of chemical emission are laminated integrally in this order. With such an arrangement, an angular drop spotted is diffused sideways along the surface of the diffusive layer and brought into contact with the chemical emission reagent layer. This enables the participation in the chemical emission analysis reaction of the sample spotted in substance entirely in a short time, and thus emission takes place evenly to elevate the measuring accuracy significantly.

rows.title: Monolithic multilayer analytical element for analyzing calcium
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To quantify calcium with high accuracy by excluding the effect of protein, in a monolithic multilayer analytical element wherein a reagent layer containing at least one kind of an indicator and a porous developing layer are provided on a light pervious and water impervious support in this order, by containing polyhydric alcohol in at least one layer above the reagent layer. CONSTITUTION:As the light pervious and water impervious support of a multilayer analytical element, a transparent planar support having a smooth surface composed of a polymer, for example, polyethylene terephthalate is used. Next, gelation (deionized gelatin) is most pref. used in a reagent layer and o-cresol phthalein is pref. as an indicator from such a viewpoint that the most accurate quantitative analysis of total calcium is possible. As a porous developing layer, a fabric developing layer is used. As polyhydric alcohol contained in at least one layer above the reagent layer, the effect of hexahydric alcohol or pentose is high and, as polyhydric alcohol fatty acid ester, sorbitol monolaurate is pref.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a one-piece type multilayer analysis element with a porous development layer whose film thickness is thin and has an improved development operation. CONSTITUTION:In a one-piece multilayer analysis element where a water- absorption layer 12 or a reagent layer and a porous development layer 14 including a hydrophilic polymer binder are laminated in one-piece on a water- impermeability support 10, the development layer 14 is constituted by a fine porous layer which consists of a polymer containing fluorine and further an interface activator is contained in this development layer 14, thus obtaining a rapid development time and a uniform analysis result. Also, an improved globule/plasma separation function is provided, which is suited for analysis of a whole blood sample.

rows.title: Multilayer chemical analysis element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance accuracy in analysis, by including the fine powder of titanium dioxide, which has not undergone specified surface treatment, in a light shielding layer on a reagent layer, thereby eliminating errors caused by the interfering action of a fluoride. CONSTITUTION:A reagent layer, a light shielding layer, and a porous developing layer are provided in this order on a supporting body having water impermeability and light transmitting property such as a transparent polymer sheet characterized by poor hydrophilic property such as cellulose acetate. The reagent layer is prepared by including a hydrogen peroxide indicator, which yields the change that can be detected under the presence of peroxidase and hydrogen peroxide, peroxidase, and oxidase in a polymer binder. The fine powder of titanium dioxide, which has not undergone surface treatment including aluminum oxide or the hydrated oxide of aluminum, or the fine powder of titanium dioxide, which has not undergone surface treatment, is included in the light shielding layer characterized by oxygen permeability and protein impermeability on the reagent layer. Thus interference by fluoride can be eliminated.

rows.title: Analysis element used in measurement of enzyme activity
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To minimize errors due to the interference of endogenous pyruvic acid without complicating the analysis operation and increasing the analysis time, by laminating a reagent layer containing pyruvate oxidase and a porous development layer on a non-aqu permeable light transmitting support with a void volume set at a specified value. CONSTITUTION:A reagent layer in which pyruvate oxidase is dissolved or dispersed into gelatin or a mixture of a gelatin and another hydrophilic polymer is formed on a non-water permeable light transmitting support made of polyethylene terephtharate, cellulose ester or the like. The reagent also contains an indicator which detects hydrogen peroxide to be generated by pyruvate oxidase. A porous development layer with a void volume of 3-15mul/cm<2> is formed thereon. The development layer may contain various substrates, a hydrophilic polymer, a surfactant, a light shielding composition and the like. In the measurement of transaminase activity of a body fluid (especially, blood) with a relatively high concentration of endogenous pyruvic acid, the measurement of enzyme activity is possible accompanied by no measuring errors without enlarging the reaction time.

rows.title: Immunological analytical element and method therefor
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To high-sensitively and quickly carry out analysis with a simple operation by providing a substrate layer containing a nondiffusive substrate and a reagent layer containing a low molecular enzyme. CONSTITUTION:On a light-transmissible base material 10, a reagent layer 12 and a substrate layer 14 are laminated. The substrate layer 14 is made up of a water-permeable layer, and contains a nondiffusive substrate being the substrate of enzyme that has been combined with an antibody as a label. This substrate produces a diffusive substance by the enzyme activity of an enzyme labeled antibody that remains in inverse proportion to the amount of a high molecular antigen being the measuring object. The reagent layer 12 is made up of a water-permeable layer, and contains a low molecular enzyme by which the diffusive substance that has diffused and shifted from the substrate layer is changed into a product of a lower molecular weight. The substrate layer 14 also contains a reagent constituent for detecting this low molecular enzyme. The substrate layer 14 is preferably made of a porous layer consisting of a porous medium, or of a layer consisting of a hydrophilic polymer binder. The reagent layer 12 is preferably made of a continuous layer consisting of a hydrophilic polymer binder.

rows.title: Dry type analyzing element for analyzing whole blood sample
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate processing at the time of production (molding) and to allow rapid measurement as well as to enhance the reproducibility of an analyte measured value by laminating a non-woven fabric having a prescribed average fiber diameter and density and a detecting function layer. CONSTITUTION:The non-woven fabric having 0.2 to 10mum average fiber size and 0.01 to 0.2g/cm<2> density and the detecting function layer are laminated or a porous layer as a development layer is held in place therebetween to form the dry analyzing element for the whole blood sample. There are no particular limitations on the fiber blank material of the non-woven fabric and spinning method. Filter paper, non-woven fabric, woven fabric, knitted fabric, etc., are usable for the porous layer and the woven fabric and knitted fabric are more preferable. A reagent layer, light shielding layer and non-woven fabric are laminated on a base to form the analyzing element. The reagent layer is the layer contg. the compsn. which can generate the coloration, discoloration or the change in absorption wavelength optically detectable in the presence of the component to be detected. This layer is formed by incorporating the reagent compsn. into a water permeable layer or pours layer consisting of a hydrophilic polymer binder.

rows.title: Integral type multi-layered analyzing element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To quickly diffuse and penetrate the analyte of the amt. enough for coloration reaction into a reagent layer by adhering 3 layers of porous sheets by an adhesive agent constituting fine through-gaps. CONSTITUTION:This integral type multi-layered analyzing element has a fibrous porous sheet, upper non-fibrous porous sheet, lower non-fibrous porous sheet and water absorptive layer contg. a hydrophilic polymer binder. Three layers of these sheets are adhered by the adhesive agent so as to constitute the fine through-gaps to substantially prohibit the uniform passage of the liquid between the adjacent faces. The fibrous porous sheets have the effect of diffusing the received sample in a horizontal direction and to supply the same at the same instant to the lower layer so as to distribute the liquid sample of the approximately specified amt. per unit area in a manner as to substantially prohibit the uneven presence of the components contained in the aq. liquid sample spotted and supplied to the surface of the upper side.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a multi-layer dry-type chemical analytic element having a water-permeable layer containing a specific substrate and a water-permeable detection layer and capable of detecting a specific component (hydrolase) in an aqueous liquid in high sensitivity. CONSTITUTION:A detection layer 20, a substrate layer 30 and a developing layer 50 are laminated on a transparent and impermeable supporting member 10 in the order. The substrate layer 30 and the detection layer 20 are formed of water-permeable porous layer. The substrate layer 30 contains a non-diffusible substrate. rows.title: Liquid crystal composition, cholesteric liquid crystal layer, cured product, optically anisotropic body, and method for producing cholesteric liquid crystal layer
rows.abstract: A first objective of the present invention is to provide a liquid crystal composition which has excellent characteristics capable of reflecting light, which is incident in the normal direction onto the surface of a layer, in a direction other than the normal direction, and is for forming a cholesteric liquid crystal layer. In addition, a second objective of the present invention is to provide a cholesteric liquid crystal layer formed by using the liquid crystal composition. In addition, a third objective of the present invention is to provide a cured product obtained by curing the liquid crystal composition. In addition, a fourth objective of the present invention is to provide: an optically anisotropic body formed by using the liquid crystal composition; and an optically anisotropic body comprising the cholesteric liquid crystal layer. In addition, a fourth objective of the present invention is to provide a method for producing a cholesteric liquid crystal layer using the liquid crystal composition.　A liquid crystal composition according to the present invention includes: a liquid crystal compound; a chiral agent A; and a chiral agent B in which spiral-inducing force is increased by light irradiation, wherein the chiral agent A induces a spiral in the direction opposite to that of the chiral agent B.

rows.title: A method for the separation and purification of nucleic acid
rows.abstract:
An object of the present invention is to provide: a method for isolating and
purifying nucleic acids which employs a solid phase wherein the solid phase has
excellent isolating capability, good washing efficiency, and easy workability, and can be
mass produced with substantially identical isolating capability, the solid phase being
used in a method for isolating and purifying nucleic acids by adsorbing nucleic acids in
a sample onto a solid phase surface and desorbing the nucleic acids by washing and the
like; and a unit for isolation and purification of nucleic acid which is suitable for
carrying out said method. The present invention provides a method for isolating and
purifying a nucleic acid, comprising the step of: adsorbing a nucleic acid onto a solid
phase composed of an organic high polymer having a hydroxide group on a surface
thereof, and desorbing the nucleic acid from the solid phase, and a unit for isolation and
purification of nucleic acid comprising a container having at least two openings wherein
the container contains a solid phase composed of organic high polymers having a
hydroxyl group on a surface thereof.

rows.title: Method for extracting nucleic acid
rows.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for extracting nucleic acids which easily enables preparation of samples for DNA microarray in a short time.  <P>SOLUTION: The method comprises a process (a) of adsorbing a nucleic acid on a solid material by bringing adsorptive liquid in which a sample comprising at least one kind of nucleic acid and at least one kind of repetitive sequence blocking nucleic acid are mixed with a buffer solution in contact with a solid material comprising a cellulose derivative as a main ingredient and a process (b) of obtaining eluate containing a nucleic acid by contacting the solid material with a recovery liquid. It is preferable that the nucleic acid contained in the sample is a nucleic acid obtained by nucleic acid amplification reaction, the nucleic acid contained in the sample is a nucleic acid bound to a fluorescent material, and the repetitive sequence blocking nucleic acid is Cot-1 DNA. Further it is preferable that a sodium salt or water-soluble organic solvent is contained in the adsorptive liquid and a process (c) of washing the solid material by a washing liquid is included between processes (a) and (b).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

rows.title: Method for cleaning and cleaning liquid
rows.abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a semiconductor substrate cleaning method that enables excellent performance in removal of polishing particles from a semiconductor substrate subjected to chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP). The present invention also addresses the problem of providing a cleaning fluid for a semiconductor substrate subjected to CMP. This cleaning method is a semiconductor substrate cleaning method comprising a cleaning step for cleaning, using a cleaning fluid, a semiconductor substrate subjected to a CMP treatment using a polishing fluid that includes polishing particles. The semiconductor substrate includes a metal. The pH of the cleaning fluid at 25 DEG C is over 7. The cleaning fluid includes: a chelating agent; a constituent A that is at least one selected from the group consisting of primary amines, secondary amines, and tertiary amines, and that has a first acid dissociation constant for conjugate acids of at least 8.0; and an anti-corrosive agent. The condition is met that the product of a contact angle ratio obtained by a designated test method 1 and a specific degree of aggregation obtained by a designated test method 2 is 15 or less.

rows.title: Cleaning liquid for semiconductor substrate
rows.abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a cleaning liquid for a semiconductor substrate, which has excellent cleaning performance and excellent ruthenium oxide dissolving ability in a case of being applied as a cleaning liquid after a CMP treatment of a semiconductor substrate including a metal film. A cleaning liquid for a semiconductor substrate according to the present invention is a cleaning liquid for a semiconductor substrate, which is used for cleaning a semiconductor substrate, where the cleaning liquid contains at least one purine compound selected from the group consisting of purine and a purine derivative and a compound represented by Formula (A).

rows.abstract: 【課題】半導体デバイスの製造工程において、バリア金属膜と、該バリア金属膜上に設けられた導体膜とを有する被研磨体を研磨する化学的機械的研磨方法であって、導体膜とバリア金属膜とを同じ研磨定盤上で連続的に研磨することができ、研磨処理の効率が向上しうる化学的機械的研磨方法を提供すること。   【解決手段】バリア金属膜と、該バリア金属膜上に設けられた導体膜とを有する被研磨体を研磨する化学的機械的研磨方法であって、研磨液Ａを用いて前記導体膜を研磨する第１の研磨工程と、研磨液Ｂを用いて前記バリア金属膜を研磨する第２の研磨工程と、を研磨パッドが配置された同一の研磨定盤上で連続的に行い、且つ、前記研磨液Ａ及び前記研磨液Ｂが下記の（１）〜（３）の成分を含むことを特徴とする化学的機械的研磨方法。   （１）一次粒子径が２０〜５０ｎｍであり、且つ、会合度が２〜５である粒子   （２）有機酸   （３）酸化剤   【選択図】なし

rows.abstract: 【課題】酸化剤添加後も極めて安定な性能を示す化学的機械的研磨用の金属用研磨液を提供すること。また、簡単な方法で効率よく金属イオンを低減し、酸化剤添加後も極めて安定な性能を示す化学的機械的研磨用の金属用研磨液の調製方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】本発明の研磨液は、半導体デバイスの化学的機械的研磨に用いられる金属用研磨液であり、有機酸および不動態膜形成剤の少なくとも一方をイオン交換水に溶解した溶液を、金属キレート能を有する基を有する水不溶性樹脂で処理して重金属イオンを固体質量換算で１ｐｐｍ以下とし、処理後の溶液に、砥粒および酸化剤を含有させてなる研磨液である。 【選択図】なし

rows.title: 金属用研磨液
rows.abstract: 【課題】迅速な銅研磨速度、及び、良好な銅／タンタル研磨選択性を有し、更に、ディッシングが少なく平坦性を向上させることが可能な金属用研磨液を提供すること。 【解決手段】半導体集積回路用基板の製造工程における化学的機械的平坦化に用いられ、（Ａ）有機無機複合粒子、（Ｂ）キノリンカルボン酸又はその誘導体、（Ｃ）アミノ酸、及び（Ｄ）酸化剤を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液。主として銅配線の研磨に用いられることが好ましい。 【選択図】なし

rows.abstract: 【課題】有機重合粒子の表面が十分な強度及び硬度を有し、耐熱性に優れ、適度に柔軟であって、研磨速度を大きくすることができるとともにスクラッチの発生も抑えられる研磨液を提供する。 【解決手段】半導体集積回路の平坦化工程における主としてバリア層の化学的機械的研磨に用いられる研磨液であって、（１）有機重合粒子表面の酸素原子を介して、Ｔｉ、Ａｌ、Ｚｒ、およびＳｉからなる群より選択される少なくとも一種の無機原子が結合してなる表面修飾粒子、（２）有機酸、（３）カルボキシル基を２つ以上有するアゾール化合物、及び（４）酸化剤を含み、かつ、ｐＨが１〜７である研磨液である。 【選択図】なし

rows.abstract: 【課題】被研磨体（ウェハ）を研磨する際に、高研磨速度とディッシングの低減とを両立することが可能な金属用研磨液、及び該金属用研磨液を用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供する。 【解決手段】半導体デバイス製造工程における化学的機械的研磨に用いられ、ペルオキソ二硫酸塩と、親水性基を置換基として有するアゾ−ル化合物と、を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液、及び該金属用研磨液を研磨定盤上の研磨パッドに供給し、該研磨定盤を回転させることで、該研磨パッドを被研磨体の被研磨面と接触させつつ相対運動させて研磨することを特徴とする化学的機械的研磨方法。 【選択図】なし

rows.abstract: 【課題】沈殿形成がなく、研磨速度が速い化学的機械的研磨液、及び、研磨方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】（Ａ）シリカ粒子、（Ｂ）酸化剤、（Ｃ）０．０１ｐｐｍ以上、１０ｐｐｍ未満の範囲内にある金属イオン、及び、（Ｄ）酸化剤と金属イオンとによる反応活性を向上させる化合物を含有し、ｐＨが２．０〜５．０の範囲内にあることを特徴とする化学的機械的研磨液。前記化学的機械的研磨液を、研磨定盤上に貼付した研磨パッドに供給する工程、及び、前記研磨定盤を回転させることで、前記研磨パッドを被研磨体の被研磨面と接触させつつ相対運動させて研磨する工程を含むことを特徴とする研磨方法。 【選択図】なし

rows.title: 药液、药液的制造方法、基板的处理方法
rows.abstract: 本发明提供一种对过渡金属含有物具有优异的蚀刻性能，且具有优异的缺陷抑制性能的药液、上述药液的制造方法及基板的处理方法。本发明的药液为包含选自由高碘酸及其盐组成的组中的一种以上的高碘酸类、选自由Ti及Zr组成的组中的一种以上的第1金属成分及水的药液，药液包含一种第1金属成分时，一种第1金属成分的含量相对于高碘酸类总质量为1质量ppt～100质量ppm，药液包含两种第1金属成分时，两种第1金属成分的含量分别相对于高碘酸类总质量为100质量ppm以下，两种第1金属成分中的至少一种成分的含量相对于上述高碘酸类总质量为1质量ppt以上。

rows.title: 處理液、處理方法
rows.abstract: 本發明提供一種去除目標物的去除性優異的同時，能夠抑制包含選自包括Co及Cu之群組中之1種以上的第1金屬之第1金屬含有物的蝕刻之處理液及處理方法。本發明的處理液係對含有包含選自包括Co及Cu之群組中之1種以上的第1金屬之第1金屬含有物之被處理物進行處理時使用之處理液，該處理液含有蝕刻劑、有機溶劑及防腐劑，相對於前述處理液的總質量，有機溶劑的含量為80質量％以上，防腐劑係選自包括化合物X、化合物Y及化合物Z之群組中之1種以上的化合物。

rows.abstract: 本發明的課題為提供一種Cu的腐蝕抑制性優異並且有機殘渣去除性亦優異的處理液。前述處理液含有：還原劑；及特定化合物，選自包括脫氫抗壞血酸、2,3-二酮古洛糖酸、4-草醯巴豆酸及3,4,5-三氧環己烷-1-羧酸之群組中之至少1種。

rows.title: 处理液、被对象物的处理方法、半导体器件的制造方法
rows.abstract: 本发明提供一种在适用于具有实施了化学机械研磨处理的铜表面的被对象物时铜的腐蚀少且铜表面上的有机残渣的去除性优异的处理液、及使用上述处理液的被对象物的处理方法、及半导体器件的制造方法。本发明的处理液包含阴离子性聚合物、膦酸化合物及含有羟基的羧酸，上述膦酸化合物的含量相对于上述阴离子性聚合物的含量的质量比为0.1～1000，该处理液的pH为0.1～7.0，并且使用于半导体制造工序。

rows.title: 藥液、被處理物之處理方法、半導體器件之製造方法
rows.abstract: 本發明提供一種藥液、藥液所涉及的被處理物之處理方法、及半導體器件之製造方法，所述藥液能夠從具有Ge濃度不同之兩種含SiGe物的被處理物中，相較於Ge濃度較低的含SiGe物選擇性地去除Ge濃度較高的含SiGe物。本發明之藥液係用於具有鍺濃度不同之兩種含矽-鍺物的被處理物的藥液，所述藥液包含水、氯化氫、及過氧化氫，並且過氧化氫的含量與氯化氫的含量之質量比為0.20以上，水的含量與氯化氫的含量之質量比為130～560。

rows.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To manufacture a plastic optical fiber (POF) that materializes low transmission loss.  <P>SOLUTION: A first member 17 in which a plurality of polymerized body layers are laminated and a cylindrical second member 19 are separately formed. The first member 17 is inserted into the second member 19 and then combined with a cylindrical third member 21 to make a preform 12. In a first member forming process 18, the first member 17 is formed so that a difference between the orientation S1 of the innermost layer and the orientation S2 of the outermost layer of the first member 17 becomes not less than 0 but below 0.2. Also, in the first member forming process 18, a layer forming material containing at least one or more kinds of polymerizable compositions and a chain transfer agent comprising a thiol group is poured into a hollow tube and polymerized, with this process repeated to form the first member 17. rows.title: Touch panel, method for manufacturing touch panel and conductive film
rows.abstract: A conductive film is disposed on a display panel. The conductive film includes a conductive part having a mesh pattern composed of thin metal wires. The mesh pattern has moire prevention portions at intersections thereof. The area Sa of the intersection and the area Sb of the moire prevention portion satisfy the following expression: Sa*0.01 < Sb ≤ Sa*5.00. The conductive film includes a transparent substrate, the conductive part composed of the thin metal wires, and a transparent coating layer. The conductive part is formed on one main surface of the transparent substrate with an adhesive layer being interposed therebetween. The transparent coating layer is coated on the conductive part and the exposed portions of the adhesive layer. The difference in refractive index between the adhesive layer and the transparent coating layer is 0.1 or less.

CONSTITUTION:A replenishing liquid supply port 6 is provided in the first half region of a stage from the start before the end of immersion of the slit type processing device for photosensitive materials which processes the silver halide photographic sensitive material by immersing this material into the processing liquid. The replenishing liquid supply pipe 4 arriving at this supply port 6 is immersed into the processing liquid in the process of heading toward the first half part from the second half part of the processing so that a heat exchange of the replenishing liquid and the processing liquid is easily executed via the supply pipe 4. The replenishing liquid supply pipe 4 is immersed into the processing liquid in the process of heading to the first half part from the second half part of the processing stage and the supply port 6 is provided in the first half region of the processing, by which the replenishing liquid is heat exchanged with the processing liquid via the supply pipe 4 in the process of arriving at the supply port 6 and its temp. is equilibriated. Then, the temp. difference between the processing liquid and the replenishing liquid is eliminated at the time of the replenishing and the temp. fluctuation of the processing liquid is prevented. The specified photographic characteristics of the photosensitive material are thus obtd.

rows.title: Device for processing photosensitive material
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of fur by a purifying device and to suppress the passage of washing water having a large degree of contamination through a filter and an adsorbent tank as well as to prolong the life of the filter and adsorbent. CONSTITUTION:This device 1 for processing the photosensitive material has a developing tank 2, a fixing tank 3, a washing tank 4, a squeezing section 7, and a drying section 8, and processes the exposed photosensitive material S by successively transporting the material by means of rollers 51 to 54, 71, 82. Further, the device 1 has a washing water supplying means 18 for supplying the washing water to the washing tank 4, a control means 10 for controlling the operation of the means 18, and the purifying device 9 having the filter 91, a UV rays ozone processing chamber 93 and the adsorbent tank 98. This device 1 detects the passage of the photosensitive material S by a sensor 19 and determines the processing quantity per unit time. The operating time of a pump 15 is prolonged to control the supply rate of the washing water to the washing tank 4 so as to increase this rate when the continuous processing is judged.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the sealing performance between a partition member and a processing tank which constitute the processing device while maintaining the conveyance performance of photosensitive materials as to the photosensitive material processing device providing with a blade in passages connecting processing chambers in the processing tank. CONSTITUTION:The respective processing chambers 6A-6E in the processing tank 2 are constituted by inserting the partition member 3 into the processing tank 2 and coupled by passages 71-76. The blade 15 is arranged in the passages 71-76 to substantially cut off a liquid flow among the processing chambers 6A-6E. The partition member 3 and processing tank 2 contact each other in a liquid-tight state vertically at step parts 33, 34, and 35, and 23, 24, and 25 provided at mutually opposite positions, thereby cutting off the liquid flow. Further, a seal means 36 may be provided between the partition member 3 and processing tank 2 to obtain sufficient sealing effect with contact pressure obtained without increasing the contact pressure of the blade 15.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent condensed water droplets from being attached to a photosensitive material. CONSTITUTION:On the inserting port 22 side of a crossover rack 12 arranged at the upper part of a developing tank 10, an inserting roller pair 44 and a guide roller 46 which are surrounded by guide members 30, 32 and 34 and driven to be rotated and which interpose and carry the photosensitive material 14 are arranged. Then, blades 52 are projectingly provided on the guide members toward the respective rollers 44A and 44B of the roller pair 44 and the guide roller 46 and the tip parts thereof are made to abut on the circumferential surfaces of the respective rollers. Therefore, when the rollers is driven to be rotated in order to start the processing of the material 14, the water droplets condensed and attached to the circumferential surfaces of the rollers are scraped by the blades 50 brought into contact with the circumferential surfaces of the rollers. Besides, they are not attached to the material 14 when the rollers are brought into contact with the material 14.

rows.title: Photosensitive material processing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To lessen the generation of unequal processing and the fluctuation in photographic characteristics by connecting a nozzle provided in the vicinity of a photosensitive material feed port and a processing liquid suction port provided in the vicinity of the bottom in a processing space via a circulating means and directing the injection direction of the nozzle toward the direction where the photosensitive material is transported. CONSTITUTION:The processing liquid is injected from the nozzle 19 provided in the vicinity of the feed port 12 in the processing space 11 toward the photosensitive surface of the photosensitive material S and is sucked from the suction port 21 provided in the vicinity of the bottom. This liquid is sent to the nozzle 19 via the circulating means P. Since the injection direction of the processing liquid from the nozzle 19 is directed toward the direction where the photosensitive material S is transported, the tailing and unequal processing generated at the end edge in the opposite direction of the photosensitive part with respect to the direction where the photosensitive material is transport are prevented. In addition, the unequal photosensitive is lessened. Since the processing liquid is injected to the photosensitive surface, the material eluted from the photosensitive surface into the processing liquid is wiped away and the photosensitive surface is processed by the uniform processing liquid at all times. The processed photosensitive material having the good photographic characteristics is obtd. with stability in this way.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve processing efficiency and to reduce the size of the device by installing blades in the respective narrow-width passages successively connected with plural processing chambers and using panel heating element as temp. control means. CONSTITUTION:The plural processing chambers 6A to 6E successively connected by the narrow-width passages, the blades 15 installed in the respective passages, transporting means 8 for successively passing a silver halide photosensitive material S in the respective processing chambers 6A to 6E and the panel heating elements 5 for heating the processing liquids (for example, washing water W) in the processing chambers 6A to 6E are provided. Consequently, the liquid compsn. gradients of the processing liquids are formed between the respective processing chambers 6A to 6E. In addition, the liquid compsn. gradients are maintained by the shielding effect and squeezing effect of the blades 15 and further, since the temp. control is executed by the panel heating elements 5, there is no need for installing the heaters on the outside of a processing tank 2 and the need for temp. control means is eliminated according to the kinds and functions of the panel heating elements 5. The processing efficiency is improved and the replenishing quantity of the processing liquid is decreased. The size of the device is thus reduced.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To effectively prevent processing solution from evaporating and being deteriorated and to smoothly open and close an aperture by the expansion and the contraction of a hollow body. CONSTITUTION:A photosensitive material processor 1 is provided with a processing tank 2 where the processing solution Q is put in. The liquid level of the solution Q is covered by a cover body 6 provided with the carrying-in port 66 and the carrying-out port 67 of a photosensitive material S. Besides, the expanding and contracting hollow bodies 71 and 72 are respectively installed in the ports 66 and 67. Then, the bodies 71 and 72 are made to expand and contract by changing the internal pressure of the bodies 71 and 72 by a pressure adjustment means such as a compressor, for example. In accordance with it, the ports 66 and 67 are opened or closed. Such opening and closing of the ports 66 and 67 is executed according to the processing and the non-processing of the material S.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the deterioration of a processing liquid and to speed up processing as well as to decrease the volume of the processing liquid and replenishing liquid by providing supply ports which supply the replenishing liquid to a processing path of a slit-shaped section in which a combined developing and fixing bath is packed. CONSTITUTION:The combined developing and fixing bath 10 for developing and fixing a photosensitive material S after exposing is packed into the slit- shaped processing path 15 of a processing tank 1. This device is constituted to supply the replenishing liquid contg. developer components at a high ratio from the replenishing supply port 21 in the inlet part of the replenishing path 15 and to supply the replenishing liquid contg. fixer components at a high ratio from the replenishing supply port 25 or 23 above photosensitive material feed reels. The photosensitive material S is carried into this processing path 15 by means of an inlet reel 24 and while the material is transported by feed reels 16 to 20, the material is processed by the liquid 10. The processed material is taken out by a take-out reel 26. Shutters to parting the processing liquid are preferably provided in front of the supply ports 23, 25.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce the fatigue of processing liquid and to decrease the amount of supplementary liquid by closing the upper part of a processing tank with a 1st and a 2nd closure part and providing an opening for passing a photosensitive material between those closure parts. CONSTITUTION:A liquid surface lid 66 which is the 1st closure part is fixed to the upper end of the outer periphery of the rack 33 of the developing tank 28 and a conveyance rack 37 which is the 2nd closure part having an arcuate refracting surface 67 is arranged inside the lid 66. Then the photosensitive material 14 where an image is printed is passed through the opening 68 between the lid 66 and rack 37 and carried in the tank 28, and further passes through the other opening 68 of similar constitution and carried to a fixing tank. Further, a level sensor 70 judges the liquid level of a liquid developer in the tank 28 and a replenishing means 77 operates when an electrode 112 does not detect the liquid any more to replenish the replenishing liquid into the tank 28; and the operation of the means 77 is stopped when an electrode 110 detects the liquid.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the accuracy of the positioning of a conveyance rack on a processing tank and to prevent the processing tank from damaging by fitting the conveyance rack to the processing tank through the bent piece of a metallic bracket. CONSTITUTION:Brackets 92 made of metal such as stainless steel are fitted to a couple of opposite sides of the opening edge part of a processing tank main body 30 and racks 40 and 42 are positioned with the lower bent pieces 96 of the brackets 92 and the lower end surfaces of the hanger parts 102 of the conveyance racks 40 and 42. Then a film 20 is sent in the processing tank 34 from an insertion opening 26, lowered by the rack 40 and then elevated, and conveyed and developed. Then the film 20 is sent in the fixing tank 36, conveyed similarly by the rack 42 and fixed, and sent in a washing tank 38, and the film is conveyed similarly by the rack 42 and washed, and then dried.

rows.title: Photosensitive material treating device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a photosensitive material treating device which can execute a uniform processing. CONSTITUTION:The treating tank 2 of the photosensitive material is partitioned by a partition wall 4. The lower part of the partition wall 4 is held open and serves as a passage for the photosensitive material 12. A solvent liquid 6 is filled in the bottom of the treating tank 2. A developer 8 and a bleach-fixing bath 10 are filled respectively in both sides of the partition wall 4 above the solvent liquid 6. Liquid shielding members 14 are provided on a boundary between the respective processing liquids 8, 10 and the solvent liquid 6. The liquid shielding members 14 is provided with photosensitive material passages 16. Then, the liquid shielding members 14 press the solvent liquid 6, therefore, the waving of the solvent liquid 6 surface is prevented even in the case of the stirring of the processing liquids and the carrying of the photosensitive material. The functions for treating the photosensitive material 12 and for squeezing the photosensitive material 12 by the solvent liquid 6 are thus maintained constant.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the washing processing efficiency by providing a reservoir of a small capacity on the downstream of a photosensitive material carrying path from a washing tank, feeding a photosensitive material which is brought to washing processing in the washing tank, to the reservoir and bringing it to washing processing again. CONSTITUTION:A reservoir 56 of a small capacity is provided on the downstream of a photosensitive material carrying path from washing tanks 16, 18, and washing water for washing processing from a water feeding source 54 to the washing tanks 16, 18 is allowed to flow in from one side of this reservoir 56 and allowed to flow out to the washing tanks 16, 18 from the other side, and a photosensitive material 20 which is brought to washing processing by the washing tanks 16, 18 is fed to the reservoir 56 and brought to washing processing again by the reservoir 56. That is, the photosensitive material 20 which is exposed is fed to a developing tank 12, a fixing tank 14 and the washing tanks 16, 18, and brought to a series of processings, and thereafter, further fed to the reservoir 56 and brought to washing processing repeatedly. As for the reservoir 56, on one side, washing water is allowed to flow in from the water feeding source 54, and on the other side, the washing water is allowed to flow out to the washing tanks 16, 18, and also, since its capacity is small, it is always filled with washing water by replenishing a small quantity of fresh washing water from the water feeding source 54. In such a way, not only the washing processing can be executed repeatedly but also the washing processing can be executed by replenishing a small quantity of fresh washing water from the water feeding source 54.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To properly process a photosensitive material even with a small quantity of processing liquid and to lessen the makeup liquid. CONSTITUTION:A processing tank 2 is divided in two by a partition 6 except the lower part. The tank is charged with a solvent liquid 14 in the part below both sides of the partition 6 and with a bleaching fixing solution 16 and washing water 18 on both sides of the partition 8 above the solvent liquid 14. A photosensitive material 4 is carried into the bleaching fixing solution 16, the solvent liquid 14 and the washing water 18 in this order. A washing part on the downstream side of the solvent liquid 14 is divided into plural water washing cambers 29 which are arranged in cascades so that the washing water may overflow from the downstream side to the upstream side.

rows.title: Photosensitive material processor
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a photosensitive material processor which suppresses the situation that dust floats up in processing liquid inside a processing liquid tank main body, is attached to the photosensitive material and leaves flaws and which maintains the stable processing performance of forming images without the flaws on the photosensitive material. SOLUTION: A filter 40 is arranged inside an auxiliary chamber 38 formed at the bottom of a processing liquid tank main body 32 and the outer side face of the filter 40 and the inner side face of the auxiliary chamber 38 are separated by 5 mm or more. Then, processing liquid purified through the filter is taken out from the lower layer part of the processing liquid stored in the processing liquid tank main body 32 and fed to the upper layer part of the processing liquid in the processing liquid tank main body 32 through a processing liquid circulation pipeline 30. The processing liquid stored in the processing liquid tank main body 32 is made to flow from the upper layer part to the lower layer part.  The dust in the processing liquid is put on the flows of the processing liquid, made to descend by gravity and caught by the filter 40 to prevent the dust from being stuck to the photosensitive material.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To miniaturize the device and to lower the amt. of the processing liquid to be replenished by providing liquid drain ports in positions exclusive of a processing chamber where a photosensitive material passes first and a processing chamber where the photosensitive material passes last. CONSTITUTION:The device for processing photosensitive materials which has the processing chambers 6A to 6E segmented to plural chambers in a processing tank 2, are formed with a continuous processing path to connect these processing chambers 6A to 6E, and is so constituted as to process the photosensitive material 100 by bringing the photosensitive material into contact with the processing liquid Q respectively filled in the chambers during the successive passage through the chambers is provided with a liquid feed port 11 in communication with the continuous processing path and is provided with at least one of the liquid drain ports 120 in the positions exclusive of the processing chamber 6A where the photosensitive material 100 passes first and the processing chamber 6E where the photosensitive material passes last. The supply of >=2 kinds of the processing liquids Q having different functions respectively from the plural points is, therefore, possible. The device is miniaturized in this way and the amt. of the processing liquid to be replenished is decreased.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent dirt and dust, etc., from being stuck between a photosensitive material and an image receiving material by pinching the end part of a heat developing photosensitive material in a transverse direction and feeding it from a housing part to a contact part. CONSTITUTION:A gear 102 which receives the driving force of a timing belt 68 is fixed to a conveying roll 95 in order to convey the photosensitive material P and plural pairs of conveying rolls 104 and 106 are provided on the back stream side of conveying rolls 98 and 100. And a small diameter part 112 is formed on the middle part of the conveying rolls 98 and 100 and the conveying rolls 104 and 106 and a small diameter part 120 is formed on the middle part of the conveying rolls 116 and 118 in the same way. Therefore, the photosensitive material P is prevented from contacting with said middle part and the dust can be prevented from sticking to an emulsion surface formed on one side of the photosensitive material P and an image formed part to a back surface. Thus, the dust is prevented from sticking to the central part of a photosensitive surface from the conveying roll and the image of good quality can be transferred on the image receiving material even at the time of developing and transfer.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To easily separate a heat developing photosensitive material from an image receiving material by making the heat developing photosensitive material and the image receiving material project in different directions respectively and guiding these projection part in different directions respectively. CONSTITUTION:Endless belts 398 and 400 for pinching the circle of the leading edge part of the image receiving material are provided on a separation take-out part 38. The endless belt 398 and 400 corresponds to both end parts in the transverse direction of the image receiving material and pinches the leading edge part of the image receiving material fed out from a heat developing part in a horizontal direction so as to bend it upward to raise. Namely, the leading edge part of the image receiving material are allowed to be contact in projecting from the leading edge part of the photosensitive material and the projection part of the image receiving material is pinched with the endless belts 398 and 400 to be raised. In such a state, the leading edge part of the photosensitive material is guided in a downward direction with the lower guide plate 390 and an upper guiding plate 392 and the image receiving material R which is allowed to be raised upward is separated from the photosensitive material which is guided downward by the plates 390 and 392.

rows.title: Image recorder
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate flawing of the surface of image receiving paper and to reproduce a high-quality image by maintaining the angle at which a photosensitive recording material and the image receiving paper join at <=80 deg. at the time of joining and superposing said material and the image receiving paper via a guide part. CONSTITUTION:The photosensitive material A subjected to a heat developing process is then carried by a Y-shaped guide plate 72 and a 1st feed path 72a via a 5th roller pair 44e into a superposing part 19. The material A and the image receiving paper C are joined and pressed with and to each other in such a manner. The material A is flawed and uneven images are induced if the joining angle thereof is about 90 deg.. The joining angle theta deg. is set at <=80 deg. and the superposing part is so constituted that either of the material A or the paper C advances rectilinearly to the superposing part and the other enters the same at <=80 deg. angle in order to eliminate such formation of the uneven image. The flawing of the material A and the paper C is thereby prevented.

rows.title: Image recorder
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a stable and satisfactory image quality by providing a pressure force adjusting means of a photosensitive material nip part, and adjusting automatically the pressure force of a pressure transfer device in accordance with thickness and rigidity of an image receiving material to be used. CONSTITUTION:By changing the energizing force applied to an oscillation tip part by a pressure adjusting device 53 provided on the oscillation tip part of a supporting member 42, the press-contacting force of a photosensitive material nip part 48 of a fixed nip roller 38 and a free nip roller 23 is adjusted. That is, when a bolt 52 is turned by a motor 47 of the pressure adjusting device 53, a pressure member 41 moves in the axial direction of the bolt, therefore, the compression quality of a coil spring 45 is changed, and the energizing force applied to the oscillation tip part is varied. In such a way, in accordance with the kind of an image receiving material to be used, the pressure force applied to the photosensitive material nip part 48 of a pressure transfer device 22 is adjusted in optimum, and even in the case of bringing an image to a pressure transfer by using the image receiving material whose thickness and rigidity are different, a stable and satisfactory image quality being free from an uneven image and a color shift can be obtained.

rows.title: Peeling device for image recorder
rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To prevent contact marks on image receiving material, and to hold the tight contact of the image receiving material with the outer periphery of a heating drum so as to excellently secure the drying property of the image receiving material. CONSTITUTION: Photosensitive material which is image-exposed is superposed on the image receiving material and wound round the outer periphery of the heating drum 106. When the drum 106 is rotated after heat developing and transferring, a photosensitive material peeling pawl 126 is turned in an opposite direction to the rotating direction of the drum 106 through a pawl shaft 128 and engaged with the preceding edge of the photosensitive material, so that the preceding part is peeled from the drum 106. Thereafter, when the pawl 126 is turned in the same direction as the rotating direction of the drum 106 and moved to a separate position, the photosensitive material is peeled from the image receiving material, and the image receiving material passes between the pawl 126 and the drum 106 with the rotation of the drum 106.  At such a time, a rolling wheel 200 is positioned more proximately to the outer periphery side of the drum 106 than the pawl 126 and rolls in a state where it abuts on the image receiving material, thereby preventing the image receiving material from coming in contact with the pawl 126.

rows.title: Image recorder
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an image recorder where the drying property of an image receiving material on which an image is formed by thermal developing and transfer can be enhanced, unnecessary traces are not left and the quality of the image can be improved. CONSTITUTION:The peeling position of a photosensitive material 16 by a bending and guiding roller 142 and a peeling pawl 154 is provided on an upstream side in a carrying direction and at a higher position than the peeling position of the image receiving material 108 by a peeling roller 174 and a peeling pawl 176. Therefore, vapor generated when the material 16 is separated from the material 108 and peeled from a heating drum 116 rises as it is and it is not attached on the material 108. Therefore, the drying property of the material 108 is enhanced and the traces of the roller or the like are not left on the material 108 when the material 108 is carried thereafter. Besides, the quality of the recorded image is improved.

rows.title: Image recording system
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate handling, control or the like of a photosensitive material and make a device smaller in size, by exposing the photosensitive material to light while paying out the photosensitive material from a first magazine and taking up the material onto a take-up roll in a second magazine, and transferring an image thus obtained onto an image-receiving material separately supplied, thereby recording the image. CONSTITUTION:A thermally developed type photosensitive material 100 is contained in the state of being wound around a payout roll 105 in a magazine 103, and the material 100 paid out through a paying-out part 120 in a sheet form is fed to and taken up around a take-up roll 102 in another magazine 104. An exposure part 200 is provided between feeding rollers 110 and feeding rollers 111, and exposure is conducted in the manner of line scanning by directing transmitted light to the photosensitive material 100. By the feeding, the material 100 and an image-receiving paper 301 are superposed on each other, and are passed over a developing plate 502 at a position A, at which heating to a predetermined temperature is conducted by a heater 503 to transfer an image from the photosensitive material 100 exposed and coated with water to the image-receiving paper 301, and then the material 100 is taken up onto the take-up roll 102. Thus, there is no need for a discarding tray or the like, and handling and control of the photosensitive material are facilitated.

Then, the photosensitive material 100 which is coated with water by the water coating part 100 has slack 100A, the image receiving paper 620 which is supplied from a cassette 621 is mounted on a development plate 602 at a position A, and a heater 603 generates heat;and the image receiving paper 620 is rotated to a position B and superposed upon the photosensitive material 100 to perform image transfer, and then falls by its own weight.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the jamming of photosensitive materials in an accumulating section so that the materials can be accumulated smoothly by providing an air blowing means which blows air on the photosensitive materials separated from image receiving materials for drying the materials. CONSTITUTION:A heat development photosensitive material 16 put between and carried by carrying rollers 66 is moved under the guidance of a guide plate 68 and sent to rollers 70 with skirt. While the photosensitive material 16 is wet because water is applied to the material 16 when the material 16 passes through a water applying section, air is directly blown on the material 16 moved under the guidance of the guide plate 68 from an air blowing port 90A by means of a cross fan 90 provided just above the guide plate 68 and the material 16 is fed to the rollers 70 while it is forcibly dried. Therefore, even when the material 16 is brought into contact with a previously accumulated photosensitive material 16, no strong frictional force is produced between the materials 16. Thus the heat development photosensitive material 16 fed by the rollers 70 smoothly slides in an abandoned tray 86 and is successively put on the previously accumulated material 16 without jamming.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To easily prevent the photographic fog by supplying a photosensitive material in a sheet state and supplying an image receiving material in a rolled state in a device where the photosensitive material is subjected to image exposure and is put on the image receiving material and the image is transferred by pressurizing. CONSTITUTION:A sensitive material supply part 12 is provided in the side part of a housing 1, and a sensitive material cassette 14 in which sheet-shaped photosensitive materials S are laminated and stored is freely detachably attached to this part 12. A sensitive material feeding roll 16, a pair of sensitive material feeding-out rolls 21 and 22, and a guide plate 24 are arranged in the exit side of the photosensitive material S, and stored photosensitive materials S are selectively fed out to an exposure part 25 one by one at a prescribed time. An image receiving paper roll 74 is axially supported by an arm member 73 in an image receiving paper housing 71 and a pair of feeding-out rolls 75 and 76 are arranged in the housing 1 to constitute an image receiving paper supply part 72. Since the photosensitive material is supplied in the sheet state, the photographic fog is easily prevented in comparison with the use of a photosensitive material roll where the photographic fog is apt to occur by the pressure of winding.

rows.title: Photosensitive material treating device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a photosensitive material treating device which enhances photosensitive efficiency and simultaneously prevents the uneven drying by efficiently discharging the humid dried air after blowing to the photosensitive material. CONSTITUTION:The dried air is blown to a filmstrip 20 by being guided by plural guiding plates 100. That is, there are cases where the vaporaized moisture-contd. humid dried air from the filmstrip 20 is stagnated in the vicinity of rollers disposed on the filmstrip transfer path in a drying section, which becomes the cause of the reduction of a drying efficiency. Thus, the dried air is branched and guided by the guiding plates 100 so as to blow a portion of the dried air to an area where the humid dried air is stagnated, thereby preventing the humid dried air from being retained. Further, a transfer guide for changing the direction of transferring the filmstrip 20 from the horizontal transfer to the vertical transfer is a plate whose surface is emboss-finished and has a little amount of ruggedness, thus preventing the humid dried air from being stagnated.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a photographing device which can provide an excellent image while the intrusion of dust is being prevented between sensitive material and image receiving material even by means of diffusion transfer by keeping a carrying passage for the thermal developing sensitive material and the image receiving material higher in pressure than the outside. CONSTITUTION:In a photographing device 10 in which an image is exposed to thermal sensitive material P so as to be piled up onto image receiving material R thereafter, and the thermally developed image is then transferred to the image receiving material R so as to be separated, a carrying passage for the thermal developing sensitive material P and the image receiving material R is constituted to be provided with a pressurizing means (a duct 50, a fan 66 and motor 69) which keeps the passage higher in pressure than the outside. In this constitution, the material P is pulled out of a housing section 26 so as to be exposed at an exposure section 28, it is then forwarded to a thermal developing section 36 thereafter, and the material P is pulled out of the housing section 34 so as to be forwarded to the thermal developing section 36, so that both of them are closely attached therein. Since the passage section for the material P and R is kept high in pressure, dust in a photograph forming chamber and outside will never be attached on the materials, this thereby prevents the occurrence of spot failures caused by dust coming in at the time of contact printing.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of dislocation by forming a separating part in such a way as to guide both heat developed sensitive material and image receiving material rectilinearly at an acute clamp angle to separate them. CONSTITUTION:Heat developed sensitive material P after the application of an image forming solvent is attached to image receiving material R so as to be subjected to developing transfer. The sensitive material P and the image receiving material R after this transfer are fed to a separating part 38 so as to be separated. In the separating part 38, the heat developed sensitive material P and the image receiving material R are both guided rectilinearly at an acute clamp angle. Accordingly, even if one material is going to be straight by rigidity at the separating terminal of the sensitive material P and image receiving material R, the force acting in the dislocating direction to the other material is small, and therefore the possibility of image dislocation is extremely small. A desirable image without image dislocation can be thereby obtained.

【課題】  受像材料等のシート部材を正確な姿勢で供給 できるシート部材供給装置を得る。
【解決手段】  受像材料４２を吸着して搬送する吸盤１ ７２の前方には、受像材料４２を挟持した状態で回転し て送り出す搬送ローラ２５６、２５８が配置されてお り、吸盤１７２によって搬送された受像材料４２の先端 部が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当てられる。ここ で、吸盤１７２は弾性変形可能であり、また、吸盤１７ ２による受像材料４２の搬送速度は搬送ローラ２５６の 回転周速度よりも速い。このため受像材料４２の姿勢が ずれて、先端部の幅方向一端が幅方向他端よりも先に搬 送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当たった場合には、幅方 向一端が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８の間へ挟み込まれる 前に、搬送ローラ２５６からの反力によって吸盤１７２ が弾性変形して、受像材料４２の姿勢を修正する。

(57)【要約】
【課題】揺動する積載台を持つシート供給装置におい て、送り手段へのシート突入位置の変動を少なくする。
【解決手段】シート供給トレイ１８にはシートを多数積 載する積載台５６が揺動自在に設けられている。この積 載台５６の上部に供給ヘッド２０が設けられ、この供給 ヘッド２０は、ナジャーロール６４、フィードロール６ ６及びリタードロール６８とから構成され、ナジャーロ ール６４の回転により積載台５６のシートがフィードロ ール６６とリタードロール６８とのニップ部８０へ押出 される。ナジャーロール６４のシート押出し位置は位置 検出手段８６により検出される。積載台５６のシート残 量が少なくなると、ナジャーロール６４から押出される シートの角度が上昇するが、ナジャーロール６４のシー ト押出し位置が積載台５６のシート残量に応じて制御さ れ、ナジャーロール６４から押出されたシートは適正範 囲内でリタードロール６８に突き当てることができる。

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To execute recording with high density, and also, to obtain a high reproducing output, by executing the recording of a magnetizing direction corresponding to the polarity of a recording signal, in the width direction of a recording track. CONSTITUTION:To an E type core 11 having gaps g1, g2, of a recording/ reproducing head 10, a core 12 is wound in the reverse direction so that a direction of a magnetic flux passing through the gaps g1, g2 becomes reverse. Accordingly, when the direction of a recording signal is the direction as indicated with an arrow (a), the magnetizing direction becomes the direction of both end parts from the center of a magnetic medium 15, and when said direction is the direction as indicated with an arrow (b), the center direction from both ends becomes the magnetizing direction, and the magnetization corresponding to the recording signal is executed in the direction vertical to the running direction of the medium 15. Accordingly, comparing with the case when the running direction of the recording medium becomes the magnetizing direction, a higher recording density can be obtained, and also, a reproducing output is raised by a sufficient magnetization in the width direction of the recording medium.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the recording density by arranging and supporting a pair of heads having each different azimuth, in the moving direction of a tape by piezoelectric elements, driving the heads by the piezoelectric elements so that tracks by both the heads are superposed, and executing the recording and reproduction by superposing two signals without causing a crosstalk. CONSTITUTION:Magnetic heads 30, 31 are supported by bimorph elements 32, 33 by setting an azimuth between gaps (g) to 90 deg., made to contact a tape 34 which moves in the direction (a), and placed side by side. In this state, the first information is recorded by adjusting the time of the applied polarity of AC voltages 35, 36, and moving the head 30 from a point a1 to a point b1. When the head 3 is in the point b1, the head 31 is in the point a1. Subsequently, the second information is superposed and recorded in the first information by switching the recording head to the head 31 and moving it to the point b1. Since there is an azimuth of 90 deg. between both the gaps, the information can be recorded without generating an interference. Thereafter, recording is executed by the same repetition,and the recording density can be improved. Even at the time of reproduction, no interference is generated owing to a large azimuth angle.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To record two types of signals on the same disk and to ensure a highly accurate tracking action by using magnetic heads to form the sound signal tracks adjacently to the picture signal tracks via the prescribed guard bands. CONSTITUTION:A sound signal magnetic head 30 and a gap part 33a are provided at the positions in parallel to gap parts 13a and 23a of picture signal magnetic heads 10 and 20 and also distant toward the track width Tw by a distance l respectively. The picture signals are recorded on tracks 61 and 62 of a magnetic recording disk 60 by heads 10 and 20. While the sound signals are recorded by the head 30 onto a track 63 set between both tracks 61 and 62 via a minute guard band corresponding to the distance l. Thus the sound signals are recorded without decreasing the number of tracks for picture signals. Furthermore, the crosstalk can be satisfactorily reduced because both heads are separate from each other by a prescribed distance. Thus, a highly accurate tracking action is ensured without using a large magnetic head.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To assure the mechanical strength of members and to improve the efficiency of recording/playback by constituting a high permeability magnetic core in such a manner that the decrease in the sectional area of sandwiching surfaces is compensated. CONSTITUTION:A deformed I-shaped member is obtd. by working aluminum titanium carbide, etc. to form a non-magnetic member 11a, polishing the right end face to a specular surface, forming a soft high permeability magnetic film by sputtering to the specular surface, working a nonmagnetic member 11 of the same material and adhering and fixing both members to sandwich a main magnetic pole 1 from the right and left with said member and the member 11a. The magnetic head body is enclosed by nonmagnetic materials 41a, 41b and 42a, 42b on the side faces of the magnetic circuit and are adhered and fixed to each other to form a slider 40. The head is subjected to lapping and polishing on the top surface by which the vertical magnetic recording/playback head is completed. The deformed I-shaped member consisting of the combination of the members 11a, 11b has the substantial width except the central part thereof and is therefore robust. The stable execution of the final polishing stage is made possible and the reliability of the finished product is high.

rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  均一性が高く且つ薄い主平面が（１００）面 の平板状粒子のハロゲン化銀写真乳剤を製造でき、更に 混合容器は攪拌羽根の回転の高速化により容易に混合効 率を向上させることができ、それによって乳剤製造の効 率を上昇せしめ、スケールアップ特性に優れたハロゲン 化銀写真乳剤の製造方法を提供する。
【解決手段】  ハロゲン化銀粒子の核形成及び／又は粒 子成長を起こさせる反応容器の外に混合容器をもうけ、 混合容器内に水溶性銀塩の水溶液と水溶性ハロゲン化物 の水溶液を供給して混合してハロゲン化銀微粒子を形成 し、直ちにこの微粒子を反応容器に供給してこの反応容 器内でハロゲン化銀粒子の核形成及び／又は粒子成長を 行わせるハロゲン化銀乳剤の製造方法であり、ハロゲン 化銀粒子の全投影面積の少なくとも５０％が主平面を （１００）面としている平板状ハロゲン化銀粒子で占め られる。

rows.title: 感光性ハロゲン化銀粒子及びその製造方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  主に粒状性の改良などの写真性能において優 れた効果を示す新規な形状の平板状ハロゲン化銀粒子及 びその製造方法を提供する。
【解決手段】  下記の（１）〜（３）の形態にある平板 状感光性ハロゲン化銀粒子。（１）二乃至四個の六角形 状の平面型ハロゲン化銀粒子が互いに各々の辺を共有す る形で接合された形態；（２）六角形状の平面型ハロゲ ン化銀粒子の一辺もしくは互いに隣接しない二もしくは 三個の辺に台形形状の平面型ハロゲン化銀粒子が、その 頂辺にて接合された形態；（３）三角形状の平面型ハロ ゲン化銀粒子の一乃至三個の辺に台形形状の平面型ハロ ゲン化銀粒子がその頂辺にて接合された形態。上記形態 の粒子は、５塩化ロジウム酸アンモニウムなどの成長制 御剤の存在下に、微粒子状のハロゲン化銀粒子を含む乳 剤に、ハロゲン塩の溶液を添加し、熟成することによ り、製造される。

【解決手段】ハロゲン化銀粒子の成長を起こさせる反応 容器の外に混合器を設け、該混合器においては、銀塩水 溶液とハロゲン化物塩水溶液の少なくとも一方を高い流 速を持つ直線状の噴流とし、前記二種類の溶液を連続的 に衝突させてハロゲン化銀微粒子を形成したあと１秒以 内に、該ハロゲン化銀微粒子を反応容器内のバルク液又 はハロゲン化銀粒子乳剤と混合せしめることによって、 反応容器中のハロゲン化銀粒子を成長させるハロゲン化 銀粒子乳剤の製造方法。

rows.title: Method for reducing granular noise in radiograph
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a natural image with high image quality by adding random noise to smoothed image data. CONSTITUTION:An accumulating phosphor sheet 1 is scanned by excitation light 5, and stimulated phosphorescent light 9 is received by a photomultiplier 11. The output of the photomultiplier 11 is inputted to an arithmetic part 19 via an amplifier 16, and an A/D converter 17, and a memory 18. At the arithmetic part 19, the smoothed image data is found by applying smoothing processing so as to reduce granular noise on a radiograph, and thereafter, the random noise is added to the smoothed data, then, image processing data can be obtained. The processing image data is sent to an image display means 20.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To fabricate a radiation image conversion panel having a superior clarity and capable of forming superior radiation image. CONSTITUTION:It is concerning a fabrication method of a radiation image conversion panel constituted substantially of a support, a phosphor layer consisting of a combining agent and a stimulated phosphor provided on the support.
