rows.title: Optical branching device, optical data bus, and signal processor
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain the optical branching device which can prevent a defect in signal light transmission, projects signal light with nearly uniform intensity, and has high use efficiency for the light by equipping a light-transmissive medium propagating the signal light by the repetition of internal reflection, with plural projection parts which emit part of the signal light to the outside. SOLUTION: The optical branching device 10 is formed of a light-transmission medium which has a slanting surface 100 at one end and also has a uniform refractive index and is almost in a quadrangular prism shape. On the top surface 101, linear light projection parts 121 to 123 are formed which extend along the width of the optical branching device 10. The light projection parts 121 to 123 have projection opening parts formed of refracting surfaces 111 to 113 crossing the slanting surface 100 at right angles. The refracting surfaces are formed of one internal surface of a linear V groove. Light which is made incident vertically on the slanting surface 100 is totally reflected by the reverse surface 102.  Part of the totally reflected light is projected from the refracting surface 111 of the light projection part 121 and the rest is totally reflected by the top surface 101 and propagated to the reverse surface 102.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a optically coupled element that a signal light propagating at a propagating angle beyond a prescribed propagating angle range can be prevented from outgoing to an optical element and which is miniaturized by providing a light transmitting body having plural specific faces with refractivity larger than that of a light transmitting medium. SOLUTION: An optically coupled element 2 is provided with a light transmitting body having an incident face 3, reflecting surface 4, and outgoing face 5 with refractivity larger than that of a light transmitting medium. The incident face 3 makes a signal light propagating in a free space incident to the inside part of the opticaly coupled element 2, and reflects the signal light temporarily made incident inside and returned to the incident face 3 to the inside part of the optically coupled element. The reflecting surface 4 which is inclined only at an angle β to the input reflects the signal light made incident on the incident face 3 within a prescribed propagating angle range for an arrow 1 to the incident face 3 side, and introduces the signal light to a direction with a wider interval between the reflecting surface 4 and the incident face 3.  The outgoing face 5 makes the light signal introduced to the direction with the wider interval between the incident face 3 and the reflecting surface 4 outgo to a light receiving element 6.

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve light use efficiency.SOLUTION: A light source device 13 that supplies illumination light to a light guide 43 of an endoscope 10 includes a light-emitting device 66, a fluorescent body 36, and a light guide rod 40. The light-emitting device 66 has a laser diode LD1 that emits excitation light for the fluorescent body 36. The light guide rod 40 includes an incident end surface 70, an emission end surface 71, and a side surface 72 that connects the incident end surface 70 and the emission end surface 71, and guides the light incident from the incident end surface 70 to the emission end surface 71 while totally reflecting it, the side surface 72 being a shape tapered with respect to the optical axis so that the area of the emission end surface 71 is larger than that of the incident end surface 70. The incident end surface 70 is optically connected to a light emitting surface 69 of the fluorescent body 36. In the range from the incident end surface 70 to midway toward the emission end surface 71, a reflection film 73 is formed on the whole periphery of the side surface 72.

rows.title: Cache structure in multiprocessor
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To easily confirm the necessity and unnecessity of the writing of data to a cache memory and to decrease the number of accesses to a main memory by providing a flag area, which corresponds to a data area, in a local cache, transferring the changed data, to which the flag is caused to stand, and flag information through a system bus to another processor and copying the data and information. CONSTITUTION:Local caches 2a and 2b are provided in the respective insides of plural processors 1a and 1b of a multiprocessor system and data areas 3a and 3b and flag areas 2a and 2b are respectively arranged in the respective local caches 2a and 2b. When the data of the area 3a or 3b are changed, the flag is caused to stand to show that the data are changed in the area 4a or 4b to correspond to the data and the changed data and flag information are transferred through a system bus 8 to another processor 1b or 1a and copied. Then, whether the main memory is written or not is confirmed by the local caches 1b or 1a.

rows.title: Program reading control circuit
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To attain the reading at a high speed even with use of a low-speed ROM by providing in parallel plural memories which store previously programs of the same contents and then outputting these programs selectively if necessary. CONSTITUTION:Address latch signals g0-gn which are outputted from buffer circuits 50-1-50-n are supplied to program memories 10-1-10-n which store previously microprograms of the same contents, and the storage contents P0-Pn are outputted. A sequence control part 40 and above-mentioned buffer circuits are controlled with the clock signal outputted from a timing generating circuit 70. The contents of storage are selected by a register circuit 20 on the basis of the controlsignal M outputted from the part 40. Then the high-speed reading is possible although the working speed of each memory is low by actuating plural memories in parallel.

rows.title: Storage device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve operation efficiency by allowing a memory to access itself and generate and transmit an overflow signal to access the remaining data in other memory when an address signal to the former memory causes an overflow. CONSTITUTION:Memories 210, 220, 230... are equipped with address overflow detecting means. For example, if the memory 210 is not capable of outputting all necessary data when an address for reading and writing close to the upper limit of its address range is specified, the memory outputs only its holding data and sends the address overflow signal OFO to the memory 220 with adjacent addresses, which outputs data corresponding to the deficient data of the memory 210. Consequently, the reading or writing of data starting at an optional address is performed to improve the operation efficiency and the effective use of storage areas.

rows.title: Memory controller
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make a storage means for every memory block unnecessary by providing a memory controller with a buffer of a first in first out FIFO memory and reading out data from the buffer memory at the timing of a prescribed memory cycle. CONSTITUTION:When the second memory access to the first memory block #1 is requested, execution stop of system execution clocks is indicated to a processor 24 from the first memory block #1 by a control bus 21. Read for the first memory access to the first memory block #1 is performed by a read control bus 25, and simultaneously, data is stacked in an FIFO memory 26. Similarly, the second and following data of the first memory block #1 are taken into the FIFO26 successively and are stacked in order. Read of the first data of the first memory block #1 out of these data is indicated by a control line after three steps, and this data is fetched into the processor 24.

rows.title: Virtual storage computer system
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To supply a virtual storage computer system which can improve operation speed by means of reducing the frequency of address conversion from a virtual memory to a real memory. CONSTITUTION:A processor 11 accesses the virtual address of a corresponding global frame on the virtual memory 17 at the time of executing a program module stored in a main storage device 13. A map table 19 is referred to as to initial access by a certain program module so as to obtain a real address concerned on the real memory 18. The real address obtained at that time is stored in a cache register 14. The map table 19 is not successively referred to as to second and succeeding accesses but the target real address is directly calculated based on the real address which is cached, whereby the real memory 18 is accessed.

rows.title: File version management device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To secure the matching of versions between a host and a terminal and to reduce the version management load by storing the updating degree information as long as the change of this information is designated after a file of unupdated terminals is updated. CONSTITUTION:When the updating or such a degree that requires the change of the major number of a file stored in a file storing part 207 is carried out, an updating information storage part 201 is initialized and an updating degree storage part 204 is checked in sequence for all terminals recorded at the part 201. If a major column is turned on and a selected unupdated terminal is operating at the part 204, the occurrence of updating is reported to a terminal by an updating occurrence reporting part 202. Then a file transfer part 203 transfers the relevant file to the terminal. This file is received by the file reception part of the terminal and stored in a file storing part 303 through the updating processing. When all updating processes are finished, these results are reported to a host by an updating result reporting part 302.

rows.title: Controlling method of rotation type memory
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To evade the transfer omission of a time-series signal by eliminating the need to take a long time for access to a substitute sector even when a defective spot characteristic to a rotation type memory is present on a storage medium. CONSTITUTION:When a track write command is supplied to an input port 102 externally, a CPU 114 selects a specified track in response to the command. If the write command is supplied while a head runs on some sector on some track, the CPU 114 detects the next index to the sector to discriminate the address of the new sector. A substitute table is searched by the sector address and when the sector is an unused sector 412 or a bad sector, the next sector is waited for. When the sector is usable, a status display part is checked and when a bit W is ''0'', data is read out of a buffer 106A or 106B and written in the sector.

rows.title: Shared memory control system
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To perform the distribution processing of the access from two masters such as CPU and DMA and to eliminate the competition for a memory by dividing a memory bank into two and providing the system with the doubled memory banks. CONSTITUTION:The shared memory is divided into mutually independent two 0-th memory bank 650 and 1st memory bank 651. These memory banks 650 and 651 shares one part or all of the address space. The connection of buses 14 and 16 for the memory banks 650 and 651 is exclusively performed one by one. For example, the system bus 14 is connected to the 0-th memory bank 650 through a 0-th selector 630, the DMA bus 16 is connected to the memory bank 651 through the 1st selector 631. Thus, the access from the two masters such as the CPU and DMA devices is distributedly performed and the competition for the memory can be deleted.

rows.title: Digital filter integrated circuit device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To decrease number of terminals and to improve the integration efficiency by writing once a write data, giving it to a data shift register and writing the data simultaneously to all lookup table RAMs. CONSTITUTION:After a write data is shifted out in write data shift registers 16-1 to 16-5 corresponding to lookup table RAMs 3-1 to 3-5, the data is written. Since the built-in lookup table RAMs 3-1 to 3-5 are all in the chip enable state, the write is implemented simultaneously by a common read/write signal. Thus, a signal comprising plural bits making each of the lookup table RAMs 3-1 to 3-5 into the chip enable state individually is not required. Thus, number of terminals is less and the integration efficiency is improved.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To easily change a constitutive state corresponding to the instruction of a user after starting by shortening starting time in the case of system start and preventing abnormality in start by stably starting a system while being exactly reflected with a state before stop and holding the instruction contents of the user before stop when starting the system. CONSTITUTION: A multitask system is provided with a task information storage part 12 for storing the information of respective tasks, task state storage part 13 for storing the state of start/stop of each task, and initialize task 16 for reading an information table and a state table when starting the system, starting the task of 'start' and not starting the task of 'stop' based on the information table while referring to the state of start/stop of each task at the time of last system stop required for the system, after the system is started, the started task is managed and the stored contents in the task state storage part are edited (changed).

rows.title: Memory device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the using efficiency of a memory which stores n-notation data by dividing this data into groups every P pieces and also m-notation memories into groups every Q pieces and securing prescribed relations among these values (n), (m), P and Q respectively. CONSTITUTION:When the n-notation data is written on an m-notation memory 3, the n-notation data train is converted into P pieces of n-notation parallel data by an S/P converter 1 and then into Q pieces of m-notation parallel data by an n/m converter 2. These converted parallel data are stored in a parallel memory 3. When the n-notation data given from the memory 3 is reproduced, the Q pieces of m-notation parallel data are read out of the memory 3. These parallel data are turned into P pieces of n-notation parallel data by an m/n converter 4 and then reproduced to an n-notation data string by a P/S converter 5. Here the relation between the data and the memory 3 is set so as to satisfy (mQ-nP)>=0.

rows.title: Memory control circuit
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To control an external RAM commonly with different control means to improve the operation efficiency by connecting a data selector to a bus connected to the external RAM and connecting selectively the bus which is connected to plural control means respectively to the bus connected to the RAM. CONSTITUTION:A data selector 21 is connected to an address bus 24, which is connected to an external RAM 12 of a memory control circuit, to select data to be supplied to the RAM 12. Address information from a CPU 19 and an external address control circuit 29 connected to address busses 22 and 23 are supplied to this selector 21. Data 28 from an external device 27 is supplied to a data bus 13 through an input port 15 and is supplied to the CPU 19 and the RAM 12. A write indication signal 33 from the CPU 19 is supplied to the selector 21 and the circuit 29, and busses 22 and 23 are selected by the selector 21 to perform the data write from the bus 13 to the RAM 12 under the control of the circuit 29, thus reducing the burden of the CPU 19 to improve the operation efficiency.

rows.title: Resource control device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To efficiently utilize a resource by setting up and controlling the storage period of the resource taken in a storage position by an icon taking-in means. CONSTITUTION:A resource icon such as a document is taken in a storage position icon for displaying a temporary storage position of a document or the like by the icon taking-in means 24 for taking-in a required icon among resource icons in the storage position icon. The number of icons to be displayed on a display 21 is practically reduced and the storage periods of the resources icon taken in by the means 24 is set up by a storage period setting means 25. Namely, the storage periods of respective resources of a dust box icon or the like are set up. Consequently, all the resources are not collectively erased in error, and when the set period has elapsed, these resources can be erased by a proper means such as an alarm display or transferred to another storage medium.

rows.title: Network system
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the efficiency of the development and maintenance of software by automatically performing the management and installation of the software. CONSTITUTION:A file server 2 to store the software, and a storage means 10 to store the information of an installation destination work station name at every software are provided. Also, means 9, 8 which automatically install the software on a work station 1 whose installation is required by referring to the content of the storage means 10 at every storage of new software in the file server 2 are provided. Namely, when the new software is released, the information of a file name and the installation destination work station name at every software are referred from the storage device 10, and the new software is automatically installed on an object work station 1 based on those information. Thereby, the efficiency of the development and maintenance of the software can be improved, and also, response to a request from a user can be attained at early stages.

rows.title: Memory controller
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve data transfer capacity and memory using efficiency by using an operatable memory in each nibble unit and executing arbitration in each nibble unit. CONSTITUTION:At the time of receiving an access request from a section A, an access determining means (arbitor) 11 accepts the access request and informs the request to a nibble unit detecting circuit 12A. A controller 13 allows the section A to execute access to a memory 14 in accordance with the reception of the access to transfer data. The circuit 12A counts up the number of memory accesses by using the contents of a nibble bit as an initial value, and when the count value reaches the nibble unit, outputs an end signal to the arbitor 11. When an access request from a section B is received, the controller 13 accepts the access request and allows the section B to execute access to the memory 14.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To permit the efficient writing of data with a memory size of a small capacity as well as the control of an address with a simple constitution by a method wherein the title device is controlled so that a writing line will never exceed a reading line, depending on the contents of counting. CONSTITUTION:The time division treatments of writing and reading are effected. When the number of reading lines has exceeded N lines (>=2), N line writing process can be effected if N line writing can be effected in the disable period of time of a L and a SYNC. In this case, a memory control unit 1 monitors the code bit of a U/D counter 7 so that the number of writing lines will never exceed the number of reading lines and executes the writing by receiving a writing request WRLN only upon a minus code.

rows.title: Cache memory device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten the processing time of the whole system by detecting which block of a cache memory each bus accesses and rewriting the contents of the dual port cache memory at the same time when a different block is accessed. CONSTITUTION:A processor address 1 and a system bus address 4 are compared by comparators 10-12 to detect which data block of the cache memory 27 each bus accesses. Then, when a different block from the cache memory 27 is detected being accessed, the dual port is employed and the same contents are rewritten in different data blocks of the cache memory 27. Consequently, even if one bus is in process of rewriting the contents of the cache memory, the other bus can advances its process, so that the total processing time is shortened.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To keep the quality of pictures for a long period by providing an auxiliary trimming member in a part of the peripheral area of a developing roll so that this trimming member is deflected in the direction opposite to the toner carrying direction with respect to a trimming member and making the gap between the auxiliary trimming member and the peripheral face of the developing roll wider than that between the trimming member and the peripheral face of the developing roll. CONSTITUTION:A toner supplied from a hopper part 4 is held on a developing roll 3 as shown by an arrow (a) and passes parts where an auxiliary trimming member 20 and a trimming member 5 are arranged, and thereafter, the toner is carried to a developing part between the developing roll 3 and a photosensitive drum 2. At this time, the surface of the toner layer on the developing roll 3 is first scraped by the auxiliary trimming member 20, and the thickness of the toner layer becomes delta', and the surface of the toner layer is next scraped by the trimming member 5, and the thickness of the toner layer becomes a trimming gap delta (delta'>delta). Thus, the toner layer on the developing roll 3 has a certain thickness, and stable pictures are obtained.

rows.title: Method and device for development
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a developing bias from being discharged and to form a uniform image having no development irregularity by forming a thin and uniform toner layer on the surface of a toner carrier by a layer control member, and sending the toner layer to an electrostatic latent image holder which forms an electrostatic latent image on the surface and applying the developing bias to the toner carrier. CONSTITUTION:The rolled toner carrier 2 is structured having a semiconductor layer 6 on the surface of a developing electrode 8 and arranged opposite the electrostatic latent image holder 4 which holds the electrostatic latent image across a development gap (d). Toner 3 is carried as the toner layer on the semiconductor layer 6 of the toner carrier 2 by a toner supply roll 7 and the layer control member 1 and electrostatic charging is performed at the same time. The developing electrode 8 of the toner carrier 2, on the other hand, is applied with a bias voltage on which a rectangular alternating electric field is superposed by a developing bias power source 9. The toner layer which is carried to a development area by the rotation of the toner carrier is scattered to the electrostatic latent image holder 4 and the electrostatic latent image 5 is visualized. Consequently, the image with high resolving power having no dot deformation is obtained.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To supply a developer to a carrier stably and to obtain an excellent image by pressing a leveling member against the carrier and setting the contact depth between the leveling member and carrier within a specific range. CONSTITUTION:The carrier 5 and leveling member 4 are provided under a hopper 2. The carrier 5 and leveling member 4 are pressed against each other while carrying a developer 1 and the carrier 5 and leveling member 4 are rotated as shown by arrows A and B respectively; the 1st blade 31 contacts the carrier 5 and the 2nd blade 32 contacts the leveling member 4. The contact depth between the carrier 5 and leveling member 4 is set to about 0.3 - about 2.0mm.. Consequently, the developer is supplied stably to the carrier 5 by the leveling member 4. Consequently, a solid-black image with high density and wide area is reproduced faithfully and an excellent image is obtained.

The leveling member 4' is formed by winding and adhering the conductive foamed body 4B' on a mandrel 4A'.

The leveling member 4' is constituted by forming the elastic body by winding and adhering an urethane foamed body 3B' on a mandrel 4A' and covering the surface of the obtained elastic body with conductive rubber 4C' to 1mm. thickness. When the leveling member 4' and carrier 5 are rubbed against each other, the carrier 5 contacts the leveling member 4' sufficiently without flexing even if the leveling member 4' is pressed strongly, so no developer falls from between the carrier 5 and leveling member 4'.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the fluidity of a developer to keep it uniform by separating the residue of a toner, which is supplied from a roll to develop a latent image on a photosensitive drum in a developing part, from a sleeve by a magnet provided on the outside of a housing. CONSTITUTION:The developer is supplied to a photosensitive drum 1 from a pickup magnet 12 of a fixed magnet cylinder 10 by a sleeve 11 rotated in the direction of an arrow to develop the latent image on the drum 1, and a magnet 16 is provided in the position, where the developer is not supplied from a pick off magnet 13, on the outside of a housing 3 near the developing part. The developer remaining on the sleeve 11 is separated from the sleeve 11 by the magnetic force of the magnet 16 and is fed to a mixer 6 through a paddle wheel 5. Thus, the unused developer is prevented from being formed to blocks, and the fluidity is improved to keep the developer uniform, and the life is extended.

rows.title: Non-magnetic one component developing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To constitute a titled device so that a carrying quantity of a developer carried toward a holding body of an electrostatic latent image is contant at all times, and to execute a uniform and stable development by setting a surface roughness of a developer carrying surface to within a specified range. CONSTITUTION:When moving onto an outside peripheral surface 6c of a carrying body roll 6 from a carrying roll 5, a developer 2 is brought to triboelectrification by a slide-contact of both the rolls 5, 6, and a sufficient charge is given. rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable reproduction of a solid black image having high density and wide area with fidelity by providing a leveling member which supplies a developer to a carrying body and recovers the same therefrom prior to formation of a thin layer of the developer on the carrying body by a regulating member. The member 4 is made into the shape consisting of an elastic material 4b adhered into a cylindrical shape to an arbor 4a. The developer 1 is frictionally electrified and is impressed with charge by the sliding contact with the member 4 and the body 5 and thereafter the developer layer of the thin layer having a prescribed thickness is formed by a regulating member 31. The developer failing to contribute to the development remains in a nonuniform state on the body 5, but a part thereof is recovered by the member 4 and the developer 1 is supplied by the member 4 to the part where the developer does not exist. The developer is thus corrected to approximately the uniform state and is eventually fed to the member 31.

rows.title: Developing method
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make a developer ambipolar and multifunctional by preliminarily apply electric charge to a toner by an external electric field in the preceding stage of a developing nip and applying electric charge to the toner by a latent image electric field in the developing nip to develop an electrostatic latent image. CONSTITUTION:A layer thickness control member 5 in connected to a developing bias power source 6, and a voltage is applied between the member 5 and a developing roll 2. The thickness of the developer layer formed on a cylindrical sleeve 3 of the developing roll 2 is controlled by the layer thickness control member 5, and a bias voltage is applied to the layer thickness control member 5 by the bias power source 6 to generate an electric field between the nonmagnetic sleeve 3 and the layer thickness control member 5, and toner particles are electrified in this electric field. The developer on the sleeve reaches a developing nip 10, and the toner is furthermore electrified by the developing electric field in the nip, and the electrostatic latent image on a photosensitive body is developed by the sufficiently electrified toner. Thus, the developer has the ambipolar property and is made multifunctional for image forming.

The device described above visualizes the electrostatic latent image formed on the electrostatic latent image member by sticking the developer having the charges on the developer carrying member 4 to the electrostatic latent image within the electric field formed in the developing region where the developer carrying member 4 and the electrostatic latent image holder face in proximity to each other.  The developer carrying member 4 is formed by coating the surface of a substrate 11 consisting of a conductive material with a surface layer 12 contg. at least a binder resin 13, carbon black 14 and conductive carbon beads 15 formed by baking polymer beads.

This fur brush 30 rotates in the same direction as a rotary sleeve 11, separates developed toner from the rotary sleeve 11 in the middle between the magnetic poles N1 and S2 of a fixed magnet 12, and supplies toner in the storage part 20 to the rotary sleeve 11. The fur brush 30 comes into contact with a part of a housing 40 (projection 41), and prevents a leak of toner in the storage part 20 when it is carried. Further, the bristles 32 of the fur brush 30 are made of a material which promotes the electrification of toner on a electrification line.

Generation of the loose winding by the oscillation during transportation is thereby prevented.

CONSTITUTION:The nozzle 5 integrating the blowing port 3 and suction port 4 continuously removing with suction the foreign matter on a metal strip plate 1 is arranged near the inlet port where the metal strip plate 1 approaches a work roll 7. The foreign matter on the strip plate 1 to which the airstream injected from an injection port 3 is proceeding is continuously cut off and the suction port 4 catches the air and foreign matter without fail. The foreign matter on the strip plate 1 is thus removed at the front of the work roll inlet port to prevent the damage of a work roll and the generation of a flaw on the strip plate.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a slippage in winding and longitudinal wrinkling from occurring, by using rolls each having its diameter which increases toward the center section of te roll from each end thereof, as a spool core and a path roll which is arranged in the vicinity of the spool core. CONSTITUTION:A web 1 is wound up on a spool core 2 by way of a path roll 3. In this arrangement, a crown rolls each having a wind-up shaft section whose diameter increases toward the center section from each end thereof (the diameter is increased by 0.1-10mm with respect to the width of a roll which is 1m), are used as the spool core 2 and the pass roll 3. As a result, the tension in the center section of the web 1 may be increased so that the center section is firmly wound up in comparison with the other sections, and therefore, there is a less possibility of occurrence of a slippage in winding even though the tension in winding is low. Further, since the center section of the web is firmly wound up while edge sections are slackly wound up, air introduced by the web may be easily relieved from the center section to the edge section thereof, and therefore, there is a less possibility of occurrence of longitudinal wrinkles.

rows.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To conduct light measurement by using light of an appropriate luminescence wavelength based on light transmission property of a part to be measured and the like.  <P>SOLUTION: Excitation light emitted from a semiconductor laser 102 is made incident on an optical fiber 101 of which core is evenly dispersed with lead sulfide nanoparticle group controlled to have a radius 5.75 nm to 7.1 nm. The nanoparticle group is optically excited, fluorescence is emitted and a wide band low coherence light L1 of 1 μm to 1.2 μm, most appropriate for measurement of a living body and the like is emitted from an end of the optical fiber 101 and introduced to a fiber 204 of a fiber joint optical system 20. By controlling the radius of the nanoparticle group, light of intended wavelength band and spectral width can be emitted from a light source 10. In a fiber coupler 201, the low coherence light L1 is separated into a measurement light L3 to be radiated to a part 1 to be measured and a reference light L2. A measurement light L4 reflected by a predetermined deep part of the part 1 to be measured and the reference light 2 are coupled and light intensity of an interference light is detected by a balance difference detection part 50 and image processing is conducted to obtain an optical tomographic image.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

rows.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sensor capable of detecting highly efficiently fluorescence emitted from a fluorescent label with high S/N ratio, and capable of dispensing with a complicated optical system for the detection.  <P>SOLUTION: This sensor 1 has a sensing surface 1s bonded only with a specific substance R to be detected, and a metal portion 20 with at least a portion exposed on the sensing surface 1s and capable of exciting a localized plasmon. rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an endoscope light source device, an endoscope system, and an operation method of the endoscope light source device capable of adjusting a contrast of a blood vessel flexibly, according to depth and thickness under a mucosa.SOLUTION: An endoscope light source device comprises: a first light source 20a for emitting V-light having a depth resolution with respect to blood vessels under a mucosa which are observation targets; a second light source 20b for emitting a white light having a continuous spectrum with a wider band wider than that of the V-light; a Bs-light generation band restriction filter 25 for generating, from the white light, Bs-light having a thickness resolution with respect to the blood vessels under the mucosa which exist at a same depth; a light amount ratio setting part 23 for setting a light amount ratio of the V-light and Bs-light, and setting a blood vessel contrast to the mucosa to a target contrast according to depth and thickness of the blood vessels; and a light source control part 22 for controlling the first and second light sources, using the light amount ratio set by the light amount ratio setting part 23.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 16

CONSTITUTION:A hierarchical data managing part 1 manages nodes and links constituting hierarchical structure together with plural link types. A formation format setting part 4 sets up conversion information for document preparation in each of plural link types. rows.title: Facsimile equipment
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To allow a sender side to easily specify a return sheet. CONSTITUTION:A received document is stored in a picture information memory 2 and its attribute is stored in a memory management section 16. An ID number indicating a sender of a stored document and an ID entered from an operation section 6 are compared at an ID comparator section 18. When the both are coincident, the stored document is read by a return sheet generating section 20 by using the ID as a retrieval key. The return sheet generating section generates a return sheet including a reduced picture of the stored document and stores it to a picture information memory 2. The return document read by a read section 1 and the return sheet are sent to a destination according to a transmission command entered from an operation section 6. The destination receiving the return document easily specify a document of a return object based on the reduced picture of the return sheet.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a document processor capable of recognizing a document image expressed by common allocation structure prior to the practical allocation of an individual document. CONSTITUTION:A designating means 112 designates a node in the common allocation structure stored in a common allocation information storing means 11. A position display means 113 outputs the node designated by the means 112 and a node relating to the node concerned. A slave element formation rule display means 114 outputs a salve element formation rule relating to at least a part of a node group displayed by the means 113. A page image display means 115 outputs a plane position relation in a rectangular area held by the slave node of a page node corresponding to the node designated by the means 112. Output information from these means 113, 114, 115 is inputted and displayed to/on a display device 103 through an I/O control part 104.

rows.title: Output device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To output each page of image data to a desired page depending on designation information by deciding to which page each page of the image data is composited by an output decision means. CONSTITUTION: An output page decision means 16 places priority on designation information received by a host interface (I/F) 11a from designation information received by a designation information input means 15. When a host device 20 sends image data comprising plural pages and designation information corresponding to each page of the image data, an output device 10 uses the host I/F 11a to store the data tentatively to a storage means such as a hard disk. When reduced information is received by a designation information input means 15, the information is stored in a register in an output page decision means 16. A display page designation means 18 stores display information to a storage means by the user.  Then an image processing means 12 extracts the data from the 1st page sequentially, the data are processed by an image expansion section 12a and recognized by a recognition means 14 and the result is outputted.

rows.title: Document preparation supporting device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To easily prepare a document excellent in outward appearance even in the case an implementor has no editorial design knowledge by inferring with document information such as the contents of the document or the attribute and document design knowledge information, and deciding an optimum design. CONSTITUTION:This document preparation supporting device is composed of a display part 1, document storage part 2, knowledge data base 3 and document design decision part 4. The document storage part 2 stores code data or graphic data prepared by a word processor, etc., generally electronized document such as the kind of the document, the data of preparation and the usage, and data expressing additional information as the document information. The knowledge data base 3 stores knowledge specifying evaluation words and mutual relation between document design elements and document attributes as the document design knowledge information. The document design decision part 4 decides the document design according to forward inference or backward inference based on the document information.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To provide a document preparation support device which supports document preparation by deciding a category during the document preparation by using a cooccurrence dictionary and indicating cooccurrence words specified in the decided category. rows.title: Document editing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate a layout work at the time of preparing a document by executing a layout processing by designating a layout name as one of attributes of the document at the time of preparing the document. CONSTITUTION:The device is constituted of a keyboard 15 being a layout name setting means, a layout information defining part 14 being a layout information storage means, a layout determining part 13 being a layout determining means, a layout processing part 12 being a layout processing means, etc. By the layout name setting means 15, a layout name is set as an attribute of a document, and in the layout information storage means 14, the layout name and its layout information are related and stored. The layout determining means 13 fetches and determines the layout information, based on the layout name, and allows the layout processing means 12 to execute a layout processing of a document, based on the layout information. In this case, instead of the layout determining means 13, it is also possible that a layout inference mechanism infers the layout information in accordance with knowledge determined in advance, for example, a rule.

rows.title: Kana/kanji converting device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To perform the KANA (Japanese syllabary)/KANJI (Chinese character) conversion at a high speed by copying a word dictionary of an external memory like a hard disk, etc., to a main memory like a RAM, etc. CONSTITUTION:When a document is produced by a word processor, a keyboard menu 71 displayed on the screen of a CRT 7 is clicked by a mouse 3a for selection of 'dictionary memory' of a keyboard menu 72. In this case, a CPU 1 checks the memory capacity of a RAM disk 10 and copies a word dictionary for KANA/KANJI conversion stored in a hard disk 6 to the disk 10 when the memory capacity of the disk 10 has its margin. As a result, the KANA/KANJI conversion processing is possible with an access given to the disk 10. Thus the access time is omitted to the disk 6 and therefore the KANA/KANJI conversion processing time is extremely reduced.

rows.title: Dictionary retrieving device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the checking such as the wastefull connection testing and to make the memory to hold an intermediate results into the necessary minimum limit by selecting with plural features of the word of the retrieving result in the case that plural retrieving results when the dictionary content of a heading coincident from the head of the retrieving object character string is retrieved exist. CONSTITUTION:For example, at the time of a retrieving object character string, that is to say, a high income (KOU SHO TOKU), the dictionary content of the heading coincident from the head becomes ('KOU'(high) prefix) ('TAKA'(high) adjective) and ('KOUSHO' noun). Next, since ('KOU'(high) prefix) is obtained when the content for which the speech part is the prefix or the adverb is searched, out of the shortest and coincident dictionary content this is stored. Continuously, when the shortest and coincident dictionary content is removed from the first dictionary content and ('KOU'(high) prefix) stored now is combined, ('KOU'(high) prefix) ('KOU SHO' noun) are obtained, and this is outputted as a primary result. Then, the retrieving leak of ('KOU'(high) prefix) caused by the longest coincident system is prevented and the extra retrieving result, that is to say, ('TAKA'(high) adjective) is not outputted.

rows.title: Kana to kanji converter
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the efficiency of a conversion work by deciding a composite word intended by an operator from a result of conversion of KANA (Japanese syllabary) to KANJI (Chinese character) and registering it automatically in a dictionary. CONSTITUTION:The converter is provided with a CPU (central processing unit) 21, a disk controller 23, a display control part 24, a RAM 25, a keyboard/mouse control part 26, a disk 27 being an external storage device, and a display part 28. In such a state, whether an unconverted character is contained in a converted character-string or not is detected, and in the case the unconverted character is contained, whether the character converted in the next time is that which is obtained by further converting the unconverted character or not is decided. Simultaneously, whether an inputted KANA character-string is divided into plural KANA character-strings and converted separately or not is decided. Subsequently, at the time point when it is detected that the unconverted character is eliminated, a composite word obtained by synthesizing the divided and converted words and reading corresponding thereto are registered in a dictionary, respectively. In such a way, the work efficiency of a conversion processing can be improved remarkably.

rows.title: Japanese word processor
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To attain a sorting job, the production of a list based on KANJI (Chinese characters) by using a KANJI/KANA (Japanese syllabary) conversion dictionary. CONSTITUTION:When a sentence of only KANJI or a sentence containing HIRAGANA (Japanese syllabary), KATAKANA (square forms of Japanese syllabary), etc. is supplied through a KANJI input part 1, these sentences are stored in a sentence memory part 2 in the form of the corresponding KANJI and character codes. When a sorting job, the production of a list, etc. are needed for the stored KANJI, a KANJI/KANA conversion key 11 is operated to read successively the KANJI codes out of a KANJI buffer 3. Then the corresponding KANA codes are detected through a conversion table of a KANJI/KANA conversion dictionary 4 and sent to a KANA buffer 5. These KANA codes are read out of the buffer 5 in a sorting or list production mode. The result of the sorting job or the result of production of a list is outputted to an output part 6.

rows.title: Japanese word processor
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To attain list processing with KANJI (Chinese characters) by storing KANA (Japanese syllabary) and its converted KANJI, adding a code to each character of a sentence based on those stored KANA and KANJI and adding the reading start and end codes to KANJI reading. CONSTITUTION:A sentence containing HIRAGANA (Japanese syllabary) and KANJI is supplied from a KANA input part 1 in the form of a KANA sentence. For the KANJI part, a KANJI conversion key 11 is operated after the Japanese reading of the KANJI is supplied in HIRAGANA. Then the corresponding KANJI is detected through a KANA/KANJI conversion dictionary 3. The HIRAGANA supplied through the part 1 are stored succeedingly to a HIRAGANA buffer 2. While the converted KANJI is stored in a KANJI buffer 4. When the reference is desired to the reading of the input KANJI, both the reading start and codes are used to convert the KANJI into the KANA. Thus the KANJI can be applied to a sorting job, the production of a list, etc.

rows.title: Kana and kanji converting device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To execute KANA (Japanese syllabary)-KANJI (Chinese character) conversion at a high speed by retrieving the stored contents of a dictionary to correspond to a specified filed to be designated and executing the KANA- KANJI conversion from inputted character information to a desired character string when there is no homonym to correspond to the inputted character information in the stored contents of a basic vocabulary KANJI dictionary. CONSTITUTION:When the KANA-KANJI conversion is executed from the inputted character information to the desired character string, the storing contents of a basic vocabulary KANJI dictionary 15C are retrieved at first. When there is no homonym to correspond to the inputted character information in the stored contents of this basic vocabulary KANJI dictionary 15C, the stored contents of dictionaries 15A (technique) and 15B (commerce), which are correspond to the specified field to be designated, are retrieved and the KANA- KANJI conversion is executed from the inputted character information to the desired character string. Thus, by designating the field of a document to be prepared by an operator, a processing speed can be improved in the case of the KANA-KANJI conversion and efficient document preparation can be executed.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To define a desired KANJI(Chinese character) inscription by inputting first several characters of reading when the reading corresponding to a prescribed character inscription is so long, displaying a KANJI inscription containing the reading as a candidate by issuing an estimate conversion instruction, and selecting a desired KANJI out of the KANJI inscriptions. CONSTITUTION:A conversion controller 5, in the case of receiving the KANJI inscription group of a conversion candidate from an inclusion word retriever 7, holds the KANJI inscription group once in a buffer, then, sends it to a display device 3. The conversion controller 5 defines a selected KANJI inscription and holds it in the buffer by selecting the desired KANJI inscription out of the KANJI inscription group of the conversion candidate displayed on the display device 3 by a user. A defined KANJI inscription is fetched in a document replying to, for example, a defined character string request from a document editing device not shown in figure which edits a converted character string according to a format set in advance to the conversion controller 5. In such a manner, the selected KANJI inscription can be defined.

rows.title: Document processor
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce burden for a user to register relation information in the case of Japanese syllabary (KANA)/Chinese character (KANJI) conversion at the document processor provided with a function to utilize the information of relation between words for selecting the candidate of homonyms. CONSTITUTION:A character string fixed by KANA/KANJI conversion is sent to a morpheme analyzer 13, and morpheme analysis is performed. The morpheme analyzer 13 extracts a pair of words in modification relation from the character string of the analyzed result and stores them through a modification information controller 16 into a modification information storage part 17. The modification information controller 16 checks whether the use frequency of stored paired words exceeds a prescribed threshold value or not and when the use frequency of those paired words exceeds the threshold value, the paired words are extracted from the modification information storage part 17 and registered through a modification information dictionary controller 19 to a relation information dictionary 18.

rows.title: Kana/kanji converter
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the operability of KANA (Japanese syllabary)/KANJI (Chinese character) converter by providing a dictionary part in which a reading KANA is stored, and providing a candidate display means for displaying in the lump candidates, in the case plural pieces of candidates of the same sound word exist in said dictionary part. CONSTITUTION:In a reading KANA storage part 15, a reading KANA dictionary is stored. When a key input is a reading KANA conversion key, the reading KANA dictionary is refered to by an input character-string, and the number of reading KANAs is derived. When the number of reading KANAs is one, its reading KANA is inserted into a character-string in a text. When two or more reading KANAs exist, candidates of the reading KANAs are displayed in the lump. Subsequently, the reading KANA selected by a user is inserted into the character-string in the text. For instance, a KANJI notation of 'KANNO' is registered in the reading KANA dictionary by three reading KANAs of 'SUGANO', 'SUGENO' and 'KANNO'. Thereafter, the KANJI notation of 'KANNO' is selected, and when the reading KANA key is depressed, the above mentioned three reading candidates are displayed altogether.

rows.title: Kana/kanji converter
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make effective use of memory resources by referring the storage information of a converted word storage means storing a defined Chinese character(KANJI) expression and its reading, and executing a Chinese character(KANJI)/Japanese syllabary(KANA) conversion by a reading converting means. CONSTITUTION:The KANJI expression and the reading information KANA/ KANJI-converted and defined are corresponded and stored in a converted word storage means 4. And when a reconverting instruction is requested to the specified character string to be a conversion object in a defined document, a reading converting means 23 refers the storage contents of the converted word storing means 4, retrieves the reading character string of the requiring KANJI expression, and reconverts the reading character string as the part of or the all of the input character string in the case the KANJI expression is included in the character string to be the conversion object. Therefore, regarding the defined KANJI expression, the KANJI expression and the reading are registered, and are not registered overlappingly. Thus, it is possible to reduce the storage area storing the reading information of the KANJI expression for processing the KANJI/KANA conversion, and to make effective use of the memory resources.

rows.title: Japanese processing system
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To take off a word composed of normal-use KANJI (Chinese character) and non-normal-use KANJI in a form mixed with normal-use KANJI and KANA (Japanese syllabary) at high speed, and to express the word consisting of only non- normal-use KANJI with only KANA without expressing them in the form of the mixture of normal-use KANJI and KANA when the expression of 'the word consists of normal-use KANJI' is set in a KANJI/KANA conversion. CONSTITUTION:When an operator starts the operation of a Japanese processor, first, an initial menu is displayed, and among them, the information setting option sheet of a used dictionary is displayed. Next, a character converter 2 judges what the set expression is. At such a time, the expression of 'the word consists of normal-use KANJI' is selected, both a first dictionary 5a, which is used for a general word and expressed by normal-use KANJI, and a third dictionary 5c, which is used for the general word and expressed by non-normal-use KANJI, are selected. On the contrary, at the time of the expression of 'the word consists of non-normal KANJI', a second dictionary 5b, which is used for general word and expressed by by the non-normal-use KANJI, is adopted. The inputted character code is searched by a dictionary searching means 14.

rows.title: Document editing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the operability of processing operation for 'KANA' (Japanese syllabary)/'KANJI' (Chinese character) conversion and its working efficiency by reflecting corresponding character attributes to a 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string to execute 'KANA'/'KANJI' conversion. CONSTITUTION:A word to be registered by a registering means 31 is registered in storage means 33, 34 such as a dictionary correspondingly to a reading character string, a 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string and a character attribute specified by a character attribute specifying means 32. At the time of 'KANA'/'KANJI' conversion, the 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string corresponding to the reading character string is retrieved from the means 33, 34 and the retrieved 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string is converted into a character string corresponding to the registered character attribute. Thereby, the 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string having the required character attribute can quickly be obtained without changing the character attribute. Thus, the operability and working efficiency of processing operation such as document preparation and edition can be improved.

rows.title: Kana to kanji converter
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the processing efficiency of a document generation processing and the operability to the correction of a document by selecting a desired sentence clause in an yet undetermined KANJI (Chinese character) mixed character-string and correcting the length of the selected sentence clause. CONSTITUTION:A pointing device such as a mouse 13, selects a desired sentence clause in an undetermined KANJI mixed character-string of KANA (Japanese syllabary) displayed on a display means 18, resets length of the selected sentence clause and corrects length of the sentence clause. Subsequently, a converting means 19 redetermines the sentence clause of the undefined KANJI mixed character-string in accordance with length of the corrected sentence clause, and reconverts the character-string in the redetermined sentence clause to the corresponding KANJI mixed character-string. In such a way, the processing efficiency of generation/editing, etc., of the document and the operability to the correction of the document can be improved.

rows.title: Telephone number informing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To dial assuredly by informing in voices the bar codes recorded on a card like a visiting card, etc. CONSTITUTION:A changeover switch 18 is set to a record mode to record the bar codes corresponding to a telephone number on a card 7. Then the switch 18 is set at the report side, and the card 7 is put into a main body 1 through a slit 4 of an inserting part 1D. Then the bar codes are read by an optical reader 17, and the telephone number corresponding to those codes is displayed at a display part 1B. At the same time, the telephone number is announced through a speaker 6. Thus a telephone dialing operation is possible while listening to the telephone number delivered through the speaker 6. This eliminates a dialing error with telephone numbers.

rows.title: Facsimile connection controller
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve management properties, and to prevent the disappearance of an original by not receiving an incoming call whose designation absence is discriminated by a designation discriminating means, or by receiving it and transferring the original data to a designated host. CONSTITUTION:Facsimile equipments 2-4 detect the incoming call, and transmit an information to a facsimile connection controller 1. The facsimile connection controller 1 accepts the information, and checks whether or not address information (host name) is designated. When the incoming call whose address is not clear is not received, the reception processing is ended, and when the incoming call is received, a receiving job is executed, the original data are received from the facsimiles 2-4, and stored in a memory in the facsimile connection controller 1. Next, the transfer destination host is checked, and the stored original data are transferred. Also, even when the instruction of print or delete is transmitted from the host, the processing is executed according to the instruction.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To allow the operator of a slave set to visit a master set as required and to obtain a hard copy with high picture quality outputted from the master set even when the picture quality of the copy obtained at the slave set is not excellent. CONSTITUTION:When communication indicating transmission of picture information to a specific slave set is made to a master set 1 from another facsimile equipment connecting to a line in a master-slave facsimile system comprising the master set 1 and plural slave sets 2-1 to 2-N whose communication capability is deteriorated than that of the master set 1, at first a transmission station capability discrimination means 61 discriminates the communication capability of a transmission station. The communication capability of the transmission station is compared with the communication capability of the slave set stored in a slave set capability storage means 62 at a comparator means 63. When the communication capability of the transmission station is in excess of the communication capability of the slave set, the picture information sent from the transmission station is converted in response to the capability of the slave set and transferred to the slave set and a hard copy 70 is obtained from an output means 69 by the communication capability of the master set.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To allow the facsimile equipment to confirm whether or not transmis sion documents are all printed out. CONSTITUTION:A sender side A generates communication management information when number of communication results to a same destination reaches a predetermined number or over and the generated communication management information is sent to a receiver side B. The receiver side B stores the received picture information to a picture information memory 2b. When the stored reception information is a usual reception document, a print section 11 prints out the document. On the other hand, the picture information stored in the picture information memory 2b is the communication management information fed from the sender side A, a bar code indicating the content of the communication management information is decoded. The decoded communication management information is fed to a comparator section 21. The communication management information of its own station is fed from a communication management information storage section 19 to the comparator section 21. When there is any reception picture information not printed out yet, a message to inform it is displayed on a display section 7.

CONSTITUTION:An instruction by a multiplex frequency is received. predetermined priority is stored. When both of function setting commands by a multiplex frequency signal and by a conventional procedure are received, the instruction with higher priority is adopted. As a result, when the priority placed on the DTMF signal is known by a sender facsimile equipment, the sender side uses instructions using the DTMF signal independently of a content such as NSS. Furthermore, a non-standard function is used even from a facsimile equipment manufactured by other manufacturer even with the provision of a DTMF signal transmission function.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To increase the opportunity of reception by devising the facsimile equipment such that it can receive a call in place of a unreceptible terminal equipment. CONSTITUTION:Upon the detection of an incoming call, an LAPD/system controller 10 discriminates whether an incoming terminal equipment is busy or receptible, and when busy, a B channel is connected to a main facsimile equipment 5 to allow it to receive the call in deputy. When the main facsimile equipment 5 is busy, an idle terminal equipment is retrieved from other terminal equipments and the controller 10 allows the idle terminal equipment to receive the call in deputy. After the substitute reception, the presence of a document received in deputy is informed to a called terminal equipment and after the busy state of the called terminal equipment is released, the document received in deputy is transferred as required. Or the main facsimile equipment 5 may use its own recording section to print out the document received in deputy or may store the document in its memory.

The dial number (a) and the station identification information (b) stored in the buffer 17 are inputted to a destination information storage section 9 when a gate G is set. A selection signal (d) inputted from an abbreviation function selection key 13 is inputted also to a telephone directory 9 and the storage content is outputted to a display section 11. One of destination information stored in the telephone directory 9 is designated by the designation key 12 and the dial number of the designated destination information is outputted to a call section 16.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To easily identify an original and overlay information attached to the original at a receiving station while economizing paper sheets at the receiving station by transmitting the picture signals of the emphasized overlay information together with the transmitting original. CONSTITUTION:A system control part 1, control panel 2, data storage part 3 and line control part 4 are connected to a system bus 6. The facsimile equipment having the above-mentioned configuration is connected to a telephone line network 5, and desired picture information transmission/reception is executed. When transmitting the picture signal so as to be printed while synthesizing the picture signal of the read transmitting original and that of the overlay information, the picture signal of the overlay information is emphasized and transmitted together with the transmitting original. Thus, paper sheets can be prevented from being wasted at the receiving station side, and the attached overlay information and the transmitting original can be clearly distinguished.

A preset value storage part 21 inputs the information required for the execution of the function, for example, a confidential box number and a password when it is the confidential transmission from the panel, or outputs a value inputted in advance by reading out from memory. Thence, a command generating part 23 generates plural commands by setting one or more pieces of information sequentially on the FIFs of one or plural commands by the decided rule based on the code from the execution function discrimination part 20 and the information from the preset value storage part 21.

rows.title: Communication control system
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the need for a file describing information representing the propriety of communication corresponding to the user by adding information representing the propriety of communication to an external network to existing user information relating to the user and referencing the user information so as to control external communication. CONSTITUTION:A network manager registers in advance information representing the propriety of communication reaching a LAN system 20 as one item of user information relating to the user in a LAN system 10 to a clearing house service(CHS) 13A. When external communication from a W/S 11 (client) to the LAN system 20 takes place, a gateway 12 converts a format of a packet or the like into a protocol suitable on the LAN system 20 and transfers the result to a router 14. The router 14 inquires of the CHS 13A about whether or not the communication to the LAN system 20 is available of the user requesting communication and returns the result to the W/S 11. When the communication is allowed, the W/S 11 continues the packet transmission and when not allowed, the W/S 11 stops the transmission.

rows.title: Communication equipment
rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To provide the communication equipment with which the next block or page is transmitted even without getting a response showing the normal reception of a block or page and image information is outputted in the order of transmission on the reception side even without receiving the image information in that order. CONSTITUTION: A control part 1 controls a facsimile based on the procedure of a G3C protocol and a storage part 2 stores a transmitting command. Corresponding to a responding command, a retrieval part 3 retrieves whether the transmitting command is stored in the storage part 2 or not. A transmitting command information storage part 5 stores information added to the transmitting command and transmission information. A transmission information change part 6 changes this transmission information. A separation control part 7 separates the transmitting command in the storage part 2 from list structure, and an image information storage part 9 stores the received image information. Even when the image information is not received in the proper order, an image information output control part 10 properly outputs that information.  Thus, the transmission/reception of image information can be efficiently controlled.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To execute the number of line counting operation of a received document in parallel with other operations by decoding stored document data and counting the number of lines if a decoding/counting means is in its free state. CONSTITUTION: When the input from a control panel 8 exists, whether prescribed time passes after the input or not is monitored and whether an operator uses this device or not is judged. When it is judged that a decoding/counting part 10 is not in use, the document control table 7a stored in a RAM 7 is referred and the retrieval of the document in which the number of lines is not fixed is performed. At this stage, a decoding is performed while a reception is performed in a line control part 6 in a normal G 3 mode reception and the number of error lines is confirmed. In a G 4 mode reception, data is stored in a storage memory 11 without counting the number of lines. As a result of the retrieval, the document in which the number of lines is not fixed is read from the memory 11, the document is transferred to the decoding/counting part 10, and the number of lines is counted, decoding the document. This work can be performed by using the free time of the decoding/counting means 10.

(57)【要約】
【目的】  給紙ローラを給紙方向に作用させ、リタード ローラを戻し方向に作用させる給紙装置において、先端 部にカールを生じている用紙に対しても、給紙作用を正 常に行い得るようにする。

【目的】  給紙部から送り出す用紙を、垂直な用紙搬送 路に向けて案内する装置において、用紙が湾曲される際 の反力により、リタードローラのニップ圧力が小さくな ることを防止できるようにする。

rows.title: 画像読取り装置の原稿取扱い装置
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  プラテンカバーを給紙と排出のトレイとして 使用し、原稿移動走査部に対してＵターン状の原稿搬送 路を設けた画像読取り装置において、走査済みの原稿の 紙の腰を強化して、２種類の原稿が重なることを防止す る。
【構成】  原稿トレイと排出トレイとを少しだけズレを 持つように配置し、２つのトレイに対して、原稿の規制 を行うための原稿規制部材３０を配置する。前記原稿規 制部材３０は、原稿トレイに対応する原稿ガイド３２、 ３２ａと、排出トレイに対応する排出ガイド３４、３４ ａを対向させて配置し、両側のガイド部材３１、３１ａ を連動させて離接させる。前記排出ガイド３４、３４ａ では、走査済みの原稿の両側に対して、側板３５の間隔 が狭まる状態に設け、原稿の中央部が高くなるように湾 曲させて紙の腰を強化することにより、給送する原稿の 上に垂れ下がらないように保持する。

rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  ロール紙を裁断するカッタ機構を備えた画像 処理装置でこの機構を利用してロール紙の巻き癖をとっ たり、これを軽減する。
【構成】  カッタ機構１５は下側レール４１と上側レー ル４３を有しており、これらの間に図示しない保持部が 往復動自在に配置されている。保持部には円板状カッタ ４４や第２のガイドコロ７３が配置されている。保持部 が往動または復動すると、円板状カッタ４４が固定刃４ ２と摺接し、これにより用紙３３が切断される。保持部 のこの移動時に第２のガイドコロ７３が第２のレール部 ４１Ａの上を移動する。このとき、用紙３３Ｂの後端近 傍が第２のレール部４１ＡのＲに押し付けられる。これ により、用紙３３Ｂの巻き癖が矯正される。

【目的】  原稿トレイに設ける原稿加圧板部材の上部 に、原稿の位置決め手段を設け、走査中の原稿の上に別 の原稿を収容させ得るようにする。

rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  中間トレイ装置のトレイ上部に用紙搬送装置 を配置し、トレイ上に用紙を堆積させる作用と、送り出 しの作用とを正確に行い得るようにする。
【構成】  中間トレイ装置１には、トレイ部材２の上部 に用紙搬送装置１０を配置し、該用紙搬送装置に設けた 多数の作動アーム部材１３……を介して、用紙搬送部材 １４……により用紙の搬送作業を行わせる。そして、入 口ローラ部材５を介して用紙が挿入されると、その用紙 の後端部が入口ローラ部材側に突出する位置に停止さ せ、その上に次の用紙を重ねる状態で、ゲート部材の方 向に搬送する動作を行い、用紙の先端をゲート部材に突 き当てた状態で収容する。また、中間トレイ装置から給 紙する際には、ゲート部材を解放して、用紙搬送装置に より用紙を用紙搬送路７に向けて送り出すようにする。

rows.abstract: The present invention discloses a metal-film-coated substrate in which the metal film has excellent adhesion to the substrate and which has a small dependence on temperature and humidity; and a process for producing the substrate. Also provided are: a metallic-pattern material which comprises a substrate and a metallic pattern having excellent adhesion to the substrate, has a small dependence on temperature and humidity, and has excellent insulation reliability in the regions not covered by the metallic pattern; and a process for producing the material. The process for producing a metal-film-coated substrate is characterized by comprising: a step (a1) in which a polymer layer is formed on a substrate, the polymer layer being made of a polymer which has a non-dissociable functional group interacting with a plating catalyst or a precursor therefor and capable of multidentate coordination and which is directly and chemically bonded to the substrate; a step (a2) in which a plating catalyst or precursor therefor capable of multidentate coordination is imparted to the polymer layer; and a step (a4) in which the plating catalyst or precursor therefor capable of multidentate coordination is plated. It may be characterized by further including, after the step (a2), the following step (a3). Step (a3) in which a metal different from the plating catalyst or precursor therefor capable of multidentate coordination is incorporated into the polymer layer.

rows.title: Medium material for electrophoresis
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a material consisting of a biological high molecular constituent, suitable for electrophoretic analysis and of which a sheet and an electrophoretic gel layer of an aq. gel are not peeled off in operation, by forming a medium layer of the aq. gel on a polymer sheet treated with glow discharge. CONSTITUTION:The surface of a polyethylene terephthalate sheet, etc. is treated with glow discharge and made hydrophilic. A gel medium layer obtained by polymerizing an acrylamidic compd. and a crosslinking agent in the presence of water is formed on the surface. A water-soluble polymer such as polyacrylamide and polyethylene glycol and agarose may be added to the gel medium layer to improve its plasticity. Besides, an anionic surfactant such as alkyl sulfate and a denaturing agent are preferably added to improve the separation of protein, especially compound protein. In addition, a cover sheet made of the same material as a support may be provided and cross-linked. In this way, the excellent electrophoretic medium material without causing any peeling-off, etc. due to electrophoresis and dyeing operation can be obtained.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a medium material for electrophoresis especially suitable for determining the basic configuration of DNA by providing a medium layer of polyacrylamidic aq. gel contg. a compd. having a carbamoyl group as a denaturing agent on a polymer sheet treated with glow discharge. CONSTITUTION:The surface of a polymer sheet such as polyethylene terephtalate is treated with glow discharge, and a layer of polyacrylamidic aq. gel, which is obtained by cross-linking and polymerizing a acrylamidic compd. contg. a carbamoyl group such as urea or formamide as a denaturing agent with a cross-linking agent in the presence of water, is formed on the surface. A water- soluble polymer and agrose are preferably incorporated into the aq. gel layer. In this way, the electrophoretic membrane, having strong adherence to the polymer sheet and which does not peel off while used for electrophoresis or further after drying and is especially suitable for determining the basic configuration of DNA, is obtained.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a polyacrylamide gel film-based electrophoretic medium material using a resin film as the support with the resolution equal to or more than that of the electrophoretic medium material produced using a glass plate as the support, by providing a resin intermediate layer made of a resin material having the oxygen transmission coefficient lower than the support material between a medium layer for electrophoresis and a support layer. CONSTITUTION:A medium material for electrophoresis which includes a medium layer for electrophoresis made of a polyacrylamide-based water gel produced by crosslinked polymerization of an acrylamide-based compound and a cross linking agent in the presence of water and a resin support is provided with a resin intermediate layer made of a resin material with the oxygen transmission coefficient lower than the support material between the medium layer for electrophoresis and the support layer. The resin intermediate layer is preferably made of a resin material with the oxygen transmission of below 15cc/m<2>.atm per day in the form of a film made at a thickness of 20mum. The resin material herein applicable is a vinylidene-vinylchloride copolymer, polyvinyl alcohol or the like.

CONSTITUTION:A medium material for electrophoresis which includes a medium layer for electrophoresis made of a polyacrylamide-based water gel produced by crosslinked polymerization of an acrylamide-based compound and a cross linking agent in the presence of water, and a resin support is provided with an oxygen transmission preventing layer made of an oxide or a sulfide of a metal element as selected from a group of V, Cr, Ni, Cu, Ga, In, Ge and Sn between the medium layer for electrophoresis and the support layer. Oxygen transmission of a laminate body made of the oxygen transmission preventing layer and the support is preferably below 10cc/m<2>.atm per day.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To strengthen the bonding of materials and to facilitate handling, by using a three-layer structure, wherein a plastic supporting body and an acrylamide water gel are bonded by a derivative of methylmethacrylate macro-monomer, as a medium material for electrophoresis. CONSTITUTION:On a plastic supporting body, e.g., polyethylene terephthalate, a derivative of methylmethacrylate macro-monomer, e.g., the compound shown by the formula, is applied as a bonding agent layer. Then, modified polyacrylamide water gel, wherein acrylamide compound, e.g., acrylamide, a bridging agent, e.g., N,N'-methl bisacrylamide, and a compound having at least one carbamoyl group as a modifying agent, e.g. urea and the like are bridged and polymerized, is bonded. Then the obtained three-layer structure is used as an electrophoresis medium material. Since bonding is performed by the compound shown by the formula, the three-layer structure has high adhesion property. Electrophoresis and dyeing can be performed with a polyacrylamide gel film (medium layer) being mounted on the supporting body.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve a practicable handling characteristic and the adhesiveness between a medium layer for electrophoresis and base in a wet state by using a material consisting of a polyacrylamide gel film formed on a plastic base and the plastic base. CONSTITUTION:This material is formed by joining the medium layer for electrophoresis and the one plastic base layer by an adhesive layer contg. gelatin. Then the gel film and the base are hardly separable even if the material is subjected to various operations in the laminated state of the base and the medium layer for electrophoresis after the electrophoresis. The medium layer for electrophoresis is, therefore, not ruptured and permits easy handling. Further, the adhesive layer contg. the gelatin is preliminarily formed on the base and the polyacrylamide gel film is formed on the adhesive layer. The other plastic base is placed on the gel film to obtain the above-mentioned material. The adhesiveness between the medium layer for electrophoresis and the base in the wet state is thus improved.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve resolving power and a handling property from a practical aspect, by constituting an electrophoretic medium layer of a predetermined polyacrylamide aqueous gel containing a specific surfactant and a modifier. CONSTITUTION:A polyacrylamide gel membrane is formed on a plastic sheet comprising a hydrophilic polymer or a sheet of which the surface is made hydrophilic as an electrophoretic medium layer. Said membrane is obtained by forming an aqueous solution or dispersion containing an acrylamide compound and a crosslinking agent into an aqueous gel membrane by crosslinking polymerization. A surfactant and a compound having at least one carbamoyl group being a modifier are contained in said gel membrane. The content of the surfactant is 1X10<-4>-5X10<-1>w/v%, pref., 1X10<-2>-5X10<-2>w/v% per a volume of an electrophoretic layer. A water-soluble polymer can be contained in the polyacrylamide gel membrane in a range of 2-about 100wt% of the monomer and the crosslinking agent.

rows.title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a patterned Cu wiring film to be formed without directly dry-etching Cu in a semiconductor device. CONSTITUTION:A polycrystalline silicon film 3 is patterned on an Si oxide film 2 formed on the surface of a semiconductor substrate 1, Cu is made to grow through a CVD method using, for instance, copper acetylacetonate complex as source, then the polycrystalline silicon film 3 is removed, and a Cu wiring film 5 is formed. By this setup, etching failure and corrosion attendant on a conventional method when Cu is etched hardly occur. As Cu is used as metal wiring material, a wiring is lower in electric resistance than that of Al or Al alloy, and a semiconductor device of this design can be enhanced in reliability to electromigration and stress migration.
