rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To realize enhanced integration by a simplified manufacturing process by a method wherein unmasked portions on the surface of a polycrystalline substrate are removed by etching and the portion just under the mask is etched from the sides and then impurity ions are implanted into the polycrystalline semiconductor substrate from both sides with the intermediary of an insulating film. CONSTITUTION:An oxide film 12 is formed on a p-type Si semiconductor substrate 11. A polycrystalline silicon layer 13 is formed, whereinto impurity, for example phosphorus, is driven. A photoresist 14 is so patterned as to retain a region for a gate electrode. Etching is accomplished for the selective removal of the polycrystalline layer 13 for the formation of a gate region layer 13A. Both upper sides of the gate region layer 13A are etched horizontally in spite of the presence of the photoresist 14. With the gate region layer 13 serving as a mask, arsenic is drivin into the Si semiconductor substrate 11 through the intermediary of the oxide film 12, for the formation on the Si semiconductor substrate 11 by self-alignment of a source region 16 and drain region 17 composed of an n<+> diffusion layer.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To form an insulating film which has an excellent boundary characteristic by keeping a glass substrate at a specific temperature or lower and at the same time depositing an insulating newer thereon and then applying heat treatment thereto in a specific range of temperature. CONSTITUTION:An a-Si film is formed on a glass substrate 1 and then is crystallized by annealing using a excimer laser to obtain a Poly-Si film, and then the Poly-Si film is patterned in land-like form by a photolithographic method to obtain a semiconductor active layer 2 having an inclination of 30 deg. or less at the end thereof. A silicon oxide film is deposited at a substrate temperature of 23 deg.C with the use of an ECR plasma CVD method, and then is heated at 500 deg.C in the atmosphere of nitrogen for an hour to deposit Ta, and patterning is applied thereto to form a gate electrode 5, and phosphorus is injected thereinto to form a source region 3a and a drain region 3b which are self-aligned. Therefore, the boundary level of a gate insulating film is lowered to improve the boundary characteristic, so that a thin films semiconductor device with high reliability may be realized.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a source ohmic layer and a drain ohmic layer to be easily formed so as not to overlap a gate electrode by a method wherein an electron cyclotron resonance plasma CVD method and a lift-off method are employed. CONSTITUTION:A gate electrode 12 is formed on an insulating board 11, and then a gate insulating film 13, a semiconductor film 14, and a surface protective 15 are successively laminated. Thereafter, a resist film 16 is formed on the upside of the surface protective film 15, and the surface protective film 15 is etched into a pattern using the resist film 16 as a mask. Then, an N<+>-a-Si semiconductor film 17 is formed on the semiconductor film 14 and the resist film 16 at a room temperature through an electron cyclotron resonance plasma CVD method. Furthermore, the board 11 is dipped into solvent such as acetone or the like to remove the resist film 16 and the semiconductor film 17 together by dissolution. By this setup, a source ohmic layer and a drain ohmic layer are formed of the semiconductor film 17 so as not to overlap the gate electrode 12.

rows.title: Thin film transistor and manufacture thereof
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a TFT device which is excellent in operational characteristics by making the inner fringes of a source electrode and a drain electrode equal at ends by limiting insulation film. CONSTITUTION:Amorphous Si2 and SiO24 are provided on a glass substrate 1 by plasma CVD and a Cr thin film 6 is piled. A gate electrode 6 and a gate insulation film 4 are made, using a resist mask 8. P-added amorphous Si 7 is made by plasma CVD, a Cr evaporation film 3' is piled and a source electrode 4 and a drain electrode 5 are made by removing the resist 8. At last, a TFT is completed by separating element, using an appropriate photo mask. No parastic capacity exists since source and drain layers and the gate electrode are not overlapped, the response speed is high and the operational characteristic are not overlapped, the response speed is high and the operational characteristics are excellent. The high precision mask alignment is not required and the process is also easy.

rows.title: Manufacture of amorphous semiconductor device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To form an amorphous semiconductor device on a thick-film IC substrate without exfoliating a thick film by forming an amorphous semiconductor layer by previously protecting a thick-film circuit by a metallic film on the formation of the amorphous semiconductor layer and removing the metallic film after the layer is attached. CONSTITUTION:Au layers 2, an insulating glass layer 3 and an Au layer 4 are printed and baked selectively onto a seramic substrate 1, thus forming a thick- film control circuit. A lower electrode 5 by a Cr evaporated film and a protective film 9 for the thick-film control circuit are formed, and the lower electrode 5 is connected to the thick-film control circuit. A metallic plate 6 is placed, and a hydrogenated amorphous Si layer 7 is deposited selectively through a plasma CVD method. When the metallic plate 6 is removed, the protective film 9 is taken away through etching and an ITO electrode 8 is formed selectively, a device consisting of a solid-state image pick-up element section 7 and a thick-film control section is obtained. In such constitution, the thick-film circuit has very excellent adhesive properties with the substrate and is stabilized secularly, a thick- film is not exfoliated even on a bonding operation on the circuit, and yield on mounting is improved.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the accumulation of ion on gate electrodes at the time of ion implantation as well as to avoid contamination of the surface of a substrate and the knock-on of oxygen element by a method wherein parts of the substrate surface other than a region, in which ion implantation is to be performed, are coated with an insulating film and the upper part of this insulating film is coated with a poly Si film. CONSTITUTION:A P-type well 2, N-type channel cut regions 1', P-type channel cut regions 2' and a field oxide film 3 are formed in an N-type Si substrate 1 and thereafter, gate oxide films 4 and 4' are formed and after a phosphorus- doped poly Si layer is deposited by an LPCVD method, gate electrodes 5 and 5' are formed by patterning. Then, a photo etching is performed in a state that a P-type channel region is coated with a photo resist 6 to remove the oxide film other than the gate oxide film 4 and opening parts 7a and 7b are formed. Subsequently, the photo resist 6 is removed, a non-doped poly Si layer 8 is deposited on the whole surface by an LPCVD method and arsenic ions are implanted. Then, a heat treatment is performed in an atmosphere of oxygen, the poly Si layer is all converted into an Si oxide layer 9 and the arsenic ions are diffused to form source and drain regins 10a and 10b.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable an interlayer insulating film to be formed thick enough to protect resist against damages while keeping the flatness of the surface of the interlayer insulating film, by applying, baking and then plasma oxidizing a siloxane S.O.G. film used as the interlayer insulating film to be provided between interconnection layers. CONSTITUTION:First aluminum interconnections 3 are formed on a substrate 1 and an insulating film 2. Then, ethanol solution of monomethyl silanol represented by CH3Si(OH)3 as siloxane S.O.G.-(spin on glass) is applied on the spinning substrate 1 having the first aluminum interconnections 3 to form an S.O.G. film 4 and then it is baked. The substrate 1 having the S.O.G. film 4 is introduced into an oxygen plasma treating apparatus, where it is plasma oxidized. Then, resist is deposited thereon and etched. The residual resist is removed and a via hole 6 is made on each of the first aluminum interconnection 3. Subsequently, second aluminum interconnections 7 are deposited on the interlayer insulating film 5. In this manner, the interlayer insulating film is allowed to have a large thickness and the flattened surface, whereby the resist is effectively protected against damages in the etching process.

CONSTITUTION:By oxidizing the whole surface of a semiconductor substrate 2, a silicon oxide film layer 2 which has a thickness smaller than the thickness of a gate oxide film layer which is applied to a charge coupling device by the thickness of a gate oxide film layer which is applied to a CMOS device is built up. After a photoresist layer 24 is applied to a region B in which a charge coupled device is to be formed, the silicon oxide film layer 22 in a region A in which a CMOS device is to be formed is removed by etching. Then the photoresist layer 24 is removed. Then a gate oxide film layer having a thickness applied to the CMOS device is built up over the whole surface of the semiconductor substrate.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate an overhang of the wall of a contact hole and to improve adherence of aluminum wiring to a silicon substrate by forming an interlayer insulating film formed on the substrate of a plurality of layers, and increasing the concentration of an impurity to be added toward a layer disposed farther from the substrate. CONSTITUTION:An NSG film is a (non-doped) silicon oxide film in which no impurity is added, and an interlayer insulating film is, for example, formed of two layers of an NSG film 7 and a PSG film 1. If the thickness of the film 7 is T1, the interlayer insulating film to 0 - T1 is the film 7. Accordingly, its impurity concentration is '0'. If the thickness is larger than the T1, e.g., in the case of the part of the film 1, its impurity concentration becomes an impurity concentration K1 of the film 1. A semiconductor device is coated with resist to form a pattern. A contact hole 4 is opened by an RIE method (Reactive Ion Etchion method). The hole 4 has a large diameter near the upper part of the film 1 having large impurity concentration and a small diameter near the lower part of the film 7 having small impurity concentration. Resist 3 is removed.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve operation characteristics and reliability of a thin film transistor, by preventing the exfoliation of a gate electrode from a glass substrate and the disconnection of a source electrode and a drain electrode which are arranged on the upper side and constituted of aluminum. CONSTITUTION:A substrate side wiring layer 23 of tantalum and a laminated wiring layer 24 of molybdenum are continuously formed on a glass substrate 1, with an inline type sputtering system; a photo resist film is uniformly spread and formed on the surface; then pattern exposure and developing process are performed, thereby forming a resist film (r) corresponding with a gate electrode. The substrate wiring layer 23 of tantalum and the wiring layer 24 are subjected to plasma etching, under the conditions of CF4: 45SCCM, O2: 5SCCM, and RF power: 500W. Thereby a gate electrode 2 whose section is nearly trapezoidal is formed.

rows.title: Manufacture of thin-film semiconductor device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To form a highly reliable thin-film semiconductor device at a low cost even when forming it on a substrate having a large area. CONSTITUTION:In the manufacturing method of a thin-film semiconductor device, a film forming process and an ion implantation process are included. In the film forming process, on the surface of an insulation substrate 1, a semiconductor layer 2 to be changed into an active layer, a gate insulation film 3, and a gate electrode 4 are formed respectively. In the ion implantation process, by the implantation of non-mass-separative ions, in a self-aligned way, source and drain regions 6 are formed using the gate electrode 4 as a mask. In this manufacturing method of a thin-film semiconductor device, first, the gate electrode 4 is so formed that its film thickness exceeds 350nm, and thereafter, in the ion implantation process, the ions are implanted into the source and drain regions 6 while the gate electrode 4 is used as a mask.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a highly reliable semiconductor device to be formed by forming slits in the wiring pattern positioned in the lower layer when forming a multilayer wiring pattern, thereby eliminating the occurrence of hillock even if a high-temperature treatment is involved in the subsequent process. CONSTITUTION:On a silicon substrate in which a predetermined element region is formed, a silicon doped aluminium layer of a 0.8-1mum thickness is formed by means of the DC magnetron sputter method with the substrate temperature of 250 deg.C. Subsequently patterning is performed by means of the photolithography method, forming the first-layer line wherein three rows of slits having a width W1=2mum and a length W2=30mum are alternately disposed in a power supply line having a line width L=50mum, and a silicon oxide film as an inter-layer insulating film is formed. Then, after punching a contact hole in the inter-layer insulating film by means of the photolithography method, patterning of the second-layer wiring line is performed. A multilayer wiring substrate formed in this way has no occurrence of hillock, and therefore is highly reliable.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To manufacture a thin film semiconductor device in excellent controllability characteristics by a method wherein, the title manufacture is provided with the film formation process to laminate a thin film amorphous silicon layer on an impurity holding film and the photoenergy irradiating process to thermal-diffuse the conductivity type impurity of the impurity holding film in the amorphous silicon layer to be simultaneously crystallized into a polysilicon layer with the low concentration conductivity type impurities led- therein. CONSTITUTION:An amorphous silicon layer 22 is pulse-irradiated using an excimer laser to instantaneously melt down the layer 22 and then phosphorus atoms are thermal-diffused in the layer 22 from an impurity holding film 21 to evenly form a low concentration led-in region while the amorphous silicon layer 22 is crystallized to form a polysilicon layer 2 doped with the low concentration phosphorus atoms. On the other hand, the polysilicon layer 2 is pulse- irradiated using the excimer laser and a gate electrode G as a mask so as to form a source electrode S and a drain electrode D. Through these procedures, the title thin film semiconductor device in excellent controllability characteristics can be manufactured easily and without fail.

Due to the dry etching, the edge portion of the semiconductor film protrudes from the resist film. Next, the p-type impurities are introduced into the edge portion of the semiconductor film using the resist film as a mask. The volume density of the p-type impurities in a channel edge portion of the semiconductor film is two to five times the volume density of the p-type impurities in a channel center section. Subsequently, the resist film is removed to form a gate insulating film and a gate electrode.

The Q terminal of the FF14 is connected to the base of an NPN type TR16. When the shutter release button is pressed to an intermediate position and the H output of the AF10 is sent out and inputted to the FF14, the FF14 outputs H to turn on TR16, and a stroboscope stop magnet 20 and an additional stop turn-on magnet 18 are excited. Consequently, a miss of photography is prevented and excellent photography with proper exposure is performed.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE: To perform speedy and smooth autofocusing control even when the lightness of an object is rapidly changed. CONSTITUTION: An image formed through lenses 1 and 5 and an iris 3 is inputted to an imaging device 7 and an image pickup signal S is provided. By processing the image pickup signal S, a luminance signal Y is provided. A photometric value is calculated from a luminance integrated value IY, for which the luminance signal Y is integrated, and the aperture of the iris 3 is controlled so that this photometric value can be equal with a target value. Besides, a focusing evaluated value F(x) is calculated by integrating a high frequency component provided by passing the luminance signal Y through a band pass filter. Then, a value dividing a reference photometric value (b) with successively provided photometric value (a) is multiplied to the focusing evaluated value F(x) and a corrected focusing evaluated value is calculated.  The position of a focus lens 5 is controlled in the direction where this corrected focusing evaluated value is enlarged.

Then when a changeover switch 4 is operated and the photographic lens is moved, the motor 12 is driven fast until the position detection subordinate contact Ea is detected and then driven at the slow speed from the position detection subordinate contact Ea to the position detection main contact Ed. Consequently, a control means for driving the lens can be made simple and the photographic lens can securely be stopped at the specific position.

rows.title: Recording tape cartridge
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a recording tape cartridge, whose recording tape is drawn out surely by a draw out member of a drive device, without damaging its leader tape. SOLUTION: In the recording tape cartridge, the leader tape 50, having a leader hole 58 that a take-up leader of the drive device enters, is connected to the tip part of a magnetic tape 14 wound around a single reel which is put rotatably in a case. A leader-protecting member 60 is fitted around the leader hole 58 of the leader tape 50, and when the magnetic tape 14 is drawn out, the leader protecting member 60 engages the take-up leader. Namely, the edge part of the leader hole 58 is protected by the leader-protecting member 60.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve stability of electric charge and stability of dispersion of an electrophotographic liquid developer by using a resin consisting of an ethylenic copolymer contg. acidic groups and being insoluble in a nonpolar liquid or swellable by the nonpolar liquid, and incorporating a nitrogen (N) atom contg. polymer or copolymer soluble in the nonpolar liquid into the developing agent. CONSTITUTION:A toner to be used consists of a nonpolar liquid having >=10<9>OMEGA.cm electric resistance and <=3 dielectric constant, a colorant, and a resin, as primary components. The resin consists of an ethylene copolymer contg. acidic groups and being insoluble in the nonpolar liquid or swellable by the nonpolar liquid. A mixture of the copolymer with a liquid having affinity with said copolymer is prepd. by stirring a mixture of the copolymer with the liquid at a temp. above a softening point of the copolymer. Then, the mixture is solidified by cooling it to below the softening point, and the solidified product is crushed coarsely and dispersed in the nonpolar liquid by the wet process to obtain thus a concentrated dispersion. An N-atom-contg. polymer is added in a stage of prepg. a liquid developer by diluting the dispersion with a carrier liquid. Thus, a liquid developer having high stability for electric charge and high stability for dispersion is obtd.

rows.abstract: 【課題】溶液製膜工程の渡り部において発生する、フィルムのツレ、シワ、側端部のカール等を抑制する。 【解決手段】渡り部３３にサクション部材Ｓ１〜Ｓｎを備えたローラ対Ｒ１〜Ｒｎを配し、フィルム３１を搬送する。ローラ対Ｒ１〜Ｒｎは、フィルム３１のバンド２７からの反剥離面側に配される。ローラ対Ｒ１〜Ｒｎでは、上流側ローラＲ１ａ〜Ｒｎａと下流側ローラＲ１ｂ〜Ｒｎｂとの間から空気が吸引され、これによりフィルム３１は、ローラ対Ｒ１〜Ｒｎに引き寄せられて接触する。得られるフィルム３１は、ツレ、シワ、カール等がなく、連続して高速製膜を行うことができる。また、この方法によるセルローストリアセテートフィルムを用いて、光学特性に優れる偏光板と液晶表示装置とを得ることができる。 【選択図】      図２

rows.title: 溶液製膜方法
rows.abstract: 【課題】  溶液製膜方法におけるポリマーフィルムのスリキズやシワ、側端部カール等の面状故障を抑制する。 【解決手段】  溶媒を含んだ状態でバンド２７から剥離したポリマーフィルム３１を、気体で支持し、その気体を搬送方向へ流すことにより、テンター装置１７へ搬送する。気体は搬送台３８の上流またはフィルム支持面側から供給されて、その供給方向はフィルム３１の面に平行とする。そして第１及び第２の堰４６，４７を設けることにより気体をせき止める。ポリマーフィルムの幅Ｗ１と、剥離位置Ｐ１からテンター装置１７までの距離Ｌ１とに対して、搬送台３８の搬送方向における長さＬ２は、Ｗ１／２≦Ｌ２≦Ｌ１を満たすものとする。これにより、フィルム３１にはスリキズやシワ、空気の吹き付け跡、側端部のカール等の面状故障が発生せず、良好な製品を得ることができる。 【選択図】        図２

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To miniaturize a magnetic latent image forming apparatus by housing a magnet for forming a magnetic bias field in a roll facing to a thermal printing head and locally heating a magnetic medium by using a selected heating element in order to form a magnetic latent image having a magnetized pattern different from the other portions. CONSTITUTION:First, a magnetic medium 3 is saturatedly magnetized in the directions of thickness, in-surface and the like to form a uniform magnetized pattern. Then, when coming to directly below a thermal printing head 1, the magnetic medium 3 is locally heated by a selected heating element 11. The temperature of the heated portion is raised above the Curie point or the temperature of the compensation point, so that the magnetization of the heated portion disappears. When the current supply to the heating element 11 stops, the temperature of the magnetic medium 3 lowers, so that the heated portion is magnetized by the magnetic field of a bias magnet 5 at a temperature below the Curie point or the like. The heated portion is magnetized in the direction determined by the magnetic field of the magnet 5. Therefore, a magnetic latent image having a pattern different form the preliminary magnetization can be obtained.

rows.abstract: To furnish with an electrophotographic sensitizing body with excellent electrophotographic peculiarity. In the course of drying after coating, it has an under-coating layer which is hard to bring about failure caused by an outbreak of cracks, etc. There is neither fluctuation of electrification potential in the course of reiterating use, nor rise of residual electric potential. The under-coating layer built up on the conductive substrate is formed by zirconium chelate compound or zirconium alkoxide compound and silane coupling agent as raw material; it is characterized by having more than 25 mole % of organic residual radical among the under-coating layer against the raw material. rows.title: Procede de developpement de materiau photographique couleur a halogenure d'argent
rows.abstract: Un procédé de développement de matériau photographique couleur à halogénure d'argent consiste à effectuer le développement couleur, à désargenter et à effectuer le rinçage à l'eau et/ou la stabilisation. Selon ce procédé, un matériau photosensible qui contient au moins une couche photographique à haute teneur en chlorure d'argent et au moins une couche photographique contenant une émulsion à dispersion simple, peut être rapidement développé à l'aide d'une soltuion de développement couleur contenant un composé à masse moléculaire élevée et soluble dans l'eau. Il est préférable que le poids de revêtement d'argent dans le matériau photographique décrit ci-dessus soit de 0,75 g/m2 au maximum, et que la solution de développement couleur contienne au moins 0,035 mol/l d'ions chlorure. Le développement rapide et continu permet de réduire de façon remarquable les variations des caractéristiques photographiques, en particulier la sensibilité et la gradation, de prévenir les inégalités de développement et d'empêcher la formation de dépôts sur la paroi du bac de développement.

rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  写真フイルムパトローネの検査効率の向上を 図る。
【構成】  写真フイルムパトローネは、写真フイルムを 収納する前に検査が行われる。第１の工程では、スプー ルロック手段がロック解除位置の状態で組み込まれた写 真フイルムパトローネのスプールに回転を与え、回転に 必要なトルクを測定する。第２の工程では、蓋部材を閉 じ位置に移動させる際の移動に必要なトルクを測定す る。第３の工程では、蓋部材の閉じ位置への移動に連動 してロック状態となるスプールを回転させてスプールロ ック力を測定する。第４の工程では、ロック状態の蓋部 材を回転させて蓋部材ロック力を測定する。そして、第 ５の工程では、ロックを解除した蓋部材を開き位置に移 動させる際の移動に必要なトルクを測定する。

rows.abstract: 本发明提供光学补偿薄膜、偏振片以及液晶显示装置。本发明的新型光学补偿薄膜能够有助于减轻液晶显示装置的白显示时在倾斜水平方向产生的黄色感，其特征在于：至少具有第1光学各向异性层(11)及第2光学各向异性层(12)，第1光学各向异性层(11)的波长550nm处的面内延迟Re(550)为20～40nm，波长550nm处的延迟变成0nm的方向不存在，且波长550nm处的延迟的绝对值成为最小的方向既不在层的法线方向、又不在面内；第2光学各向异性层(12)的波长550nm处的面内延迟Re(550)为20～150nm，并且波长550nm处的厚度方向的延迟Rth(550)为40～110nm。

rows.title: 扩增的核酸方法
rows.abstract: 本发明提供一种使用寡核苷酸引物和DNA聚合酶进行核酸扩增的方法。本发明的扩增方法包括：将含有至少一种脱氧核苷三磷酸、至少一种DNA聚合酶、至少两种寡核苷酸引物、以及作为模板的核酸片段的反应溶液进行孵育，以上述引物的3’末端作为起点进行聚合酶反应，从而对该核酸片段进行扩增，其特征在于，将标识序列添加到第一寡核苷酸引物的5’末端，该标识序列为在作为模板的核酸片段中存在的一段碱基序列，在所述模板上，该碱基序列位于该模板中的与第一寡核苷酸引物的3’端部分(第一寡核苷酸与模板核酸退火的部分)基本上相同的序列的3’末端侧。

rows.title: 超声波诊断装置
rows.abstract: 本发明的课题在于提供一种超声波诊断装置，在具有相对于装置主体能够回转的监视器部的超声波诊断装置中，抑制位于关闭位置的监视器部的回转。监视器部(18)相对于装置主体(16)能够开闭，进而能够围绕回转轴线(R)回转。监视器部(18)在关闭位置附近朝向关闭位置施力。回转轴线(R)相对于与装置主体(16)上表面的操作面板(20)垂直的方向后倾。若位于关闭位置的监视器部(18)围绕后倾的回转轴线(R)回转，则监视器部(18)上的点(P)的轨迹(T)与装置主体(16)发生干涉。因此，通过回转，监视器部(18)与装置主体(16)发生干涉而抑制位于关闭位置的监视器部(18)的回转。

rows.title: 组合物、喷雾器及擦拭布
rows.abstract: 本发明的课题在于提供一种抗病毒活性优异的组合物。并且，本发明的课题在于提供一种使用了上述组合物的喷雾器及擦拭布。本发明的碱性组合物包含具有氨基以及选自由酸性基、羟基及苯基组成的组中的至少一种官能团且分子量为85以上的化合物和包含醇的溶剂。

rows.title: Database management equipment
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To always keep a lock conflict probability of each of data uniformly corresponding to a state of a database by storing the number of reject of access request for each tree structure and dividing the tree structure when the stored access reject number of times reaches a prescribed number of times or over. CONSTITUTION:An access reject section 10C keeps a B tree in the lock state to reject an access request from other client while clients 13, 14 uses the B tree and adds the number of times of the B tree in which lock conflict takes place. An index division section 10d divides the B tree having the lock conflict number of times when the lock conflict number of times indicated on a distribute table in the index storage section 10b satisfies a prescribed condition. Furthermore, when the B tree is divided, it is divided so as to uniformize the access frequency with respect to the B tree after the division. The lock conflict number of times of each B tree to be divided is cleared.

rows.title: Photosensitive material processing device and processing method
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To enable rapid processing and to obtain stable images even if a developer is not heated to a high temp. by regulating a bromine ion concn. lower than heretofore by an energizing means. CONSTITUTION:This photosensitive material processing device 1 consists of a developing tank D, a bleaching tank B, a fixing tank F, washing tanks W1, W3 and a stabilizing tank St. The photosensitive material S is transported successively in these processing tanks. The developing tank D is provided with the energization processing device 2. Replenishing liquids b1 to b5 are respectively added to the respective processing tanks and overflow liquids a1 to a5 are discharged from the processing tanks. The energization processing device 2 is partitioned to two chambers by an anion exchange membrane A. A cathode 10 is installed in the one chamber and an anode 11 in another chamber. The bromine ion concn. is regulated by the energization processing device 2 to 4.2X10<-3>mol/liter or lower. The silver halide photosensitive material for photography having 90mol% or a more bromine ion content, >=0.2mol% or a more iodine ion content and 2 to 7g/m<2> coated amt. of silver is thus processed.

【課題】  プロセス・カートリッジの使用量に関するデ ータを好適に保管可能な画像形成装置を提供する。
【解決手段】  プロセス・カートリッジと装置本体の各 々が保管する寿命データの同期化処理は自動で行われ る。例えば、プロセス・カートリッジを別の画像形成装 置に移して画像形成処理を実行した後で再び元の画像形 成装置に戻した場合、プロセス・カートリッジ側のメモ リが保管する寿命データの方が、装置本体側のメモリよ りもカートリッジ使用量の大きな値を示す。このような 場合、プロセス・カートリッジ側の寿命データが優先さ れ、装置本体側の古いデータは駆逐される。

rows.title: Developing device
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make it possible to prevent the occurrence of coarse fogging in a non-image part by setting the ratio of the coarse powder of a fluidizing agent to be externally added to a one-component developer at a specific weight. SOLUTION: The magnetic one-component developer prepared by externally adding the powdery fluidizing agent 6 subjected to a hydrophobing treatment by silicone oil in accordance with a known technique to small grain size toner particles Ta into which magnetic powder is incorporated is used as a one- component toner T. The ratio of the coarse powder of >=20 μm in grain size in this fluidizing agent 6 is set at <=0.03 wt.% (wt%). The coarse powder of the fluidizing agent is generated by flocculation at the time of the hydrophobing treatment of inorganic fine powder (of about several to 30 nm in primary particle diameter) consisting of silica, titania, alumina, etc., after the hydrophobing treatment by the silicone oil. The coarse powder ratio of the fluidizing agent is preferably <=0.02 wt.%, more preferably a value as approximate to 0 wt.% as possible.

rows.title: Method for spectrally sensitizing silver halide photographic emulsion
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To spectrally sensitize a silver halide photographic emulsion in a satisfactory state and to improve stability and reciprocity law characteristics by using a cyanine dyestuff which gives J band when added to the emulsion, adding the dyestuff to the emulsion and aging this emulsion under specified conditions. CONSTITUTION:When a silver halide photographic emulsion is spectrally sensitized, a cyanine dyestuff which gives J band in the emulsion is used. The dyestuff is added to the emulsion and this emulsion is aged before coating under conditions required to obtain <=1/2, preferably <=1/3 of relative quantum yield phir of spectral sensitization obtd. by aging under the conditions of 40 deg.C and 20min. Satisfactory spectral sensitization can be carried out, the silver halide is firmly adsorbed on the dyestuff to improve the stability of a photosensitive material using the resulting emulsion and the chemical aging stage is improved to improve the performance of the photosensitive material such as the reciprocity law characteristics.

rows.title: Method and device for flash fixation
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To fix even a low-density image area excellently by providing a rectifier and a switching means which performs electric connection between an end part of a subordinate capacitor where a main capacitor is not connected and the toner end of a flash lamp when light is emitted to high illumination. CONSTITUTION:The flash lamp 15 is arranged oppositely to a beltlike conveying body for conveying a form to which a toner image is already transferred. When the form on the conveying body is detected by a sensor, a trigger circuit 18 outputs a trigger pulse to induce a high voltage at a trigger wire 16B connected to the secondary coil of a transformer 6 for triggering. The trigger wire 16B is arranged to be connected to the tube wall of the flash lamp 15, and the discharging of the flash lamp 15 is started with high voltage. When the flash lamp 15 breaks down with an initial current, the light emission of the flash lamp 15 by only the capacitor C2 is enabled.

rows.abstract: To obtain an endoscope system, which is capable of accurately detecting an insertion state including at least one of a position and shape of an insertion part of an endoscope, and an operation method thereof.SOLUTION: An endoscope system acquires a value concerning an output impedance of a magnetic field detection element, which detects a magnetic field, and a value concerning an input impedance of a reception circuit, which receives a signal outputted from the magnetic field detection element. The endoscope system derives a frequency characteristic of a pair of the magnetic field detection element and the reception circuit using the value concerning the output impedance and the value concerning the input impedance. rows.title: Photosensitive composition and planographic printing plate using the same
rows.abstract: The present invention provides a photosensitive composition comprising an infrared absorbing agent represented by the following formula (I) and a polymer compound which is insoluble in water and soluble in an aqueous alkali solution and becoming soluble in an aqueous alkali solution by radiation of an infrared laser. In the formula described below, R<1> and R<2> independently represent an alkyl group having 1 to 18 carbon atoms or an alkyl group having 9 to 30 carbon atoms and Z represents a heptamethine group which may have a substituent. The definitions of other substituents are shown in the specification. According to the present invention, a photosensitive composition having high development latitude and storage stability, together with a positive type planographic printing plate for direct plate-making which can form an image with high sensitivity by using an infrared laser, are provided. <CHEM>

rows.title: Color picture converting device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To convert a color picture into another color picture having a designated psychological image without deteriorating the quality of the color picture by executing a color conversion for the picture according to a psychological image conversion request from an operator. CONSTITUTION:When the instruction of the color conversion from the operator in a psychology display language is received, a psychological language selecting means 10 retrieves a psychological language coordinate memory 92 and reads out the coordinate value of the psychology display language corresponding to the instruction of the operator. An optimum histogram calculating means 11 calculates the optimum histogram most adaptive to the coordinate value of the psychological language. A color conversion means 12 successively makes areas in the histogram of an input picture correspond to areas in the optimum histogram obtained in the optimum histogram calculating means 11 according to a sequence from the area having the highest frequency, converts color data in a picture memory, and writes the color-converted data in a converted picture memory 22. Further, a picture display means 13 displays the respective contents of the picture memory before and after the color conversion. Thus, the color conversion for the input picture can be automatically executed only by instructing the psychology display language of an image level.

rows.title: Transparent toner and toner image using the same, electrostatic latent image developer, toner cartridge, process cartridge, image forming apparatus, and image forming method
rows.abstract: PURPOSE: Transparent toner, a toner image using the same, an electrostatic latent image developer, a toner cartridge, a process cartridge, an image formation apparatus, and an image formation method are provided to produce the transparent toner for forming the image having excellent transparency in the environment in which the color temperature is greater than 5,000 K. CONSTITUTION: Transparent toner for electrostatic latent image development includes a toner particle containing a binding resin, and an external additive agent containing cerium oxide. The concentration of cerium for the toner is 0.05-0.20 mass%, and the concentration of neodymium is 0.001-0.015 mass%. An electrostatic latent image developer contains the transparent toner for electrostatic latent image development. A toner cartridge has a toner storage chamber, and contains the transparent toner for electrostatic latent image development. A process cartridge for an image formation apparatus uses a phase retainer and a developer for developing an electrostatic latent image formed on the surface of the phase retainer.

rows.title: Image display medium, device and method
rows.abstract: An image display medium provided with a pair of substrates both of which are substantially transparent, and a gas enclosed in space defined between them. Each of the pair of the substrates is provided with transparent electrodes (ITO). The space defined between the substrates encloses two types of particle groups having colors different from one another, have a negative charge polarity, and have different adhesiveness from each other with respect to the substrates. A white particle group having a positive polarity is further enclosed in the space. A voltage is applied to the electrodes  28  and  30  so as to apply an electric field determined in response to the types of particles to be transferred. Thus, a plurality of colors are selectively developed via the particle groups enclosed in the space for displaying different colors.

rows.title: 紙送り装置
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  前記用紙出力装置の排出速度および用紙排出 間隔に関係なく、任意の速度で紙折り部に用紙を送出で きる紙送り装置を提供することにある。
【構成】  用紙搬入時に、用紙検出手段２および速度検 出手段３等から構成される用紙サイズ検出手段で用紙の サイズを検出し、搬入された用紙を一旦用紙収容トレイ ４に収容してから紙折り部１２へ送出する。この際、所 定のタイミングで、フィードベルト７が駆動され、該用 紙の下側の一枚を紙折り部１２への方へ送出する。この ため、用紙搬入口１から紙折り部１２までの用紙搬送路 １１を短くすることができ、用紙出力装置の用紙排出速 度、および用紙排出間隔に影響されずに、任意の速さで 紙折り部１２へ一枚づつ用紙を送ることができるように なる。また、本装置内で用紙のサイズが分かるため、用 紙出力装置との通信が不要になる。

rows.title: 层叠膜
rows.abstract: 本发明提供一种层叠膜，其具有量子点层等光学功能层，能够防止由于氧气等从端面渗透而引起显现量子点的光学功能的部件劣化。本发明的层叠膜具有功能层层叠体及端面密封层，所述功能层层叠体具有光学功能层及层叠于光学功能层的至少一个主表面的阻气层，所述端面密封层覆盖功能层层叠体的端面中的至少一部分而形成，端面密封层从功能层层叠体的端面侧起依次包括端面树脂层、金属层，金属层覆盖端面树脂层的除了与功能层层叠体的端面接触的面以外的整个面。

rows.title: 文書構造作成装置
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  文書全体の構造から不足部分を判断して補完 処理を行い、希望の文書クラスに従った文書構造を作成 する。
【解決手段】  補完指定記憶手段１は、文書構造に対す る補完の指定を記憶する。補完手段２は被補完文書構造 に補完処理を施す。対応規則記憶手段３は異なる文書ク ラス間の構成要素の対応規則を記憶している。文書構造 変換手段４は特定の文書クラスの構造制約を満たした原 文書を、対応規則に従って別の文書クラスに従った構造 になるように変換する。原文書は、まず文書構造変換手 段４において特定の文書クラスに従った構造から希望の 文書クラスにほぼ従った構造に変換される。ここで変換 に必要な対応規則は対応規則記憶手段３に記憶されてい る。その後、補完指定記憶手段１に記憶された補完指定 に基づいた補完処理を補完手段２において施され、希望 の文書クラスに従った文書構造が作成される。

rows.title: 像保持体及びこれを用いた画像形成装置
rows.abstract: 【課題】画素単位で縦横に配列された画素電極を有しトナーを保持可能な像保持体にて、環境適応性を向上し、高湿環境下においてもコントラストの低下等の画質劣化を防ぐ。 【解決手段】潜像が形成され且つこの潜像に基づいたトナー像を保持可能な像保持体１であって、移動可能な支持体１ａと、この支持体１ａ上に形成され、画素単位で縦横に配列されて画像信号に基づいた潜像電圧が画素単位に印加されることで潜像が形成される多数の画素電極１ｂと、この画素電極１ｂ表面及び画素電極１ｂ間を保護する保護層６とを備え、保護層６は、画素電極１ｂ間に最大潜像電圧に相当する電圧が作用したときに画素電極１ｂ間の絶縁性が維持される程度に高耐圧で、酸化シリコン、窒化シリコン、酸化タンタルのいずれかからなる絶縁層７と、この絶縁層７の表面に形成され且つ水の接触角が８０度以上となる疎水性表面層８とを有するものとなっている。 【選択図】図１

rows.title: Image coder and method
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image coder that prevents image quality from fluctuating even when the resolution of a received image is changed in the case of conducting irreversible coding through frequency conversion and quantization. SOLUTION: A DCT section 20 applies DC transform to an image received by an image input section 10, a quantization section 40 quantizes the result of transform, and an entropy coding section 50 applies entropy coding to the output of the quantization section 40 and provides the output of the entropy coding. A quantization table calculation section 30 stores each normalized quantization step with respect to a reference resolution, receives resolution data of the received image, calculates each quantization step matching the input image according to an expression of (quantization step)=(reference quantization step)/(reference resolution)×(resolution of received image) to prepare a quantization table.

rows.title: Muffling device
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a muffling device which can attain a large noise reducing effect by using an inexpensive arithmetic unit and causes no size increase. SOLUTION: A duct-shaped structure 11 propagating noise from a noise source as a plane wave is constituted of a first duct-shaped part 12a and a second duct-shaped part 12b having different cross-sectional areas at an installation position of a sound detecting means 13 for detecting noise. The transmitivity and reflectivity of a sound wave at a position where the cross-sectional areas discontinuously change are respectively made to be 0.5 by making ratio of these cross-sectional areas to be 1:3. Thereby a transmitted component of a traveling wave transmitting the installation position of the sound detecting means 13 and a reflected component of a retreating wave reflected at the installation position respectively are the same magnitude for the signal detected by the sound detecting means 13. Thereby the reflected component of the retreating wave is also muffled by the same principle as the transmitted component of the noise from the noise source is muffled by interference with sound from an electro-acoustic converting means 15.

rows.title: Thin film of optically active polypeptide
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prepare the subject film excellent in the biocompatibility and molecular orientation properties by polymerizing a monolayer or a built-up film thereof comprising amphoteric long-chain alkyl derivs. of optically active alpha-amino acid esters having the same stereochemical structure. CONSTITUTION:A monolayer of amphoteric long-chain alkyl derivs. (e.g. formulas I and II) of optically active alpha-amino acid esters having the same stereochemical structure is developed with a suitable org. solvent on the surface of water in a trough for preparing a monolayer, and is allowed to stand on the water surface for a length of time necessary for the monolayer to polymerize, thus giving a thin film of an optically active long-chain alkylated polypeptide. A built-up film obtd. by laminating a plurality of said monolayers may be polymerized to produce the thin film. The resulting thin film, being excellent in the biocompatibility, is usable in living tissues as, e.g. a permeation-controlling film of a drug.

rows.title: Manufacture at high temperature for high electrically- conductive tin oxide powder and its apparatus
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To control the viscosity of high electrically-conductive SnO2 to be produced whose grain size is micron or less by burning tin compounds while introducing an incombustible gas functioning as a diluent or a reaction moderator into the combustion flame of an oxidizing agent contg. oxygen and a combustible gas contg. hydrogen. CONSTITUTION:The high electrically-conductive SnO2 powder is produced by burning tin compounds (e.g. SnCl4) in the flame formed by the combustion of an oxidizing agent consisting of air or oxygen and a combustible gas contg. H2 as a simple substance or H which is present in the form of a volatile hydrocarbon (e.g. C3H8). In this case, a diluent and/or incombustible gas flow consisting of N2 or air acting so as to make the reaction temp. adjustable are thrown in or brought into contact with the flame. Thereby, the grain size of SnO2 to be produced is controlled and the high electrically-conductive SnO2 powder whose grain size is micron or less is obtained.

A compound used as a charge transfer material is a biphenyl compound represented by the formula III in which X is CH3 or Cl. Said charge generating material is contained in a charge generating layer and said charge transfer material is contained in a charge transfer layer to form a laminate photoconductive layer on a conductive substrate, or both the materials are contained in a single photoconductive layer, thus permitting charge generating and transferring efficiencies to be enhanced and a high-photosensitivity electrophotographic receptor to be obtained.

rows.abstract: 【課題】液滴吐出面に付着した液類および付着部を確実に除去できるとともに、液滴吐出面表面及び清掃部材の耐久寿命を低下させないインクジェット記録装置及びインク吐出面清掃方法並びに清掃装置を提供する。 【解決手段】印字ヘッド５０のノズル面５１Ａに付着している汚れを清掃するノズル面清掃手段６６は、印字ヘッド５１に当接しながら往復移動してノズル面５１Ａの清掃を実行する。往路では、インク吸収ローラ６６Ａを従動回転させ、液類を吸液除去し、復路では、インク吸収ローラをスリップさせながら固着物を払拭除去する。従動回転と非従動回転とはワンウエイクラッチにより切り換える。液類を吸液除去する部材と固着物を拭き取る部材とを別部材構成にすると、往路移動のみで液類の吸液除去と固着物の払拭除去とを行うことができ、構成を簡素化するとともにメンテナンス時間を縮減できる。 【選択図】  図８

rows.title: 色素画像形成方法
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  簡易に色素画像を得る。しかも現像液の再生 使用が可能となる。
【構成】  色像形成剤を含有するハロゲン化銀写真感光 材料を、露光後、酸化還元反応を可逆的に行う化合物で あって、ハロゲン化銀と反応して酸化体となり電子が供 与されることにより還元体に戻る化合物の還元体の存在 下に現像し、ハロゲン化銀が銀に還元される反応に応じ て前記色像形成剤から色素を得、この色素により色素画 像を形成する。

rows.title: 纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法
rows.abstract: 一种纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法是在干燥箱(31)内边传送胶片(1)边经干燥风排气管(33)及干燥风供给管(34)循环干燥风干燥胶片(1)。这时，与干燥箱(31)内的干燥风接触部分的温度比在干燥风中所含低分子量物质的饱和温度高5℃以上。另外，在新鲜风导入口(36)导入新鲜风，同时在干燥风排气口(37)排出部分干燥风。该方法在溶液制膜法中传送胶片至干燥箱使之干燥时，能抑制低分子量物质气化物附着在干燥箱内壁面并能防止低分子量物质附着在胶片上。

CONSTITUTION: A transparent layer of a polyester resin is formed on the surface of a transparent plastic film. The film has the relation -50Pa<=Ep-≠t<=2500Pa between the storage modulus of elasticity Ep of the resin and the storage modulus of elasticity ET of the binder resin of the toners. The inclination angle of the molten toner of the resin is specified to γ50 deg.. The thickness of the transparent resin layer is specified to be in a range of l to 8μm. The surface electric resistance value of the surface which comes into contact with an elastic transfer roll is 5×10<8> to 3.2×l0<10> Ω/cm<2> and the surface electric resistance value of the transparent resin layer is 10<10> to 10<13> Ω/cm<2> .

rows.abstract: 【課題】ぶれの発生している画像データからぶれのない画像データを安価で高速に復元する。 【解決手段】画像データ修復部は、撮像時における撮像素子のＹ方向へのぶれに関するぶれ情報を内部メモリから取得し、ぶれ情報に基づいて、ぶれ情報に基づくぶれがない状態で被写体を撮像したときに得られる理想的な画像データを、内部メモリに記録されている静止画像データから復元するための復元行列であって、該理想的な画像データのＹ方向への広がりを表すぶれ伝達関数の行列表現であるぶれ行列の擬似逆行列である復元行列を生成し、この復元行列と静止画像データとにより、理想的な画像データを復元する。ここで、復元行列は、静止画像データのＹ方向の総画素データ数ｎと同じ数のデータからなるｎ個の行ベクトルＤｔで構成される。 【選択図】図６

rows.title: Plate material for lithography printing not requiring dampening water
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the plate material for the dry lithography printing good in stickiness to a base material and ink repellence and efficient in plate water, without greasing which can be easily reproduced by electrophotograpy, by forming an ink repellence layer by vapor phase polymerization method. CONSTITUTION:In the plate material for the dry lithography printing having an ink repellence layer on the base material, the ink repellence layer is formed by the vapor phase polymerization method of silicon compound. As a base material, various kinds of substance such as paper, plastic film, or metallic plate of aluminum or the like, and various kinds of composite materials of paper laminated with aluminum foil and paper one or both sides of which are laminated with the polymer layer of polyethylene or the like are used. The electrophotographic photosensitive layer consisting of zinc oxide, inorganic photoconductive layer may be provided on the base material. As a monomer used for polymerization, silicon compound or the like are used. As to the organic silicone film produced by plasma polymerization method, the radical generated in gas phase reacts on the surface of the substrate and is accumulated to form a film. Therefore, the said organic silicone film has good stickiness to the surface of the base material.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of a trouble caused by toner pollution and simplify maintenance by preventing toner from leaking outside of a cleaning device so as to eliminate the pollution of a charger, an optical system and a driving system. CONSTITUTION:The housing 400 of a cleaning device is provided with a brush roller 43, side walls 410 for rotatably supporting a toner conveying auger 45, and a scrape-off part 47 formed by projecting the upper face of the housing 400. The longitudinal dimension L2 of the scrape-off part 47 is shorter than the dimension L1 between the side walls 410 and equal to or longer than the axial length dimension L3 of the brush roller 43 so as to form clearances 100 to the side walls 410 of the housing 400. These clearances 100 serve as air passages for making air flow, generated by the rotation of the brush 43, flow out to the rear part in the housing and making air at the rear part flow in to circulate air.

rows.title: A method of printing
rows.abstract: The present invention provides a method of inkjet printing comprising the following steps, in order: (i) providing an inkjet ink comprising a radiation-curable material and a photoinitiator; (ii) inkjet printing the inkjet ink from a printing head on to a substrate; (iii) exposing the inkjet ink to a first dose of radiation from an LED source to partially cure the ink; (iv) exposing the inkjet ink to a second dose of radiation from a mercury lamp to fully cure the ink; wherein the printing head moves relative to the substrate at a speed of 60 m/min or more. The radiation-curable material may comprise a radiation-curable monomer which may be a difunctional, multifunctional (meth)acrylate monomer or 3-methyl-1,5-pentanediol diacrylate. The photoinitiator may be phenylbis(2,4,6-trimethylbenzoyl) phosphine oxide. The method may be a method of single-pass inkjet printing. The first dose of radiation from each LED source to partially cure the ink is from 10 to 80 mJ/cm2. The second dose of radiation from each mercury lamp to fully cure the ink is from 50 to 250 mJ/cm2.

rows.title: Flow control method for liquid
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make to control flow with good precision for various conditions of applicating liquid by using a flow control valve which has small rate of change in flow and still linear quality to valve lift. CONSTITUTION:Finished emulsion for application is detected flow rate by a flow detector in a feed pipe, and thereby a servomotor 6 is ordered to control a flow control valve 7, and flow control is performed so as to get a required flow rate. The flow control valve 7 is lifted and lowered through a valve stem 10, on the top of which a valve head 13, abut ting to a valve seat 11 and in conical or cylindrical shape, is provided. The valve head 13 is treated to conical or cylindrical shape in slender and so as to be small and still linear in rate of change of flow rate to lift of the valve stem.

rows.abstract: 本发明公开了一种具有高透射率和无光泽特性的薄膜，在透明基底(1)上，有一个硬涂层(8)，其中结合了颗粒尺寸在1.0到10μm的颗粒，所述的颗粒尺寸大于硬涂层的厚度，还包括低折射指数层(3)，其折射指数是1.45或者更小，覆盖在所述硬涂层上面，该薄膜的浊度是1.0%或者更大，总的透光率是93.5%或者更大。该具有高透射率的薄膜能够防止由于调光薄膜的热膨胀而导致的显示不均匀，并防止调光薄膜出现亮度不均匀。

rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain visibility of the same color as that of an image of a hard copy to a soft copy image on a display device. SOLUTION: A physiological primary color corresponding to three stimulus values of each pixel of am image on a hard copy is obtained, a parameter representing a degree of an incomplete adaptation corresponding to a correlation color temperature of a white color point on a display device (CRT) displaying an image is decided, temporary three stimulus values to be reproduced on the display device are introduced based on the parameter, metric brightness, metric chroma and a metric hue angle in the LAB color system are obtained by making the while color point on the display device as an observation light source from the three stimulus values, the three stimulus values of the image are converted into three stimulus values on the display device and a soft copy image on the display device is prepared based on the converted three stimulus values.  As a function of the color temperature of the white color on the display device, especially as for as a white color correlation color temperature is higher than 6000K or lower than 5500K, by setting an adaptation white color point to a point different from a white color point itself on the display device an ideal color is obtained to the widespread display device.

rows.title: Optical waveguide element
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To converge a light beam which is projected from an optical waveguide into a small spot by setting the grating height of a diffraction grating formed on the surface of the optical waveguide so as to have a mountain-shaped distribution in the traveling direction of waveguide light. CONSTITUTION:The grating height of the diffraction grating 21 is varies in the mountain shape in the traveling direction of the waveguide light 13' so that when waveguide light 13' is projected from the optical waveguide 11 by the diffraction grating 21, the intensity distribution of the projection light 13'' is nearly a Gaussian distribution in the traveling direction. Therefore, the light beam 13'' projected from the optical waveguide element 10 is converted into the small beam spot Q through a scanning lens 26 to scan (main scan) on a photosensitive body 23 as shown by an arrow (u). Simultaneously, the photosensitive body 23 moves by a conveying means 22 almost at right angles to the main scanning direction as shown by an arrow (v) to make a subscan, so the photosensitive body 23 is scanned with the light beam 13'' in two dimensions. Consequently, the beam spot Q is converted sufficiently and a fine image can be recorded.

rows.title: マーカー消去装置
rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  編集準備処理のために原稿上にマーカーペン で書いたマーカーを、編集実行のために原稿を読み取る 際に消去するマーカー消去装置において、プレスキャン 時とコピースキャン時での原稿セットの位置ずれに基づ くマーカーの消し残りをなくすこと。
【構成】  プレスキャン時に、マーカー認識回路１によ りマーカー部分を認識してマーカーデータ記憶部２−１ に記憶しておく。コピースキャン時には、プレスキャン 時に読みとったマーカー部分より、主走査方向および副 走査方向に予め指定した幅だけ拡張した領域に対して は、あたかもマーカー部分であるかのような出力をマー カー太め回路８が出す。そうすると、コピースキャン時 にセットした原稿がプレスキャン時の位置より多少ずれ ても、コピースキャン時に読みとられるマーカー部分 は、前記の拡張した領域内には入る。入った場合、選択 回路３は、マーカーを消去するための置換レベル設定部 ４のデータを選択する。

rows.title: Close up photographing controller for variable focus camera
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to perform close up photographing in either state of standard photographing and telephotographing by controlling a lens barrel so that it may be positioned at a 1st close up photographing position in the case of the standard photographing and controlling the lens barrel so that it may be positioned at a 2nd close up photographing position in the case of the telephotographing. CONSTITUTION:In the case that an object distance is shorter than a close range capable of photographing in the case of the standard photographing and the telephotographing, the lens barrel 1 is extended, and in the case of the standard photographing, the lens barrel 1 is controlled so as to be positioned at the 1st close up photographing position where the performed based on the detection of the 1st adjacent photographing pattern which is obtained by sliding a contact member 8. Meanwhile, in the case of the telephotographing, the lens barrel 1 is controlled so as to be positioned at the 2nd close up photographing position where the adjacent photographing by the telephotographing can be performed based on the detection of the 2nd close up photographing pattern which is obtained by sliding the contact member 8. Thus, the close up photographing can be performed in either state of standard photographing or telephotographing.

rows.title: Control method for optical device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To considerably shorten the time required for control of the exposure by storing a rough driving frequency corresponding to the correct exposure of an image sensor for each interchangeable lens and driving the image sensor with the driving frequency corresponding to a selected lens at the time of replacing a lens. CONSTITUTION:A correction curve for the illuminance variance of each lens is preliminarily stored in a memory 86, and a CPU 52 corrects a contrast C and an output signal d' or slice levels Sn and Sp for a turning position theta of a line sensor 40. The driving frequency of the line sensor 40 corresponding to an approximately correct exposure for lens power is preliminarily stored in a memory 88 for each interchangeable lens; and since this frequency determines the rough exposure of the line sensor 40 for each interchangeable lens and a comparator 68 has a blooming preventing function, such driving frequency is stored in the memory that the exposure is rather on the blooming side. Thus, the exposure of the image sensor is certainly entered in the correct range and the operation time when the driving frequency in this range is obtained is very shortened at the time of lens replacement.

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain microcapsules capable of providing a picture image having satisfactory contrast by constituting the microcapsules of external shells comprising a resin generated from a raw material contg. isocyanate having a isocyanurate ring structure, around a core material. CONSTITUTION:External shells comprising a resin generated from a raw material contg. isocyanate having an isocyanurate ring structure are formed around a core material contg. silver halide and a polymerizable compd. When the shell is prepd. from a raw material contg. isocyanate having an isocyanurate ring structure (a product modified with isocyanurate ring), heat resistance is given to the shell by the trimerization of isocyanate monomer, and, as a result, resin walls having high glass transition point is obtd. Thus, oozing of the monomer in the capsule is retarded even if heat development is performed at high temp., and a distinct picture image is obtd. by the development for a short time.

rows.title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve graininess of a silver halide photographic sensitive material without reducing its sensitivity by incorporating at least one kind of liquid paraffin into an outermost layer, and regulating an amt. of a matting agent to be contained in the outer-most layer to <=15mg/m<2>. CONSTITUTION:At least one kind of liquid paraffin is incorporated into the outermost layer of the silver halide photographic sensitive material, and content of the matting agent in one of the outermost layer is regulated to <=15mg/m<2>. The kind of the liquid paraffin is not restricted particularly by a mol.wt. etc., and any kind of liquid paraffin may be useful so far as it reduces a coefft. of static friction and a degree of adhesion when it is present on the surface of a body as compared to that when it is absent. Preferred amt. of the matting agent to be used is <=50mg/m<2> when a mean particle size of the matting agent is <=2mum, and an improving effect for graininess is obtd. when it is <=30mg/m<2>, particularly, <=15mg/m<2> in the case of >=2mum particle size. Thus, graininess and sharpness of the silver halide photographic sensitive material are improved without reducing its sensitivity.

rows.title: Failure detector for electrostatic potentiometer of copying machine or the like
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To simply detect the failure of an electrostatic potentiometer without using a measuing instrument by impressing a voltage with a proper waveform to an electrostatic latent image recording member, detecting the potential by the electrostatic potentiometer and detecting the failure of the potentiometer from the potential and a delay. CONSTITUTION:At the time of setting up an operation mode to a failure detecting mode in order to detect a failure in the electrostatic potentiometer 7, a square waveform signal (c) is outputted from a control device 9 to a high voltage amplifier 10. The signal (c) is impressed to the electrostatic latent image recording member 4 through a current collecting brush 12 and sent from the potentiometer 7 to the control device 9. The control device 9 reads out voltage V1 obtained after t1sec from the trailing edge of a signal (b) inputted from the potentiometer 7 and displays the value V1 on a display device 13. The potential V1 obtained after t1sed and displayed on the display device 13 is compared with a regulated value, and when the displayed value is <= the regulated value, the normality of the potentiometer is decided, and in case of exceeding the regulated value, its failure can be easily decided.

rows.title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the decrease of concentration caused by diffusion of phosphorus by providing an ion mixing process after a silicide layer is formed and crystallized by heat treatment. CONSTITUTION:On a P-type silicon substrate 1 wherein trivalent boron B<+> is mixed into silicon crystal, a field oxide film 2 is formed, and element isolation is performed. The surface of the substrate 1 is oxidized in a dry oxygen atmosphere, thereby forming a gate oxide film 3, on which a photo resist film (r) is selectively formed. Next the substrate is exposed to an atmosphere of boron B gas being P-type impurity, and the boron gas is diffused and mixed into the substrate 1 from the exposed part position. After the layer (r) is eliminated, washed with suitable acid and inorganic solvent, and dried, silicide 6 is formed on the surface. After that, the substrate is heated in a high temperature atmosphere, thereby crystallizing the layer 5. Since boron gas B is mixed into the substrate 1, the decrease of concentration caused by the diffusion of mixed-in atom can be prevented.

rows.abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  高速変調やアレイ化の不要な安価な光源が使 用可能になり、しかも、構造が簡素で、高精度な位置合 わせが不要になる光変調素子の駆動方法及び光変調素子 並びにそれを用いた露光装置、平面表示装置を提供す る。
【解決手段】  光源２３からの光を伝搬させる導光体２ ７と、この導光体２７の境界面に対面して設けられる主 可撓薄膜３３と、主可撓薄膜３３より光伝搬方向下流側 で導光体２７の境界面に対面して設けられる副可撓薄膜 ３５とを備え、電気機械動作により主可撓薄膜３３と境 界面との距離を変化させて導光体２７を伝搬する光の透 過率を変化させるとともに、電気機械動作により副可撓 薄膜３５と境界面との距離を変化させ、導光体２７を伝 搬する透過光の光路を偏向させて導光体２７から外部へ 出射される光を制御する。

rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the deterioration of an element by providing a filter cutting off the light included in the absorption wavelength region of an organic nonlinear optical material constituting the conversion element within the external light fed to a transparent window and transmitting the wavelength conversion wave. CONSTITUTION:A light wavelength conversion element 10 stored in a sealed container 20 filled with dry nitrogen gas 50, a semiconductor laser 16 emitting the fundamental wave 15, and a collimator lens 17 and an objective lens 18 serving as an incidence optical system are provided. Transparent windows 27, 28 of the sealed container 20 are formed with a filter cutting off the light in the absorption wavelength region of the material of the core 11 of the conversion element 10, the external light included in this region is absorbed by the transparent windows 27, 28 and does not infiltrate into the sealed container 20, thus the core 11 is surely prevented from being denatured by the photochemical reaction.

rows.title: Radiographic apparatus and operation method of the same
rows.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To radiograph stereoscopic vision images having an appropriate depth feel corresponding to a subject, in a radiographic apparatus.SOLUTION: Radiation is emitted to a subject from a first radiographing direction and the radiation transmitted through the subject is detected by a radiation detector 131. A reaching dose T which has reached the radiation detector 131 is measured, and a convergence angle Δθ is set on the basis of the reaching dose T. The radiation is emitted to the subject from a second radiographing direction and the radiation transmitted through the subject is detected by the radiation detector 131. Radiation image data for the respective first and second radiographing directions is generated on the basis of detection signals from the radiation detector 131.

rows.title: Image data compressing device
rows.abstract: PURPOSE:To compress even an original where characters and half-tones are mixed together without spoiling the picture quality by converting respective picture elements in a block into binary data and replacing them with a specific bit pattern when the picture elements are in a character area, or replacing them with the mean value in the block when the picture elements are in a half-tone area. CONSTITUTION:When image data is outputted actually, the area decision flag of the head bit of the image data is detected when the flag indicates '0', the same image data is read out three times repeatedly in a main-scanning and a subscanning direction and stored in a three-line buffer. The image data is compared with the threshold pattern of a dither matrix for binary coding and output binary data obtained by the comparison is generated in a three-line buffer for output. Further, when the area decision flag indicates '1', on the other hand, the data is character data, so bit patterns corresponding to picture elements A-D, and F-I are read out to the three-line buffer for output and they are restored according to the states of the picture elements A-D, and F-I and then stored.
